senses.english: something that has been remembered
senses.exampleEnglish: That familiar smell brought back a happy memory of the summer we spent by the sea.
senses.exampleChinese: 那熟悉的气味唤起了我们在海边度过夏天的美好回忆。

senses.english: the ability to remember information and past experiences
senses.exampleEnglish: Her memory improved when she began reviewing new vocabulary regularly instead of studying everything only once.
senses.exampleChinese: 她开始定期复习新词，而不只学一次后，记忆力提高了。

senses.english: the part of a computer that holds information for use
senses.exampleEnglish: The program needs more memory to open large files while several other applications are running on the computer.
senses.exampleChinese: 当电脑同时运行多个程序时，这个程序需要更多内存来打开大文件。

senses.english: color of young leaves
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a soft green for the kitchen because it made the small room feel calmer.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为厨房选了柔和的绿色，因为它让小房间显得更宁静。

senses.english: having the colour of grass or fresh leaves
senses.exampleEnglish: We painted the kitchen green because the colour looked pleasant beside the wooden cupboards and white tiles.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把厨房漆成绿色，因为它与木橱柜和白瓷砖搭配很好看。

senses.english: intended to protect the environment or reduce damage to it
senses.exampleEnglish: The company encourages green travel by helping staff buy bicycles and providing secure places to leave them.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司帮助员工购置自行车并提供安全停车处，以鼓励绿色出行。

senses.english: having little experience of a particular activity or job
senses.exampleEnglish: Although he was rather green when he joined the team, he learned quickly from his more experienced colleagues.
senses.exampleChinese: 他刚加入团队时虽然缺乏经验，但很快就向更有经验的同事学到了东西。

senses.english: green vegetables eaten as food, usually used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The children helped wash the greens before their father added them to the soup for the evening meal.
senses.exampleChinese: 父亲把青菜放进晚饭的汤里之前，孩子们帮忙清洗了它们。

senses.english: some music with words in verse
senses.exampleEnglish: The song reminded everyone of their school days, although none of them remembered all the words.
senses.exampleChinese: 这首歌让大家想起学生时代，尽管没有人记得全部歌词。

senses.english: to disagree; to protest against an idea or plan
senses.exampleEnglish: Several neighbours object to the plan because the new road would pass close to their homes.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位邻居反对该计划，因为新公路会紧邻他们的家。

senses.english: a thing that can be seen or touched
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum asks visitors not to touch any object because even clean hands can damage delicate surfaces.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆要求游客不要触摸任何物品，因为干净的手也会损伤脆弱表面。

senses.english: the purpose that an action or activity is intended to achieve
senses.exampleEnglish: The object of the exercise is to improve communication rather than to decide which student speaks most accurately.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项练习的目的是改善沟通，而不是决定哪个学生说得最准确。

senses.english: to keep, exist or continue without changing
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers maintain the garden throughout the year, so visitors can enjoy it in every season.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者全年维护花园，让游客每个季节都能欣赏它。

senses.english: to continue to say that something is true
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver maintained that he had followed the instructions, although the delivery had reached the wrong address.
senses.exampleChinese: 司机坚持说自己遵循了说明，尽管货物送到了错误地址。

senses.english: system to buy something and pay for it later
senses.exampleEnglish: She bought the washing machine on credit because she could not afford the full price immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 她赊购了洗衣机，因为无法立即付清全款。

senses.english: recognition or praise for something someone has done
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager gave the volunteers credit for organising the event so successfully with very little money available.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理赞扬志愿者用很少的资金就把活动组织得如此成功。

senses.english: money available in an account or already paid towards future use
senses.exampleEnglish: I checked the credit on my travel card before boarding, since the journey cost more than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 上车前我查看了交通卡余额，因为这次车费比平时高。

senses.english: a unit showing that a student has successfully completed part of a course
senses.exampleEnglish: Students receive credit for the project only if they explain their methods as well as their final results.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生只有既解释方法又说明最终结果，才能获得这个项目的学分。

senses.english: to say that someone or something is responsible for a good result
senses.exampleEnglish: She credits her teacher with helping her gain the confidence to speak English during meetings at work.
senses.exampleChinese: 她把自己敢于在工作会议中讲英语的信心归功于老师的帮助。

senses.english: a thing that roughly forms a circle, usually around something; the sound of a bell
senses.exampleEnglish: A thin ring of light appeared around the moon as we walked home through the park.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们穿过公园回家时，月亮周围出现了一圈细细的光。

senses.english: the sound made by a bell or telephone
senses.exampleEnglish: The ring of the doorbell interrupted our conversation just as we were about to make the final decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们正要作出最终决定时，门铃声打断了谈话。

senses.english: to contact someone by telephone, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: Please ring the office before setting off, so someone can confirm that the documents are ready for collection.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前请给办公室打电话，让人确认文件已经准备好领取。

senses.english: to make a clear bell-like sound or cause a bell to sound
senses.exampleEnglish: The school bell rang while the children were finishing their drawings, so the teacher allowed another minute.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们快画完时学校铃响了，于是老师又给了一分钟。

senses.english: to form a circle around something
senses.exampleEnglish: Trees ring the small lake, giving walkers plenty of shade even on the hottest afternoons in summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 树木环绕小湖，让散步者即使在夏季最热的下午也有很多阴凉。

senses.english: to find something new that was not known before
senses.exampleEnglish: The children hope to discover how the machine works before they build a smaller version themselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们希望先弄清机器如何运作，再自己制作缩小版。

senses.english: not alive
senses.exampleEnglish: The tree was dead, but the gardener left its trunk standing as a home for insects.
senses.exampleChinese: 这棵树已经死了，但园丁留下树干供昆虫栖息。

senses.english: no longer working because power has stopped or been used up
senses.exampleEnglish: My phone was dead by the time we reached the village, so I borrowed a map from the café.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达村庄时手机没电了，所以我向咖啡馆借了地图。

senses.english: time after 12:00 and before the evening meal
senses.exampleEnglish: We spent the afternoon exploring the old town before returning to our hotel for dinner.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们整个下午都在游览老城区，随后回旅馆吃晚饭。

senses.english: to like something better than something else
senses.exampleEnglish: I prefer working near a window because natural light helps me stay focused during long tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 我更喜欢在窗边工作，因为自然光有助于我长时间保持专注。

senses.english: to straighten or stretch something out (e.g., your leg)
senses.exampleEnglish: Please extend your arm slowly while the instructor checks that you are holding the racket correctly.
senses.exampleChinese: 请慢慢伸直手臂，让教练检查你的握拍姿势是否正确。

senses.english: to make something longer in time or distance
senses.exampleEnglish: The library will extend its opening hours during the exam period so students have somewhere quiet to study.
senses.exampleChinese: 考试期间图书馆将延长开放时间，让学生有安静的地方学习。

senses.english: to make something cover a larger area or reach more people
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisation hopes to extend its services to nearby villages where families currently have little access to support.
senses.exampleChinese: 该组织希望将服务扩大到附近村庄，那里的家庭目前很难获得支持。

senses.english: something with a chance of happening or being true
senses.exampleEnglish: We discussed the possibility of travelling by train, since the airport was far from the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们讨论了乘火车旅行的可能性，因为机场离市区很远。

senses.english: describes the way you are going (e.g., north)
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide pointed in the direction of the village, which was hidden behind a wooded hill.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导指向村子的方向，村子藏在一座林木茂盛的小山后。

senses.english: information explaining how to reach a place or do something, usually plural
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed the directions on the packet carefully, but the mixture still seemed much thicker than expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们仔细按照包装上的说明操作，但混合物仍比预期浓得多。

senses.english: control and guidance of the way an activity is carried out
senses.exampleEnglish: Under her direction, the team completed the repairs early without reducing the quality of the final work.
senses.exampleChinese: 在她指导下，团队在不降低质量的情况下提前完成了维修。

senses.english: piece of equipment or buildings with a special use
senses.exampleEnglish: The new sports facility includes an indoor pool, so local families can swim throughout the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的体育设施包括室内泳池，当地家庭全年都能游泳。

senses.english: a particular type or types of things or persons
senses.exampleEnglish: The market sells a wide variety of vegetables, including several kinds that we had never tried.
senses.exampleChinese: 市场出售多种蔬菜，其中有几种我们从未尝过。

senses.english: the quality of including different things instead of always being the same
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher adds variety to each lesson by combining short discussions with reading, writing and practical activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师将简短讨论与阅读、写作及实践活动结合，增加每节课的多样性。

senses.english: happening every day
senses.exampleEnglish: She practises daily, even when she has only fifteen minutes available before leaving for work.
senses.exampleChinese: 她每天都练习，即使上班前只有十五分钟空闲。

senses.english: happening every day or belonging to everyday life
senses.exampleEnglish: Daily practice helped her remember the new words, even when she had little time to study after work.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使下班后学习时间不多，每天练习仍帮她记住了新词。

senses.english: things you wear on your body (e.g., shirt, dress, tie)
senses.exampleEnglish: We packed some warm clothes because the mountain village often becomes cold after the sun sets.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们带了些保暖衣物，因为山村在日落后常常变冷。

senses.english: flat surface on a computer, or tv that shows images
senses.exampleEnglish: The screen was bright enough for us to read the instructions even in the sunny room.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使房间阳光充足，屏幕亮度仍足以让我们看清说明。

senses.english: a structure used to separate an area or hide something from view
senses.exampleEnglish: A wooden screen separates the sleeping area from the rest of the room without blocking all the light.
senses.exampleChinese: 木屏风把睡觉区域与房间其他部分隔开，同时没有完全挡住光线。

senses.english: to examine people or things to find possible problems or decide suitability
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisation screens all volunteers before allowing them to work alone with children at the holiday camp.
senses.exampleChinese: 该组织会审查所有志愿者，之后才允许他们在夏令营独自带孩子。

senses.english: to show a film or programme to an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: The cinema will screen the film with English subtitles so that more visitors can follow the story.
senses.exampleChinese: 影院将放映带英文字幕的电影，让更多观众理解故事。

senses.english: to follow behind someone to see what they are doing
senses.exampleEnglish: Researchers track the birds throughout the winter to learn where they find food when temperatures fall.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究人员整个冬天都跟踪这些鸟，了解降温时它们在哪里觅食。

senses.english: a rough narrow path made by people or vehicles
senses.exampleEnglish: The track became narrower after the farm, so we left the bicycles and continued through the woods on foot.
senses.exampleChinese: 过了农场后小道变窄，我们留下自行车，步行继续穿过树林。

senses.english: the pair of metal rails along which trains travel
senses.exampleEnglish: Workers checked the track before the first train arrived because heavy rain had fallen during the night.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一班火车到达前，工人检查了轨道，因为夜间下过大雨。

senses.english: one recorded song or piece of music on an album
senses.exampleEnglish: The final track on the album sounds different because it was recorded live rather than in a studio.
senses.exampleChinese: 专辑最后一首曲目听起来不同，因为它是现场录制，而非录音室制作。

senses.english: to follow and record how something changes over time
senses.exampleEnglish: The app helps students track their progress by showing which words they can remember without seeing any hints.
senses.exampleChinese: 应用显示学生无需提示就能记住哪些词，帮助他们跟踪进步。

senses.english: to move your body rhythmically to music
senses.exampleEnglish: The children learned to dance together, although they found it difficult to follow the music initially.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们学习一起跳舞，尽管起初很难跟上音乐。

senses.english: movement of the body to music, or one particular set of such movements
senses.exampleEnglish: The dance requires everyone to move together, so the instructor asked us to practise the basic steps slowly.
senses.exampleChinese: 这支舞需要大家动作一致，因此老师让我们慢慢练习基本舞步。

senses.english: a social event at which people dance to music
senses.exampleEnglish: The village held a dance in the community hall to raise money for repairing the children's playground.
senses.exampleChinese: 村里在活动中心举办舞会，为修理儿童游乐场筹款。

senses.english: in every way or as much as possible
senses.exampleEnglish: The room looked completely different after we moved the furniture and painted the walls a lighter colour.
senses.exampleChinese: 挪动家具并将墙壁刷浅后，房间看起来完全不同了。

senses.english: person of the sex that gives birth to babies
senses.exampleEnglish: The female engineer explained her design clearly, and several students stayed afterwards to ask her questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位女工程师清楚地讲解了设计，几位学生课后留下提问。

senses.english: a female person or animal
senses.exampleEnglish: The adult female stayed close to her young while the researchers observed the animals from a safe distance.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究者在安全距离外观察时，成年雌性一直待在幼崽身边。

senses.english: state of being dependable or reliable
senses.exampleEnglish: Taking responsibility for the mistake helped him regain the trust of colleagues who had felt disappointed.
senses.exampleChinese: 承担错误的责任，帮助他重新赢得了失望同事的信任。

senses.english: a duty to look after someone or do a particular job
senses.exampleEnglish: Her main responsibility is to check that every new employee receives the training needed to work safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的主要职责是检查每位新员工是否接受了安全工作所需的培训。

senses.english: the state of being the person who caused something wrong to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The company accepted responsibility for the mistake and arranged to send the correct order without charging us again.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司承认对错误负责，安排免费重新寄送正确的订单。

senses.english: being first made, thought, or performed; fresh
senses.exampleEnglish: We compared the translation with the original text to check whether the meaning had changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们对照译文和原文，检查意思是否发生了变化。

senses.english: new and interesting rather than copied from something else
senses.exampleEnglish: Her original idea made the exhibition more interesting by allowing visitors to add their own stories to the display.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的新颖想法让游客补充自己的故事，使展览更有趣。

senses.english: the first version from which copies are made
senses.exampleEnglish: Please keep the original in a safe place and send us a copy with your completed application form.
senses.exampleChinese: 请将原件妥善保管，把复印件与填好的申请表一起寄给我们。

senses.english: female you share a parent with
senses.exampleEnglish: My sister offered to collect the children because she knew our meeting might finish later than expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 姐姐主动提出接孩子，因为她知道我们的会议可能延迟结束。

senses.english: big stone; hard, solid substance forming mountains
senses.exampleEnglish: A large rock blocked the narrow path, so we had to find another way down the hill.
senses.exampleChinese: 一块巨石挡住了狭窄小路，我们只好另找下山的路。

senses.english: a style of popular music with a strong beat, often using electric guitars
senses.exampleEnglish: The band combines rock with traditional local music, which makes its performances popular with several different generations.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐队把摇滚乐与当地传统音乐结合，因此表演受到几代人的欢迎。

senses.english: to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side
senses.exampleEnglish: The boat began to rock as the wind grew stronger, so everyone moved towards the middle and sat down.
senses.exampleChinese: 风变大时船开始摇晃，于是大家移到中间坐下。

senses.english: images, thoughts, and feelings that are experienced during sleep
senses.exampleEnglish: In my dream, I was exploring a city where every street led back to my childhood home.
senses.exampleChinese: 梦中我探索着一座城市，每条街都通向儿时的家。

senses.english: something that you strongly hope to achieve in the future
senses.exampleEnglish: Her dream of opening a bookshop became possible when she found a small building near the busy station.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在繁忙车站附近找到一幢小楼后，开书店的梦想有望实现。

senses.english: to experience pictures, feelings or events in your mind while sleeping
senses.exampleEnglish: I dreamed that I was travelling through a city where every street led back to my old school.
senses.exampleChinese: 我梦见自己穿行于一座城市，每条街都通向我以前的学校。

senses.english: to imagine and hope for something you would like in the future
senses.exampleEnglish: They dream of living near the sea, although they know they must find suitable work before moving there.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们梦想住在海边，但知道搬去之前必须先找到合适工作。

senses.english: used to show two things that are both untrue or do not happen
senses.exampleEnglish: She neither complained about the delay nor asked for special treatment when the train finally arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车终于到站时，她既没有抱怨延误，也没有要求特殊待遇。

senses.english: high-level educational institution; college
senses.exampleEnglish: The university offers evening classes for people who want to continue studying while working full time.
senses.exampleChinese: 这所大学为希望全职工作之余继续学习的人开设夜校。

senses.english: without difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were written clearly, so even beginners could easily understand how to use the device.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明写得很清楚，因此连初学者都能轻松理解设备的用法。

senses.english: business that provides some service for others
senses.exampleEnglish: The travel agency arranged a different hotel after discovering that our original booking had been cancelled.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅行社发现原先的预订被取消后，另给我们安排了旅馆。

senses.english: a basic unit of money equal to 100 cent
senses.exampleEnglish: He saved a dollar every day until he had enough money to buy his own dictionary.
senses.exampleChinese: 他每天存一美元，直到有足够的钱购买自己的词典。

senses.english: yard; ground outside your house to grow plants
senses.exampleEnglish: We planted flowers in the garden so that there would be something colourful throughout the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在花园里种了花，让整个夏天都有鲜艳的色彩。

senses.english: to grow and look after plants in a garden
senses.exampleEnglish: She likes to garden in the early morning, before the weather becomes too warm to work comfortably outdoors.
senses.exampleChinese: 她喜欢清晨做园艺，那时天气还没热到不适合户外工作。

senses.english: to make something whole or able to work again
senses.exampleEnglish: The mechanic offered to fix the bicycle while we waited, which saved us another journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 修车师傅提出在我们等候时修好自行车，省得我们再跑一趟。

senses.english: to attach something firmly so that it does not move
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to fix the shelves to the wall securely before putting the heavier books on them.
senses.exampleChinese: 放较重的书之前，我们需要把架子牢固地固定在墙上。

senses.english: to decide or arrange a definite time, price or plan
senses.exampleEnglish: We should fix a date for the meeting now, before everyone's calendar becomes too full to find a suitable day.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该现在确定会议日期，免得大家日程排满后难以找到合适日子。

senses.english: in or toward the front
senses.exampleEnglish: We could see a small village ahead, although the path towards it was hidden by trees.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们看见前方有个小村庄，尽管通往村庄的小路被树林遮住。

senses.english: into the future or before a later event
senses.exampleEnglish: Thinking ahead helped us prepare the materials before the visitors arrived, instead of rushing at the last minute.
senses.exampleChinese: 提前考虑让我们在访客到来前备好材料，而不是最后一刻匆忙准备。

senses.english: in a better position or with a higher score than someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: Our team was ahead for most of the match, but the visitors scored twice during the final minutes.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们队大部分比赛时间领先，但客队最后几分钟进了两球。

senses.english: to meet at one point
senses.exampleEnglish: The two paths cross near the bridge, where walkers usually stop to check their maps.
senses.exampleChinese: 两条小路在桥附近相交，徒步者通常在那里停下查看地图。

senses.english: to go from one side of something to the other
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited for the lights to change before helping the children cross the busy road near the school.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们等信号灯变换后，才帮助孩子穿过学校附近的繁忙道路。

senses.english: a mark formed by two lines that meet and go across each other
senses.exampleEnglish: Put a cross beside the answer you choose, then check that you have completed every question on the page.
senses.exampleChinese: 在所选答案旁打叉，然后检查是否完成了这页的每道题。

senses.english: angry or annoyed, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt cross when she discovered the missing book, but she listened to the explanation before saying anything.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现书不见时她很生气，但先听完解释才开口。

senses.english: yes (informal)
senses.exampleEnglish: When I asked whether she wanted to join our team, she smiled and said, 'Yeah, definitely.'
senses.exampleChinese: 我问她是否愿意加入团队时，她笑着说：“当然愿意。”

senses.english: a person being considered for a job or position in office
senses.exampleEnglish: Each candidate had to explain how they would solve a problem before the interview panel made its decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 面试小组决定之前，每位候选人都必须说明解决问题的方法。

senses.english: how heavy something is
senses.exampleEnglish: The weight of the bag surprised me because it contained only a few books and a laptop.
senses.exampleChinese: 包的重量让我吃惊，因为里面只有几本书和一台笔记本电脑。

senses.english: the importance or influence given to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee gave more weight to local knowledge than to advice from people who had never visited the area.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会更看重本地知识，而非从未来过该地区者的建议。

senses.english: a heavy object used in exercise or to keep something in place
senses.exampleEnglish: He put a weight on the papers to stop them blowing away while he worked beside the open window.
senses.exampleChinese: 他在窗边工作时用重物压住纸，以防被风吹走。

senses.english: concerning the law; allowed by law
senses.exampleEnglish: The company sought legal advice before signing the agreement, since several conditions were difficult to understand.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司在签约前咨询了法律意见，因为几个条款很难理解。

senses.english: allowed by the law
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained where camping was legal, since some parts of the park were protected for nesting birds.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导解释了哪里可以合法露营，因为公园部分区域为鸟类繁殖保护区。

senses.english: offer or plan to people who can decide about it
senses.exampleEnglish: Her proposal received strong support because it offered a practical way to reduce waste without increasing costs.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的提议得到大力支持，因为它能切实减少浪费而不增加成本。

senses.english: a request asking someone to marry you
senses.exampleEnglish: His proposal came as a surprise because they had never seriously discussed when they might get married.
senses.exampleChinese: 他求婚令人意外，因为两人从未认真讨论过何时结婚。

senses.english: particular form of something and other forms
senses.exampleEnglish: The latest version includes a simpler menu, although users can still choose the old layout if they prefer.
senses.exampleChinese: 最新版本增加了更简单的菜单，用户仍可选择原来的布局。

senses.chinese: 对事件的说法；叙述版本
senses.english: one person's description of an event, which may differ from another's
senses.exampleEnglish: We heard a different version of the story from each witness, so we checked which details they agreed on.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位目击者说法不同，所以我们核对了哪些细节是大家一致的。

senses.english: when you talk with other people; discussion or chat
senses.exampleEnglish: Our conversation continued long after dinner because we discovered that we shared an interest in local history.
senses.exampleChinese: 晚饭后我们聊了很久，因为发现彼此都对当地历史感兴趣。

senses.english: person who is not known or named
senses.exampleEnglish: Somebody had left a note on the door explaining where we should wait until the office opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 有人在门上留了字条，说明办公室开门前我们该在哪里等候。

senses.english: unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kg
senses.exampleEnglish: The recipe requires a pound of potatoes, but you can adjust the amount for a smaller family.
senses.exampleChinese: 食谱需要一磅土豆，但可以按家庭人数减少用量。

senses.english: the main unit of money used in the United Kingdom
senses.exampleEnglish: The ticket cost one pound more than last year, although the organiser said the extra money would improve facilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 票价比去年贵一英镑，但组织者说多收的钱会用于改善设施。

senses.english: to hit something hard several times
senses.exampleEnglish: Rain began to pound against the windows while we waited inside for the storm to pass over the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在屋内等暴风雨过去时，雨开始猛烈敲打窗户。

senses.english: weekly or monthly publication with pictures and stories
senses.exampleEnglish: She reads a science magazine every month because its articles explain difficult ideas in an interesting way.
senses.exampleChinese: 她每月读一本科学杂志，因为文章能生动解释复杂概念。

senses.english: outer form of something, what it looks like
senses.exampleEnglish: The shape of the bottle makes it easy to hold, even when your hands are wet.
senses.exampleChinese: 瓶子的形状方便握持，即使手湿时也一样。

senses.english: to give something a particular physical form or influence how it develops
senses.exampleEnglish: The children used wet clay to shape small bowls, which would be dried before they could paint them.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们用湿黏土塑成小碗，干燥后再涂色。

senses.english: to influence the way a person or situation develops
senses.exampleEnglish: Her early experiences helped shape her views about education and the importance of giving every child equal opportunities.
senses.exampleChinese: 早年的经历影响了她对教育以及给予孩子平等机会的看法。

senses.english: place with a large amount of salt water
senses.exampleEnglish: We could hear the sea from our bedroom, although the beach was hidden behind the houses.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然海滩被房屋挡住，我们在卧室里仍能听到海浪声。

senses.english: without any delay; straight away; right (after or before)
senses.exampleEnglish: Please contact the office immediately if your address changes, so important letters do not go missing.
senses.exampleChinese: 地址变更时请立即联系办公室，以免重要信件遗失。

senses.english: friendly greeting to someone who has arrived
senses.exampleEnglish: The family gave us such a warm welcome that we felt comfortable almost as soon as we arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人热情欢迎我们，让我们几乎一到就觉得很自在。

senses.english: to greet someone in a friendly way when they arrive
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser will welcome the visitors before explaining how the community garden developed over the past few years.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者会先欢迎访客，再介绍社区花园过去几年的发展。

senses.english: pleasant or useful because it is wanted or needed
senses.exampleEnglish: The extra help was welcome because several volunteers had become unavailable just before the event was due to start.
senses.exampleChinese: 额外援助很及时，因为活动快开始时几位志愿者来不了了。

senses.english: used to greet someone who has just arrived
senses.exampleEnglish: Welcome to the workshop, where we will spend the morning learning how to repair small household objects safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 欢迎参加工作坊，今天上午我们将学习安全修理小型家居用品。

senses.english: to show happiness by pulling up the corners of your mouth
senses.exampleEnglish: She began to smile when she realised that everyone had remembered the story she told last week.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现大家都记得她上周讲的故事时，她开始微笑。

senses.english: an expression in which the corners of the mouth turn up, often showing happiness
senses.exampleEnglish: Her smile reassured the new student, who had been worried about joining a class where nobody knew him.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的微笑让新同学安心，他原本担心加入一个无人认识自己的班级。

senses.english: the process or method to give or exchange information
senses.exampleEnglish: Clear communication between the two teams prevented small mistakes from becoming serious problems during the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个团队清晰的沟通，防止了项目中的小错误变成大问题。

senses.english: person who can represent and decide for others
senses.exampleEnglish: Our agent checked the documents carefully before agreeing to represent us in discussions with the publisher.
senses.exampleChinese: 代理人仔细检查文件后，才同意代表我们与出版商洽谈。

senses.english: a substance that produces a particular effect or chemical change
senses.exampleEnglish: Check that the cleaning agent is suitable for wood before using it on the old kitchen table.
senses.exampleChinese: 在旧厨房木桌上使用清洁剂前，先检查它是否适用于木材。

senses.english: involved in a tradition
senses.exampleEnglish: The restaurant serves traditional dishes that local families have prepared in much the same way for generations.
senses.exampleChinese: 餐厅供应传统菜肴，当地家庭几代人都用相似的方法制作。

senses.english: to use instead of something else
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to replace the old windows because too much heat was escaping during the winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定更换旧窗户，因为冬天从窗户散失的热量太多。

senses.english: to put something back in its usual or previous position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please replace the tools on the shelf after using them, so the next person can find everything easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 使用工具后请放回架子，方便下一个人找到。

senses.english: to form an opinion after careful consideration
senses.exampleEnglish: It is difficult to judge the quality of the course until you have attended a few lessons.
senses.exampleChinese: 上过几节课后，你才能判断这门课程的质量。

senses.english: a public official who controls a court and makes legal decisions
senses.exampleEnglish: The judge asked for more information before deciding whether the evidence was strong enough to continue the case.
senses.exampleChinese: 法官在决定证据是否足以继续审理案件前，要求提供更多信息。

senses.english: a person who decides how well people have performed in a competition
senses.exampleEnglish: Each judge gave detailed comments, so the young musicians understood which parts of their performance needed more practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位评委都详细点评，让年轻乐手明白哪些部分还需要练习。

senses.english: female person that did the original action
senses.exampleEnglish: She repaired the chair herself after watching a short video that explained which tools she needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她看完工具说明短片后，自己修好了椅子。

senses.english: in an unexpected or very quick manner
senses.exampleEnglish: The lights suddenly went out while we were preparing dinner, so we finished cooking by candlelight.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们准备晚饭时突然停电，只好借着烛光做完。

senses.english: people born and living at about the same time
senses.exampleEnglish: Each generation brings new ideas to the family business while trying to preserve the values it inherited.
senses.exampleChinese: 每一代人都为家族企业带来新想法，同时努力保留传承的价值观。

senses.english: the process of producing something, especially electricity
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains electricity generation using simple models that visitors can operate without needing any technical knowledge.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览用无需技术知识即可操作的简单模型，解释发电过程。

senses.english: a group of products or machines at a similar stage of development
senses.exampleEnglish: The latest generation of cameras can take clearer pictures in low light without requiring such a large lens.
senses.exampleChinese: 最新一代相机无需那么大的镜头，也能在弱光下拍出更清晰照片。

senses.english: guess or calculation of cost, size, or value
senses.exampleEnglish: The builder gave us an estimate before starting, but warned that unexpected repairs might increase the cost.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑工开工前提供了估价，但提醒意外维修可能增加费用。

senses.english: to calculate roughly how much, how many or how large something is
senses.exampleEnglish: Please estimate how long the repairs will take before promising the customer that the bicycle will be ready tomorrow.
senses.exampleChinese: 向顾客承诺明天修好自行车之前，请先估计维修需要多久。

senses.english: most liked; best loved
senses.exampleEnglish: Her favorite book is one she first read as a child, and she still returns to it occasionally.
senses.exampleChinese: 她最喜欢的书是儿时读过的一本，如今仍偶尔重读。

senses.english: a person or thing that someone likes more than others
senses.exampleEnglish: This book remains her favorite because the story reminds her of the place where she grew up.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本书仍是她最爱，因为故事让她想起自己长大的地方。

collocations.chinese: 一直很受喜爱的人或物

senses.english: something that is hard to do
senses.exampleEnglish: We had difficulty finding the hotel because the street names on our map were out of date.
senses.exampleChinese: 地图上的街名过时了，因此我们很难找到旅馆。

senses.english: to buy something; to get by paying money for it
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors can purchase tickets online in advance, which usually saves time when the museum is busy.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客可以提前在线购票，博物馆繁忙时通常能节省时间。

senses.english: the act of buying something or an item that has been bought
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep the receipt for your purchase, since the shop may need it if the item stops working.
senses.exampleChinese: 请保留购物收据，因为商品故障时店里可能需要查看。

senses.english: to kick or throw a ball at a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach told me to shoot only when I had enough space to aim at the goal.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练让我只有在有足够空间瞄准球门时才射门。

senses.english: to fire a weapon or hit something with a bullet
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum guide explained why soldiers had to stop and reload before they could shoot again with these old weapons.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆向导解释了为何士兵用这些旧武器时必须停下装弹后才能再次射击。

senses.english: to take photographs or record a film
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will shoot their short film in the park, provided that they receive permission from the council.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生获得市议会许可后，将在公园拍摄短片。

senses.english: to make a public statement about a plan, decision
senses.exampleEnglish: The school will announce the results tomorrow, after the judges have checked all the final entries.
senses.exampleChinese: 评委检查完所有决赛作品后，学校明天将公布结果。

senses.english: negative of 'if'
senses.exampleEnglish: We will have lunch outside unless the weather changes, in which case we can use the kitchen.
senses.exampleChinese: 除非天气变化，否则我们就在外面吃午饭；天气变了可用厨房。

senses.english: making your own decisions; not controlled by others
senses.exampleEnglish: She became more independent after moving away from home, although she still called her parents regularly.
senses.exampleChinese: 离家生活后她变得更独立了，但仍经常给父母打电话。

senses.english: to say something is good and deserves to be chosen
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you recommend a quiet restaurant where we can talk comfortably without having to raise our voices?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能推荐一家安静的餐厅，让我们不用提高声音就能自在聊天吗？

senses.english: to ask people a question about a particular topic
senses.exampleEnglish: The council plans to survey local residents before deciding whether the park needs a larger playground.
senses.exampleChinese: 市议会计划先调查当地居民，再决定公园是否需要更大的游乐场。

senses.english: an examination of people's opinions or behaviour using a set of questions
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey asked residents how they travelled to work and whether better bus services would change their habits.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查询问居民如何通勤，以及公交改善会不会改变他们的习惯。

senses.english: to examine a place carefully to learn about its condition or features
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineer will survey the site before deciding where the new path can cross the stream safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师会先勘测地点，再决定新小路可以在哪里安全跨过溪流。

senses.english: amount that is more than half of a group
senses.exampleEnglish: The majority of students chose the earlier train because it would give them more time in the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 大多数学生选了较早的火车，这样在城里能多待一会儿。

senses.english: long thin piece of wood from a tree
senses.exampleEnglish: He used a long stick to pull the branch closer without damaging the young leaves underneath.
senses.exampleChinese: 他用长棍拉近树枝，没有损伤下面的嫩叶。

senses.english: to attach something using glue or another sticky substance
senses.exampleEnglish: Please stick the label firmly to the box so it does not fall off while the parcel is being carried.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把标签牢牢贴在箱子上，以免搬运时脱落。

senses.english: to push a long or narrow object into something
senses.exampleEnglish: Stick the plant label into the soil beside the seeds, so we remember which vegetables are growing there.
senses.exampleChinese: 把植物标签插在种子旁的土里，让我们记得那里种了什么蔬菜。

senses.english: to become fixed in place and difficult to move
senses.exampleEnglish: The old door tends to stick when the weather is damp, so opening it sometimes requires a gentle push.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气潮湿时旧门容易卡住，有时得轻推才能打开。

senses.english: to ask for something
senses.exampleEnglish: Guests should request an extra blanket at reception if their room feels cold during the night.
senses.exampleChinese: 夜间觉得房间冷的住客，可以到前台要求加一条毯子。

senses.english: an act of asking politely or formally for something
senses.exampleEnglish: We received a request for more information, so we sent the organiser a copy of the full schedule.
senses.exampleChinese: 收到索取更多信息的请求后，我们给组织者发了完整日程。

senses.english: having a lot of money, possessions, or resources
senses.exampleEnglish: The town became rich through trade, although many of its old warehouses are now used as galleries.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座城镇因贸易而富裕，如今许多旧仓库已改为画廊。

senses.english: containing a large amount of something valuable or useful
senses.exampleEnglish: The soil is rich in nutrients, which helps the vegetables grow well even without adding much extra material.
senses.exampleChinese: 土壤富含养分，因此即使不添加很多额外材料，蔬菜也长得很好。

senses.english: having a strong pleasant flavour or containing much fat, sugar or cream
senses.exampleEnglish: The cake was so rich that most guests chose a small piece rather than the larger portions offered.
senses.exampleChinese: 蛋糕很浓厚，大多数客人只选一小块，没有拿提供的大份。

senses.english: natural movement of outside air as part of the weather
senses.exampleEnglish: A strong wind made it difficult to cycle home, especially along the open road near the fields.
senses.exampleChinese: 强风让骑车回家变得困难，尤其是经过田边开阔路段时。

senses.english: to turn something repeatedly or arrange it in curves around another object
senses.exampleEnglish: Wind the cable around the holder carefully so it will not become tangled before we need it again.
senses.exampleChinese: 小心把电缆绕在支架上，免得下次用时缠结。

senses.english: not one of a group; not at all or in no way
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked several possible routes, but none offered a direct connection to the village we wanted to visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们查了几条路线，但没有一条能直达想去的村庄。

senses.english: to give things of similar value to each other
senses.exampleEnglish: At the end of the lesson, students exchange their work so they can learn from each other's suggestions.
senses.exampleChinese: 课结束时，学生交换作业，从彼此的建议中学习。

senses.english: an act of giving something and receiving something else in return
senses.exampleEnglish: The exchange of ideas helped both teams find a solution that neither had considered before the meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 想法交流帮助两个团队找到了会前双方都没想到的办法。

senses.english: amount of money planned to be spent on something
senses.exampleEnglish: We stayed within our budget by cooking some meals ourselves instead of eating in restaurants every evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们自己做了几顿饭，没有每晚去餐厅，因此支出未超预算。

senses.english: to plan how much money can be spent on particular things
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to budget carefully for the trip because transport and accommodation will cost more during the school holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校假期的交通住宿更贵，我们得仔细规划旅行预算。

senses.english: costing less than most similar things
senses.exampleEnglish: They chose a budget hotel near the station so they could spend more money on activities during their visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们选了车站附近的经济型旅馆，以便把更多钱用于游览活动。

senses.english: widely known; recognized by many people
senses.exampleEnglish: The village is famous for its pottery, which local families have produced using traditional methods for centuries.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个村庄以陶器闻名，当地家庭数百年来一直沿用传统方法制作。

senses.english: red liquid in the bodies of people and animals
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse checked the blood sample carefully before sending it to the laboratory for further tests.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士仔细检查血样，再送往实验室进一步检测。

senses.english: right or suitable for some situation or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: Please wear shoes appropriate for walking, since part of the route follows a narrow path through the forest.
senses.exampleChinese: 请穿适合步行的鞋，因为部分路线要经过林间狭窄小路。

senses.english: to stop from going forward or making progress
senses.exampleEnglish: A fallen tree began to block the road, so drivers had to wait until workers removed it.
senses.exampleChinese: 倒下的树挡住了道路，司机们只好等工人清理。

senses.english: a solid piece of material with flat sides
senses.exampleEnglish: The children used a block of wood to keep the door open while they carried their paintings outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们用一块木头撑住门，再把画搬出去。

senses.english: a large building or a group of buildings joined together
senses.exampleEnglish: The new apartment block includes shared spaces where residents can meet without having to leave the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 新公寓楼设有公共空间，居民不出楼就能相聚。

senses.english: an area of buildings surrounded by streets, especially in American English
senses.exampleEnglish: The café is only two blocks from the station, so we can walk there before the next train arrives.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆离车站只有两个街区，下班火车到达前我们能走过去。

senses.english: slightly hot; not very hot
senses.exampleEnglish: The room remained warm throughout the evening, even after we turned the heating down before dinner.
senses.exampleChinese: 晚饭前我们调低暖气后，房间整个晚上仍然暖和。

senses.english: showing kindness and friendly feelings towards someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Her warm welcome helped the visitors relax, even though most of them had never met anyone in the group before.
senses.exampleChinese: 她热情欢迎，让多数从未认识组员的来访者都放松下来。

senses.english: to make something less cold or become less cold
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped in a small café to warm our hands before continuing the walk through the snowy village.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在小咖啡馆停下暖手，再继续穿过下雪的村庄。

senses.english: to add things together to find the total number
senses.exampleEnglish: Please count the chairs before the guests arrive, so we can borrow more if there are not enough.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人到达前请清点椅子，不够的话我们还能再借。

senses.english: to be important or make a difference
senses.exampleEnglish: Every suggestion counts when we are planning a service that should meet the needs of the whole community.
senses.exampleChinese: 规划服务以满足整个社区需求时，每条建议都重要。

senses.english: to consider someone or something to be a particular type
senses.exampleEnglish: We count the short review as part of the lesson, rather than expecting students to complete it afterwards at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把简短复习算在课内，而不要求学生课后在家完成。

senses.english: the total found by counting or the act of finding that total
senses.exampleEnglish: The final count showed that we had enough chairs for everyone, including the guests who had not booked in advance.
senses.exampleChinese: 最终清点显示椅子足够，包括没有提前预订的客人也能坐下。

senses.english: part of an act in a play
senses.exampleEnglish: The final scene takes place in a railway station, where the two friends unexpectedly meet again.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一幕发生在火车站，两位朋友在那里意外重逢。

senses.english: the place where an event, especially an accident, happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The road remained closed near the scene of the accident while workers checked that it was safe to reopen.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人检查是否能安全重新开放时，事故现场附近的道路仍然关闭。

senses.english: professional who writes books, articles, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer spent months researching the village before using its history as the background for her novel.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位作家花了几个月研究村庄，再把它的历史作为小说背景。

senses.english: information in something (e.g., a book or computer program)
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher reviewed the content of the website before recommending it to students preparing for their exams.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先检查网站内容，再推荐给备考学生。

senses.english: happy with what you have and not wanting more
senses.exampleEnglish: She was content with the smaller flat because it was quiet and close to the people she cared about.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对较小的公寓很满意，因为那里安静，也靠近关心的人。

senses.english: the things inside a container or included in something, usually plural
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked the contents of the box before signing, since the package looked as if it had been damaged.
senses.exampleChinese: 签收前我们检查了箱内物品，因为包裹看起来受过损。

senses.english: to stop something from happening or existing
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular checks can prevent small faults from causing serious problems when the equipment is used every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 定期检查能防止设备日常使用中的小故障引发严重问题。

senses.english: being out of danger
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide found a safe place to stop, where everyone could rest away from the busy road.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导找到安全的停车处，让大家远离繁忙道路休息。

senses.english: a strong lockable container for money or valuable things
senses.exampleEnglish: The owner kept the original documents in a safe because replacing them would have been difficult and expensive.
senses.exampleChinese: 店主把原始文件放在保险箱里，因为补办困难且费用高。

senses.english: to ask someone to go somewhere or do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to invite our neighbours to dinner so that we could get to know them better.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定邀请邻居吃饭，以便更好地了解他们。

senses.english: to combine two or more things to make one
senses.exampleEnglish: Mix the ingredients slowly until the mixture becomes smooth, then pour it into the prepared baking dish.
senses.exampleChinese: 慢慢混合原料至顺滑，再倒入准备好的烤盘。

senses.english: a combination of different things or people
senses.exampleEnglish: The class includes a good mix of beginners and experienced learners, which makes the discussions especially interesting.
senses.exampleChinese: 班里初学者与有经验的学习者搭配合理，使讨论格外有趣。

senses.english: to spend time socially with other people
senses.exampleEnglish: The activities help children mix with new classmates instead of always choosing to work with the friends they already know.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动帮助孩子与新同学交往，而非总选择与原来的朋友合作。

senses.english: essential or particular part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Trust is an essential element of teamwork, especially when people must make decisions without consulting each other.
senses.exampleChinese: 信任是团队合作的重要要素，尤其是在成员无法相互商量就必须决策时。

senses.english: a basic substance that cannot be divided into simpler substances by chemical means
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained that each element has different properties before asking students to compare the samples on their desks.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先解释每种元素的性质不同，再让学生比较桌上的样品。

senses.english: working efficiently to produce a desired result
senses.exampleEnglish: The new method proved effective because students remembered the vocabulary even several weeks after practising it.
senses.exampleChinese: 新方法很有效，因为学生在练习几周后仍记得词汇。

senses.english: officially applying from a particular time
senses.exampleEnglish: The new timetable becomes effective next month, giving passengers time to plan different routes before their usual service changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表下月生效，让乘客在惯常班次改变前有时间规划其他路线。

senses.english: true or accurate
senses.exampleEnglish: Before sending the report, check that every name is correct and that the dates match the records.
senses.exampleChinese: 发报告前，检查每个姓名是否正确，以及日期是否与记录一致。

senses.english: to change something so that it is right or accurate
senses.exampleEnglish: Please correct the address before sending the order, otherwise the delivery may go to the previous owner's house.
senses.exampleChinese: 发送订单前请改正地址，否则货物可能送到前房主家。

senses.english: of or relating to physical health or medicine
senses.exampleEnglish: The centre provides medical care to families who would otherwise have to travel a long distance.
senses.exampleChinese: 该中心为家庭提供医疗服务，否则他们得长途奔波求医。

senses.english: to agree that you did something bad, or that something bad is true
senses.exampleEnglish: He was willing to admit that he had misunderstood the instructions before asking for another chance.
senses.exampleChinese: 他先承认自己误解了说明，然后请求再给一次机会。

senses.english: to allow someone to enter a place or receive treatment in a hospital
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum will admit visitors in smaller groups so everyone has enough space to see the exhibition comfortably.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆将分小组接待游客，让每个人都有足够空间舒适观展。

senses.english: 1) (n) sound made when you (v) hit something many times; 2) to win against another person or team
senses.exampleEnglish: Our team managed to beat the visitors, although we were losing by two goals at half-time.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然半场时落后两球，我们的队伍最后还是击败了客队。

senses.english: to hit something several times
senses.exampleEnglish: The rain continued to beat against the windows while the family waited inside for the storm to pass.
senses.exampleChinese: 一家人在屋里等待风暴过去时，雨水一直敲打窗户。

senses.english: to make the regular movements of a heart
senses.exampleEnglish: Her heart began to beat faster as she stepped onto the stage to introduce the school's final performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 走上舞台介绍学校最后一场表演时，她的心跳加快了。

senses.english: a regular pattern of sounds in music or repeated movements
senses.exampleEnglish: The children clapped along with the beat before trying the dance steps that the instructor had shown them.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们先跟着节拍拍手，再尝试老师展示的舞步。

senses.english: machine used to talk to someone who is far away
senses.exampleEnglish: The telephone in the entrance hall rang while we were helping our guests find their rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们帮客人找房间时，门厅里的电话响了。

senses.english: to contact someone using a telephone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please telephone the office if your arrival is delayed, so someone can change the arrangements for collecting you.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果抵达时间延误，请给办公室打电话，方便调整接你的安排。

senses.english: to make something that looks the same as the original
senses.exampleEnglish: You can copy the instructions into your notebook, but please keep the original document on the desk.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以把说明抄进笔记本，但请把原件留在桌上。

senses.english: something made to be the same as an original
senses.exampleEnglish: Please keep a copy of the form, because you may need to check the information after sending the original.
senses.exampleChinese: 请保留一份表格副本，因为寄出原件后可能需要核对信息。

senses.english: one example of a book, newspaper or other printed publication
senses.exampleEnglish: The library ordered another copy of the novel because several readers wanted to borrow it at the same time.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位读者同时想借这本小说，因此图书馆又订了一本。

senses.english: to behave or do something in the same way as another person
senses.exampleEnglish: The younger children began to copy the dance moves after watching the older students practise in the hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 小孩子们看年长学生在大厅练习后，开始模仿舞蹈动作。

senses.english: group of people who do or decide something
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee postponed its decision until every member had received the revised proposal and enough time to consider it.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会推迟了决定，直到每位成员收到修订提案并有足够时间考虑。

senses.english: knowing or feeling that something exists
senses.exampleEnglish: We were aware of the problem, but we had not realised how seriously it affected nearby residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们知道这个问题，但没意识到它对附近居民的影响有多严重。

senses.english: suggestion about what someone should do
senses.exampleEnglish: She followed her teacher's advice and practised speaking regularly instead of simply reading the same notes repeatedly.
senses.exampleChinese: 她听从老师建议，经常练习口语，而不是反复读同样的笔记。

senses.english: to have the ability to cope with or take responsibility for
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager showed us how to handle complaints calmly, even when customers were upset about a delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理教我们如何冷静处理投诉，即使顾客因延误而不满。

senses.english: a part designed for holding, carrying or opening something
senses.exampleEnglish: The handle felt loose when I lifted the bag, so I carried it from underneath instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 我提包时觉得提手松了，于是改为从底下托着搬。

senses.english: to touch, hold or move something with your hands
senses.exampleEnglish: Please handle the old photographs carefully because their edges have become weak after so many years in storage.
senses.exampleChinese: 请小心拿放老照片，因为存放多年后边缘已经脆弱。

senses.english: hard transparent material used for making windows
senses.exampleEnglish: The door was made of thick glass, which allowed light into the room while keeping the noise outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 门用厚玻璃制成，既让光线进入房间，又隔绝外面的噪声。

senses.english: a container for drinking, usually made of glass, or its contents
senses.exampleEnglish: She poured a glass of water for each guest before bringing the food from the kitchen to the table.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先给每位客人倒了杯水，再把食物从厨房端上桌。

senses.english: two lenses in a frame worn to help someone see, used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: He put on his glasses to read the instructions, which were printed in small letters beneath the diagram.
senses.exampleChinese: 他戴上眼镜，阅读图示下方用小字印出的说明。

senses.english: an event to determine the quality of something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: During the trial, volunteers tested the new device and explained which features they found useful in daily life.
senses.exampleChinese: 试用期间，志愿者测试新设备，并说明哪些功能在日常生活中实用。

senses.english: a formal examination of evidence in court to decide a legal case
senses.exampleEnglish: The trial lasted several weeks because the court needed to hear evidence from people living in different countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 审判持续数周，因为法院需要听取住在不同国家者的证词。

senses.english: to be in a state of mental tension due to problems
senses.exampleEnglish: Try not to stress about every small mistake, because learning a skill always involves some unsuccessful attempts.
senses.exampleChinese: 别为每个小错误感到紧张，因为学习技能总要经历一些失败尝试。

senses.english: mental or emotional pressure caused by difficult situations
senses.exampleEnglish: The long delay caused considerable stress because nobody knew whether the last connection would still be available.
senses.exampleChinese: 漫长延误带来很大压力，因为没人知道能否赶上最后一班接驳。

senses.english: to give particular importance to something when speaking or writing
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide stressed the importance of staying together before leading the children into the crowded exhibition hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 带孩子进入拥挤展厅前，向导强调了大家待在一起的重要性。

senses.english: extra force given to a syllable or word when speaking
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained how stress can change a sentence's meaning even when the words remain exactly the same.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师解释了即使词语完全相同，重音也能改变句意。

senses.english: system for sending and receiving signals through the air
senses.exampleEnglish: We listened to the weather report on the radio before deciding whether to continue our walk along the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定是否继续沿海散步前，我们收听了广播天气预报。

senses.english: the work of running something (e.g., a business)
senses.exampleEnglish: The school improved its administration by introducing a system that made it easier to organise lessons and contact families.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校引入了便于安排课程及联系家长的系统，改进了行政管理。

senses.english: the people who manage a country or organisation during a particular period
senses.exampleEnglish: The new administration promised to improve public transport before asking residents to consider using their cars less often.
senses.exampleChinese: 新政府承诺先改善公共交通，再让居民考虑减少开车。

senses.english: difficult, not easy to understand or explain
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions seemed complex at first, but the diagrams made each stage of the process easier to understand.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明起初似乎很复杂，但图示让每个步骤都更容易理解。

senses.english: a group of connected buildings or facilities used for a related purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The sports complex includes a pool and indoor courts, so local families can exercise throughout the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 体育综合设施包括游泳池和室内球场，当地家庭全年都能锻炼。

senses.english: written part of a book or other work
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the whole text before answering, because some details become clearer when you reach the final paragraph.
senses.exampleChinese: 回答前请读完整篇文章，因为有些细节到最后一段才更清楚。

senses.english: a short written message sent using a mobile phone
senses.exampleEnglish: I received a text from the driver explaining that he would wait near the side entrance instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 我收到司机短信，他说会改在侧门附近等。

senses.english: to send a short written message using a mobile phone
senses.exampleEnglish: Please text me when you reach the station, so I can come outside and help with your bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 到车站时请给我发短信，我好出来帮你拿行李。

senses.english: set of facts surrounding a person or event
senses.exampleEnglish: The meaning becomes clearer when you read the sentence in context rather than looking at each word separately.
senses.exampleChinese: 把句子放回语境阅读，而不是逐词孤立理解，意思就会更清楚。

senses.english: to sit on and control a horse or vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: We learned to ride safely on quiet roads before joining the cycle route that leads through the city centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先在安静路段学习安全骑行，再进入通往市中心的骑行路线。

senses.english: a journey on a bicycle, horse or vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: The bus ride took longer than expected because workers were repairing part of the road near the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 公交车程比预期久，因为工人正在修村庄附近的部分道路。

senses.english: from one place or person to another with nothing or no one between
senses.exampleEnglish: Please send the information directly to the organiser, so it does not get delayed while passing through several people.
senses.exampleChinese: 请直接把信息发给组织者，避免经多人转交而耽搁。

senses.english: without waiting or allowing time for something else to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: We went directly to the office after landing because the documents needed to be signed before lunchtime.
senses.exampleChinese: 飞机降落后我们直接赶往办公室，因为文件必须在午饭前签好。

senses.english: having a lot of weight
senses.exampleEnglish: The box was too heavy for one person, so we waited until a colleague could help carry it upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 箱子太重，一个人搬不动，我们等同事来帮忙抬上楼。

senses.english: greater in amount or strength than usual
senses.exampleEnglish: Heavy traffic delayed the bus, so we called the organiser to explain why we would arrive late.
senses.exampleChinese: 大量车流让公交延误，于是我们打电话解释为何会迟到。

senses.english: to move, erase or take away from a place
senses.exampleEnglish: Please remove your shoes before entering the room, since the wooden floor has only just been cleaned.
senses.exampleChinese: 请脱鞋后再进房间，因为木地板刚刚打扫干净。

senses.english: to direct, lead or guide something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide will conduct the tour in English, although printed information is available in several other languages.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导将用英语带领参观，另有多种语言的印刷资料可取。

senses.english: to organise and carry out an activity or process
senses.exampleEnglish: The researchers will conduct a survey before deciding whether the new service meets the needs of local families.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究者会先进行调查，再判断新服务是否符合当地家庭需求。

senses.english: the way someone behaves, especially towards others
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher praised the students' conduct during the visit because they listened carefully and treated everyone with respect.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师表扬学生参观时的举止，因为他们认真倾听并尊重所有人。

senses.english: to allow heat or electricity to pass through a material
senses.exampleEnglish: The experiment showed that metal can conduct heat, so the handle became warm even though it never touched the flame.
senses.exampleChinese: 实验显示金属能导热，因此把手虽未接触火焰也变暖了。

senses.english: tools or materials used to perform a task
senses.exampleEnglish: Check that all the equipment works properly before the visitors arrive, especially the microphone at the front.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人到达前，检查所有设备是否正常，特别是前面的麦克风。

senses.english: indicates that there will be a bad result if something is done, not done, or done improperly
senses.exampleEnglish: Please save your work before closing the program; otherwise, you may lose changes that have not been stored.
senses.exampleChinese: 关闭程序前请保存工作，否则可能丢失尚未保存的修改。

senses.english: apart from the fact or situation just mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: The room had one small window but was otherwise comfortable, with enough space for both of us to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间只有一扇小窗，但其他方面很舒适，足够我们两人工作。

senses.english: name given to something to identify or describe it
senses.exampleEnglish: The title caught my attention, but it was the opening paragraph that persuaded me to read the whole article.
senses.exampleChinese: 标题引起我的注意，但真正让我读完整篇文章的是开头一段。

senses.english: the position of being the winner of an important competition
senses.exampleEnglish: The team won the title after a difficult final that neither side managed to control until the last minutes.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场决赛直到最后几分钟双方都难以控制，最终球队夺得冠军。

senses.english: a word or name showing someone's official position or social status
senses.exampleEnglish: Please check each person's title before printing the invitations, since several guests have recently changed their roles.
senses.exampleChinese: 印邀请函前请核对每人的头衔，因为几位客人最近调任了。

senses.english: more than necessary; additional
senses.exampleEnglish: We brought an extra blanket because the forecast suggested that the temperature might fall sharply during the night.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们多带了一条毯子，因为天气预报说夜间可能大幅降温。

senses.english: something added to the basic item or price
senses.exampleEnglish: Breakfast is included, but any extras must be paid for before guests leave the hotel at the end of their stay.
senses.exampleChinese: 早餐包含在内，但客人离店前必须付清任何额外费用。

senses.english: more than is usual or normally expected
senses.exampleEnglish: We worked extra hard during the final week so the exhibition could open before the school holidays began.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一周我们格外努力，让展览能在学校假期前开幕。

senses.english: a senior manager in a business or organization
senses.exampleEnglish: The executive listened to employees' concerns before explaining why the company had decided to change its working hours.
senses.exampleChinese: 高管先倾听员工顾虑，再解释公司调整工作时间的原因。

senses.english: relating to people who make important management decisions
senses.exampleEnglish: The executive team reviewed the proposal before deciding whether the business could afford to open another branch.
senses.exampleChinese: 管理团队审阅提案后，再决定企业能否承担开设分店的费用。

senses.english: a piece of furniture you sit on when sitting at a table or desk
senses.exampleEnglish: She placed a chair beside the window so her grandfather could read comfortably in the afternoon sunlight.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在窗边放了把椅子，让祖父能舒适地借午后的阳光读书。

senses.english: the person who leads a meeting, committee or organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The chair invited quieter members to speak before asking the committee to vote on the final proposal.
senses.exampleChinese: 主席先请较少发言的成员表达意见，再让委员会对最终提案投票。

senses.english: to lead a meeting and manage the discussion
senses.exampleEnglish: She will chair the meeting because she knows the project well and can keep the discussion focused.
senses.exampleChinese: 她将主持会议，因为她熟悉项目，也能让讨论保持集中。

senses.english: costing a lot of money
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel was more expensive than we expected, although breakfast and transport to the station were included.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅馆比预期贵，不过包含早餐和往返车站的交通。

senses.english: to try something to see if you like it (e.g., food)
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors can sample the local cheese before deciding which varieties they would like to buy and take home.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客可以先尝当地奶酪，再决定购买哪些品种带回家。

senses.english: a small amount of something used to show what the whole thing is like
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop offered a sample of the cheese so we could decide whether its flavour suited our taste.
senses.exampleChinese: 店里给了一小块奶酪样品，让我们判断味道是否合口。

senses.english: a small group chosen to provide information about a larger group
senses.exampleEnglish: The researchers chose a sample of local residents that included people from different ages and types of household.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究者选取当地居民作为样本，包含不同年龄与家庭类型的人。

senses.english: state of being male or female mostly biological
senses.exampleEnglish: The researchers recorded each bird's sex and age before releasing it safely back into its natural surroundings.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究人员记录每只鸟的性别和年龄后，将其安全放归自然。

senses.english: physical sexual activity between people
senses.exampleEnglish: The course discusses sex and relationships in an age-appropriate way, encouraging students to ask questions respectfully rather than feel embarrassed.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程以适龄方式讨论性与关系，鼓励学生尊重地提问，而不必觉得尴尬。

senses.english: to take something to a person or place
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop promised to deliver the furniture on Saturday, when we would both be at home to receive it.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店答应星期六送家具，那天我们两人都在家收货。

senses.english: to give a speech or communicate a message to an audience
senses.exampleEnglish: The student will deliver a short speech explaining why the class chose to support the local animal shelter.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生将发表简短演讲，说明班级为什么选择支持当地动物收容所。

senses.english: to produce the result or quality that was promised or expected
senses.exampleEnglish: The new system must deliver better results without making daily tasks more difficult for the people using it.
senses.exampleChinese: 新系统必须改善效果，同时不能让使用者的日常任务更困难。

senses.english: to help a baby be born
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained that a trained midwife would deliver the baby and support the family throughout the birth.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士解释说，受过训练的助产士会接生，并在分娩期间支持家人。

senses.english: recording capturing action with sound
senses.exampleEnglish: The video shows how to replace the battery, with close-up views that make the smaller parts easier to identify.
senses.exampleChinese: 视频演示如何更换电池，特写画面让小零件更容易辨认。

senses.english: something that joins things together; being joined
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked the connection between the two cables before switching the machine on again to test the repair.
senses.exampleChinese: 再次开机测试维修效果之前，我们检查了两根电缆之间的连接。

senses.english: a relationship between people, facts, ideas or events
senses.exampleEnglish: We found a connection between regular practice and confidence, although other factors also influenced how comfortably students spoke.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们发现规律练习与信心有关，不过其他因素也会影响学生开口的自在程度。

senses.english: a bus, train or flight taken after another to continue a journey
senses.exampleEnglish: Our first train was delayed, but fortunately the connection to the village left from the same platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一班火车延误了，幸运的是去村庄的接驳车从同一站台发车。

senses.english: a relationship with someone who can help you, often used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: She had useful connections in the industry, but she still needed to show that her own work was good.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在业内有人脉，但仍需证明自己的作品出色。

senses.english: most important, most basic or essential
senses.exampleEnglish: Our primary concern is safety, so the trip will be postponed if the weather makes the route dangerous.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们最关心安全，如果天气使路线变得危险，就会推迟行程。

senses.english: relating to children's first years of formal school education
senses.exampleEnglish: The primary school invited local families to help create a garden where younger children could learn about growing food.
senses.exampleChinese: 小学邀请当地家庭一起建花园，让年幼孩子学习种植食物。

senses.english: whether it is raining, sunny, cold, etc., outside
senses.exampleEnglish: The weather improved during the afternoon, allowing us to finish the walk we had abandoned earlier that morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午天气转好，我们得以完成早晨放弃的徒步路线。

senses.english: to gather things/people together in one place
senses.exampleEnglish: Please collect the completed forms after the lesson, so the teacher can check who needs extra help.
senses.exampleChinese: 下课后请收齐填好的表格，以便老师查看谁需要额外帮助。

senses.english: to go to a place and bring someone or something away
senses.exampleEnglish: Please collect the children from school before going to the shop, since their lesson finishes earlier today.
senses.exampleChinese: 今天课结束得早，请先到学校接孩子，再去商店。

senses.english: to give information or facts about something
senses.exampleEnglish: We will inform you of any changes as soon as we receive confirmation from the people organising the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们一收到活动组织者的确认，就会通知你任何变更。

senses.english: strong belief that influences a person's actions; basic law or belief
senses.exampleEnglish: She refused to accept the gift because it went against her principle of treating every customer in the same way.
senses.exampleChinese: 她拒绝收礼，因为这违背了她平等对待每位顾客的原则。

senses.english: a basic rule explaining how something works
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide demonstrated the principle behind the machine before showing us how the same idea appears in modern equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导先演示机器背后的原理，再展示现代设备如何运用相同想法。

senses.english: not having curves, bends, or angles
senses.exampleEnglish: Draw a straight line between the two points, then measure its length using the ruler beside your notebook.
senses.exampleChinese: 在两点间画一条直线，再用笔记本旁的尺子量长度。

senses.english: without turning, stopping or doing something else first
senses.exampleEnglish: Walk straight past the library until you reach the bridge, where the path turns towards the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 径直走过图书馆直到桥边，小路在那里转向河流。

senses.english: honest, direct and easy to understand
senses.exampleEnglish: We needed a straight answer about the cost before deciding whether the project could continue with the money available.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要关于费用的明确答复，才能决定现有资金是否足以继续项目。

senses.english: to request a judge or others change a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: The family plans to appeal against the decision because they believe important evidence was not considered during the hearing.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人计划对裁决提出上诉，因为他们认为听证时忽略了重要证据。

senses.english: the quality that makes something interesting or attractive
senses.exampleEnglish: The town's appeal comes from its quiet streets and small cafés rather than from any single famous attraction.
senses.exampleChinese: 小镇的魅力来自宁静街道和小咖啡馆，而非某个著名景点。

senses.english: to be interesting or attractive to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The course should appeal to adults who want practical speaking practice rather than another series of grammar lectures.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程应能吸引想要实用口语练习、而非又一系列语法讲座的成年人。

senses.english: a formal request for help or for a decision to be changed
senses.exampleEnglish: The family made an appeal after discovering that important documents had not been included in the original application.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现原申请漏掉重要文件后，这家人提出了申诉。

senses.english: more than usual; to a great degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide is highly experienced, which is reassuring when the route passes through areas that are difficult to navigate.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导经验丰富，在经过难以辨路的地区时，这让人安心。

senses.english: (v) to have (n) a belief that someone or something is safe, good, and reliable
senses.exampleEnglish: We trust the guide to choose a suitable route because she knows the local mountains better than anyone.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们信任向导会选择合适路线，因为她最了解当地山地。

senses.english: a belief that someone or something is honest, safe or reliable
senses.exampleEnglish: Her trust in the team grew as people kept their promises and explained problems openly instead of hiding mistakes.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家信守承诺、坦诚说明问题而不掩盖错误，她对团队的信任增加了。

senses.english: money or property managed by someone for the benefit of others
senses.exampleEnglish: The trust uses donations to protect local woodland and provide activities that teach children about the natural environment.
senses.exampleChinese: 信托基金用捐款保护本地林地，并开展活动让孩子了解自然环境。

senses.english: producing feelings of enjoyment or delight
senses.exampleEnglish: The concert was a wonderful experience, especially when the audience joined the final song without any encouragement.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会令人难忘，尤其是观众自发加入最后一首歌的时候。

senses.english: level; even; without curves or bumps
senses.exampleEnglish: Choose a flat surface for the experiment, otherwise the water may spill before you finish taking measurements.
senses.exampleChinese: 实验要选平整表面，否则测量还没完成，水就可能洒出来。

senses.english: a set of rooms for living in within a larger building, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: They rented a small flat near the station so they could reach work without driving through the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们在车站附近租了小公寓，方便不必开车穿城就能上班。

senses.english: not containing enough air, especially used of tyres
senses.exampleEnglish: The bicycle had a flat tyre, so we walked back to the village instead of continuing along the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 自行车轮胎瘪了，所以我们步行回村，没有继续沿海骑行。

senses.english: lacking energy, excitement or expression
senses.exampleEnglish: His voice sounded flat after the long journey, although he was pleased to see everyone waiting at the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途旅行后，他的声音显得没精神，不过看见大家在车站等他仍很高兴。

senses.english: completely; totally; very
senses.exampleEnglish: Make absolutely sure the door is locked before leaving, because nobody will return to the building until Monday.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前务必确认门锁好，因为星期一前没人会回到楼里。

senses.english: to move steadily and easily in a certain direction
senses.exampleEnglish: Water can flow through the narrow channel even after heavy rain, provided that fallen leaves are cleared away.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要清掉落叶，即使大雨后，水也能流过狭窄水道。

senses.english: the steady movement of water, people, information or other things
senses.exampleEnglish: The new entrance improved the flow of visitors, so people no longer had to wait in a narrow corridor.
senses.exampleChinese: 新入口改善了游客流动，人们不再需要挤在狭窄走廊等候。

senses.english: treating all people the same way
senses.exampleEnglish: A fair solution should consider everyone's needs rather than giving the largest group everything it has requested.
senses.exampleChinese: 公平的解决办法应考虑所有人的需求，而非完全满足人数最多的一方。

senses.english: an event where things are shown, sold or enjoyed, often with stalls and entertainments
senses.exampleEnglish: The school fair included games and a book sale, helping the parent group raise money for new sports equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校游园会包含游戏和图书义卖，帮助家长组织筹款买新体育器材。

senses.english: light in colour, especially used of hair or skin
senses.exampleEnglish: The child with fair hair stood beside her sister while their father took a photograph near the garden gate.
senses.exampleChinese: 金发孩子站在姐姐身旁，让父亲在花园门边拍照。

senses.english: acceptable or quite good without being excellent
senses.exampleEnglish: We have a fair chance of finishing today if the remaining materials arrive before the lunch break begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要剩余材料午休前送到，我们今天完成的机会还不错。

senses.english: further or added
senses.exampleEnglish: Additional information will be sent to participants once the organisers have confirmed the final location and starting time.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者确定最终地点和开始时间后，会向参与者发送补充信息。

senses.english: having the duty of dealing with something; being the cause or creator of something; behaving in a mature and reasonable manner
senses.exampleEnglish: Each student is responsible for checking their own work before sharing it with a partner for further suggestions.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个学生都有责任先检查自己的作业，再交给同伴提出建议。

senses.english: being the cause of a particular event or problem
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineer identified the loose cable responsible for the problem before replacing parts that were still working properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师先找出导致问题的松动电缆，避免更换仍正常的零件。

senses.english: behaving sensibly and considering the possible effects of your actions
senses.exampleEnglish: She is a responsible student who checks the equipment carefully before allowing the younger children to use it.
senses.exampleChinese: 她很有责任心，会仔细检查器材后才让小孩子使用。

senses.english: land used for growing crops or raising animals
senses.exampleEnglish: The farm welcomes school groups who want to learn where their food comes from and how vegetables are grown.
senses.exampleChinese: 农场欢迎学校团体，了解食物来源以及蔬菜的种植方式。

senses.english: to grow crops or keep animals to produce food or other products
senses.exampleEnglish: The family has farmed this land for generations, although they now use different methods to protect the soil.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个家庭几代人在这片土地务农，如今改用不同方法保护土壤。

senses.english: group of similar things gathered as a hobby
senses.exampleEnglish: Her collection of old maps helped us understand how much the city had changed over the last century.
senses.exampleChinese: 她收藏的旧地图帮助我们了解这座城市百年来的巨大变化。

senses.english: the act of gathering or fetching things
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity arranged a collection of old clothes so local families could donate items they no longer needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 慈善机构组织旧衣收集，让当地家庭捐出不再需要的衣物。

senses.english: to attach a picture, photograph, etc., onto a wall
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to hang the picture above the fireplace, where visitors could see it as soon as they entered.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定把画挂在壁炉上方，让来访者一进门就能看见。

senses.english: to fasten something so that its lower part is free
senses.exampleEnglish: We will hang the photographs along the corridor so that visitors can follow the story while walking towards the main hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们将把照片挂在走廊，让游客走向大厅时沿途了解故事。

senses.english: to wait, continue holding on, or spend time without a fixed activity
senses.exampleEnglish: Hang on a moment while I check whether the room is available before you invite the rest of the group.
senses.exampleChinese: 请稍等，我先确认房间可用，再请你邀请团队其他人。

senses.english: being harmful, unwanted, or unhelpful
senses.exampleEnglish: The report described the negative effects of noise on residents who lived close to the main road.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告描述了噪声对住在主干道附近居民的不良影响。

senses.english: showing that something being tested for was not found
senses.exampleEnglish: The test result was negative, but the clinic asked her to return if the problem did not improve.
senses.exampleChinese: 检测结果为阴性，不过诊所让她在情况未改善时复诊。

senses.english: less than zero
senses.exampleEnglish: The temperature became negative overnight, which explains why water in the garden had turned to ice by morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 夜间气温降到零下，因此花园里的水到早晨结了冰。

senses.english: expressing no or saying that something is not true
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to turn the statement into a negative sentence without changing the time it referred to.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们把陈述句改成否定句，同时保持所指时间不变。

senses.english: a disadvantage or bad feature of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We discussed the positives and negatives of the proposal before deciding which changes would make it easier to accept.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定怎样修改才更易接受前，我们讨论了提案的优缺点。

senses.english: group of people who work together (e.g., play music)
senses.exampleEnglish: The band played several new songs before returning to the older music that most of the audience knew.
senses.exampleChinese: 乐队先演奏几首新歌，再演奏大部分观众熟悉的老歌。

senses.english: a narrow strip or ring of material
senses.exampleEnglish: A bright band around each bag made it easier to recognise our luggage when it arrived on the moving belt.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个包上鲜亮的带子，让我们更容易从传送带上认出行李。

senses.english: a range of numbers, ages or values within a larger system
senses.exampleEnglish: Students in the same age band worked together, although the teacher adjusted each task to match their different abilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 同年龄段学生一起学习，不过老师按不同能力调整任务。

senses.english: measured or considered in comparison to something else
