senses.exampleEnglish: The relative importance of each factor changes depending on whether the journey is made for work or pleasure.
senses.exampleChinese: 各因素的相对重要性，会随旅行是出差还是休闲而变化。

senses.english: a member of your family
senses.exampleEnglish: We invited a relative who knows the area well to help us choose a suitable place for the reunion.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们请熟悉当地的一位亲戚帮忙选择适合聚会的地点。

senses.english: a journey to visit several places for pleasure
senses.exampleEnglish: The tour includes a visit to the old harbour, where many of the original warehouses are still standing.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次游览包含旧港口，那里许多原来的仓库至今仍在。

senses.english: to travel around a place or several places, often to visit or perform
senses.exampleEnglish: The group will tour the region for two weeks, performing in small towns as well as the larger cities.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个团体将在该地区巡演两周，既去小镇，也去大城市。

senses.english: other choices
senses.exampleEnglish: Cycling is a useful alternative to driving, especially when the roads become crowded during the morning rush hour.
senses.exampleChinese: 骑车是开车之外的实用选择，尤其是在早高峰道路拥堵时。

senses.english: available as another possible choice
senses.exampleEnglish: We need an alternative route because the bridge will remain closed until the repairs are finished next week.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥要到下周修完才开，所以我们需要另一条路线。

senses.english: programs and instructions used by a computer
senses.exampleEnglish: The software automatically saves your work, so an unexpected interruption does not necessarily mean losing everything you have written.
senses.exampleChinese: 软件会自动保存，因此意外中断不一定会丢失你写的所有内容。

senses.english: two of the same thing (e.g., socks)
senses.exampleEnglish: She packed a spare pair of shoes in case the ones she wore became wet during the walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 她带了一双备用鞋，以防脚上的鞋在徒步时弄湿。

senses.english: to put two people or things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher will pair each beginner with an experienced learner so they can support one another during the activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师将每位初学者与有经验者配对，方便活动中相互支持。

senses.english: large boat
senses.exampleEnglish: The ship reached the harbour later than expected because strong winds had slowed its journey along the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 强风延缓了沿海航行，轮船比预计更晚到港。

senses.english: to send goods to another place, by ship or another form of transport
senses.exampleEnglish: The company will ship the parts tomorrow, provided that the final checks are completed before the warehouse closes.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要仓库关门前完成最后检查，公司明天就会发出零件。

senses.english: way you act, think, and feel about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her positive attitude encouraged the rest of the team when the project became more difficult than they had expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目难度超出预期时，她积极的态度鼓舞了其他队员。

senses.english: not costing a lot of money
senses.exampleEnglish: The tickets were surprisingly cheap because we booked early and agreed to travel outside the busiest hours.
senses.exampleChinese: 票价出奇地便宜，因为我们提前预订并避开了最繁忙时段。

senses.english: two times the amount or degree; twice
senses.exampleEnglish: The new room is double the size of our old office, so everyone has more space to work comfortably.
senses.exampleChinese: 新房间的面积是旧办公室的两倍，大家都有更宽敞舒适的工作空间。

senses.english: to become twice as much or make something twice as much
senses.exampleEnglish: We may need to double the number of chairs because more families have registered than we originally expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 报名家庭超过原预期，我们可能需要把椅子数量加倍。

senses.english: made for two people or consisting of two parts
senses.exampleEnglish: They booked a double room near the station so both of them could get to the early train easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们预订了车站附近的双人房，方便两人搭早班火车。

senses.english: twice a particular quantity or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The larger box holds double what the smaller one does, but it is much harder for one person to carry.
senses.exampleChinese: 大箱容量是小箱两倍，但一个人搬运困难得多。

senses.english: part of the body from the thigh down
senses.exampleEnglish: After a long day of walking, he stretched each leg carefully before sitting down to rest near the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 走了一整天后，他小心伸展双腿，才在入口附近坐下休息。

senses.english: one of the supports of a table, chair or similar object
senses.exampleEnglish: One leg of the chair had become loose, so we put it aside until someone could repair it safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 椅子一条腿松了，于是我们先放到一旁，等人安全修好。

senses.english: one part of a journey or competition with several stages
senses.exampleEnglish: The final leg of our journey took us through the mountains before we reached the village beside the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一段旅程穿过群山，才到湖边村庄。

senses.english: to watch carefully; to make a comment
senses.exampleEnglish: Students were asked to observe the plants carefully and record any changes that appeared during the following week.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生要仔细观察植物，并记录接下来一周出现的变化。

senses.english: to follow a rule, custom or official instruction
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors are asked to observe the rules so the historic building remains safe and pleasant for everyone using it.
senses.exampleChinese: 请游客遵守规定，让历史建筑对所有使用者都安全宜人。

senses.english: to say something that you have noticed
senses.exampleEnglish: She observed that the instructions were clearer in the newer version, although the pictures had not changed at all.
senses.exampleChinese: 她指出新版说明更清楚，虽然图片一点没变。

senses.english: set of spoken or written words that make a whole statement
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to write a sentence that explains the idea clearly without using any of the words from the original text.
senses.exampleChinese: 试着不使用原文中的词，写一句清楚解释这个观点的话。

senses.english: to state officially what punishment a person found guilty will receive
senses.exampleEnglish: The court will sentence the person after considering the evidence and the effect of the crime on others.
senses.exampleChinese: 法院考虑证据及犯罪对他人的影响后，会对该人判刑。

senses.english: to make many copies of a page, magazine, or book
senses.exampleEnglish: Please print a copy of the map, since we may not be able to use our phones in the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 请打印一份地图，因为进了山谷后我们可能无法使用手机。

senses.english: a picture or design produced by printing
senses.exampleEnglish: She bought a print of the painting because the original was far too expensive for her small flat.
senses.exampleChinese: 她买了这幅画的印刷品，因为原作对她的小公寓来说太昂贵。

senses.english: to move forward or toward a place or goal
senses.exampleEnglish: Students progress at different speeds, so the teacher provides extra practice rather than expecting everyone to finish together.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生进步速度不同，因此老师提供额外练习，而非要求同时完成。

senses.english: development towards a better or more complete state
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher noticed clear progress after students began reviewing regularly instead of trying to remember everything in one evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生开始定期复习、不再一晚突击后，老师看到了明显进步。

senses.english: real facts about something
senses.exampleEnglish: We wanted to know the truth about the delay before deciding whether to change our travel plans.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们想先弄清延误的真相，再决定是否调整旅行计划。

senses.english: no person; no one; not any person
senses.exampleEnglish: Nobody noticed that the window was open until a sudden gust of wind scattered the papers across the floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到一阵风把纸吹散到地板上，大家才发现窗户开着。

senses.english: to look at someone or something very carefully in order to learn more
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineer will examine the bridge carefully before deciding whether it is safe to open to traffic again.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师会先仔细检查桥梁，再决定是否能安全恢复通车。

senses.english: to put or set something down in a flat position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please lay the clean towels on the bed before the guests arrive, so they can find everything easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人到达前请把干净毛巾平放在床上，方便他们找到用品。

senses.english: to produce eggs from the body
senses.exampleEnglish: The hens lay fewer eggs during winter, so the family buys extra supplies when the days become shorter.
senses.exampleChinese: 冬季母鸡下蛋减少，因此白天变短时这家人会多买些备用。

senses.english: not professionally trained in a particular subject or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The booklet explains the research for lay readers who are interested in science but have no specialist training.
senses.exampleChinese: 小册子为对科学感兴趣、却没受过专业训练的普通读者解释研究。

senses.english: quality of being fast or quick
senses.exampleEnglish: We reduced our speed as we approached the village because children were playing close to the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 靠近村庄时我们减速了，因为孩子们正在路边玩耍。

senses.english: to move quickly or drive faster than is allowed
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver was asked not to speed through the village because children often crossed the road near the school.
senses.exampleChinese: 司机被提醒不要在村里超速，因为孩子常在学校附近过马路。

senses.english: activities influencing the policies of a government
senses.exampleEnglish: She became interested in politics after learning how decisions made by the council affected services in her neighbourhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 了解市议会的决定如何影响社区服务后，她开始关注政治。

senses.english: answer someone's question
senses.exampleEnglish: His reply arrived just before lunch and included the information we needed to complete the booking form.
senses.exampleChinese: 他的回复在午饭前送达，包含了完成预订表所需的信息。

senses.english: to answer something that someone says, writes or asks
senses.exampleEnglish: Please reply before Friday so the organisers know how many meals they need to prepare for the visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在星期五前回复，让组织者知道要为访客准备多少餐食。

senses.english: to put so they can be seen or be bought
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum will display the photographs beside old maps, helping visitors understand how the town developed over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆将把照片与旧地图一起展出，帮助游客了解城镇发展。

senses.english: an arrangement of things intended for people to look at
senses.exampleEnglish: The display includes photographs and letters that explain how ordinary families lived in the village a century ago.
senses.exampleChinese: 展品包括照片和信件，介绍一个世纪前普通家庭在村里的生活。

senses.english: an occasion when someone clearly shows a quality, feeling or skill
senses.exampleEnglish: The audience admired the team's display of skill, especially during the final part when everyone moved together perfectly.
senses.exampleChinese: 观众欣赏团队展现的技巧，尤其是最后大家完美配合的部分。

senses.english: to move something from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to transfer the files to another computer before the old machine is taken away for repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧电脑送修之前，我们需要把文件转移到另一台电脑上。

senses.english: the act of moving someone or something from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The transfer of files took longer than expected because several videos were much larger than the other documents.
senses.exampleChinese: 文件传输比预期久，因为几段视频比其他文件大得多。

senses.english: so good it/they cannot be improved
senses.exampleEnglish: The weather was perfect for walking, with enough sunshine to feel pleasant and a breeze to keep us cool.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气非常适合徒步，阳光温暖宜人，微风带来凉爽。

senses.english: to improve something until it is as good as possible
senses.exampleEnglish: She spent several weeks trying to perfect the design before showing it to people outside the research team.
senses.exampleChinese: 她花了几周完善设计，之后才展示给研究团队以外的人。

senses.english: concerning a small quantity or degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The room was slightly smaller than we expected, but its large windows made it feel bright and welcoming.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间比预期略小，但大窗户让它显得明亮舒适。

senses.english: viewed as a whole; in general, not as details
senses.exampleEnglish: The overall result was encouraging, although several small problems still needed attention before the project could continue.
senses.exampleChinese: 总体结果令人鼓舞，不过项目继续前仍需处理几个小问题。

senses.english: considering everything together rather than individual details
senses.exampleEnglish: Overall, the trip was successful, although a few families said they would have liked more time at the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 总的来说旅行成功，不过几家人说希望在博物馆多待一会儿。

senses.english: to plan or want to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We intend to finish the repairs before winter, provided that the materials arrive within the next few weeks.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要材料在接下来几周内到达，我们打算在冬天前修好。

senses.english: person that uses a service or thing (e.g., a website)
senses.exampleEnglish: Each user can choose a different layout, so the program feels suitable for both beginners and experienced staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位用户都能选择不同布局，让程序同时适合初学者和熟练员工。

senses.english: to say or write to answer the question
senses.exampleEnglish: Please respond to the invitation by Friday, so the organisers know how many places they need to prepare.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在星期五前回复邀请，方便组织者确定需要准备多少座位。

senses.english: to react to something rather than necessarily answering in words
senses.exampleEnglish: The plants responded well to the extra light, and new leaves began to appear within a few days.
senses.exampleChinese: 增加光照后植物反应很好，几天内就长出了新叶。

senses.english: main meal of the day, usually in the evening in the us
senses.exampleEnglish: We invited our neighbours to dinner because we wanted an opportunity to talk without rushing between work and school.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们邀请邻居吃晚饭，希望有机会不受上下班接送的匆忙影响，好好聊天。

senses.english: moving or happening without speed; not fast
senses.exampleEnglish: The journey was slow because the road was narrow, but the views across the valley made it enjoyable.
senses.exampleChinese: 道路狭窄使行程缓慢，但山谷美景让旅途很愉快。

senses.english: to become less fast or make something less fast
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to slow the car as we approached the village, where the road became narrow and busy.
senses.exampleChinese: 靠近村庄时道路变窄、人车增多，我们得放慢车速。

senses.english: occurring or being done frequently
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular practice helped her become more confident, even though she could only study for a short time each evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管每晚只能学一小会儿，规律练习仍让她更有信心。

senses.english: normal or standard rather than special
senses.exampleEnglish: I ordered a regular coffee rather than the larger size because we had little time before the train left.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车快开了，我们时间不多，所以我点了普通杯咖啡而非大杯。

senses.english: concerning the body of a person
senses.exampleEnglish: The course combines physical exercise with teamwork, encouraging participants to communicate while they complete each activity together.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程结合体育锻炼与团队合作，鼓励参与者共同完成活动时沟通。

senses.english: real and able to be touched rather than only existing as an idea or digitally
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum keeps physical copies of the letters as well as digital images that visitors can read online.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆既保存信件的实体副本，也提供游客在线阅读的数字图片。

senses.english: separated by an amount of time or space
senses.exampleEnglish: The two villages are several kilometres apart, although a regular bus service makes it easy to travel between them.
senses.exampleChinese: 两村相距数公里，但定期公交让往返很方便。

senses.english: to be appropriate for a given situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The new timetable should suit people who work during the day, since most classes now begin in the evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 新课表应该适合白天工作的人，因为大多数课现在都在晚上开始。

senses.english: a jacket and matching trousers or skirt worn together
senses.exampleEnglish: He wore his best suit for the interview, although the company normally allowed staff to dress more casually.
senses.exampleChinese: 他面试时穿了最好的西装，虽然公司平时允许员工穿得更随意。

senses.english: a legal action brought by one person or organisation against another
senses.exampleEnglish: The company faced a suit after customers claimed that the product had not performed as the advertisement promised.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾客声称产品效果不符合广告承诺后，公司遭到诉讼。

senses.english: system of government
senses.exampleEnglish: The federal government announced a programme that would help smaller communities improve their roads and public transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 联邦政府宣布了一项计划，帮助小型社区改善道路和公共交通。

senses.english: to make known, to show or prove
senses.exampleEnglish: The old photographs reveal how much the harbour has changed since the town became a popular holiday destination.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧照片展示了自城镇成为热门度假地后，港口发生的巨大变化。

senses.english: part of a whole divided into hundredths
senses.exampleEnglish: The percentage of students walking to school increased after a safer crossing was built near the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 主入口附近建了更安全的过街设施后，步行上学的学生比例增加了。

senses.english: time when there is no war or fighting
senses.exampleEnglish: After years of disagreement, people hoped the new agreement would bring lasting peace to both sides of the border.
senses.exampleChinese: 多年争端后，人们希望新协议为边境双方带来持久和平。

senses.english: a state of being quiet, calm and free from disturbance
senses.exampleEnglish: We enjoyed the peace of the garden after spending most of the afternoon in the busy city centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午大部分时间在繁忙市中心度过后，我们享受花园的宁静。

senses.english: position or rank relative to others in a society
senses.exampleEnglish: Her status within the organisation improved after she successfully led a project that other managers had considered too difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 她成功领导了其他经理认为太难的项目后，组织内的地位提高了。

senses.english: the present condition or situation of something
senses.exampleEnglish: You can check the status of your application online rather than calling the office every few days.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以在线查看申请状态，不用每隔几天打电话给办公室。

senses.english: act that is against the law; murder, theft, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The community organised a meeting to discuss how better lighting might reduce crime around the station after dark.
senses.exampleChinese: 社区开会讨论如何通过改善照明，减少车站周围夜间犯罪。

senses.english: to not accept an invitation or offer; refuse
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to decline the invitation politely because she had already promised to help at another event.
senses.exampleChinese: 她决定礼貌谢绝邀请，因为已经答应去另一项活动帮忙。

senses.english: to become less in amount, strength or quality
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitor numbers began to decline after the bus service stopped, especially among families without access to a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 公交停运后游客开始减少，尤其是没有汽车的家庭。

senses.english: a reduction in amount, strength or quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The report describes a decline in sales but suggests that improving customer service could help the business recover.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告指出销量下降，但建议改善顾客服务可帮助业务恢复。

senses.english: period of 10 years
senses.exampleEnglish: Over the past decade, the town has built several cycle paths that connect its residential areas with the centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 过去十年里，这座城镇建了几条连接住宅区与中心的自行车道。

senses.english: to put a rocket into the air; put a ship into the water
senses.exampleEnglish: The team will launch the research rocket tomorrow if the final safety checks are completed and the weather remains clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果最终安全检查完成且天气晴好，团队明天将发射科研火箭。

senses.english: to begin something new or make a product available for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: The library plans to launch a reading programme that gives families practical ways to enjoy books together at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆计划推出阅读项目，提供家庭在家共同读书的实用方法。

senses.english: the beginning of a new project, product or service
senses.exampleEnglish: The launch attracted local families who wanted to see how the new app could support children's reading practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 发布活动吸引了想了解新应用如何支持儿童阅读练习的当地家庭。

senses.english: to tell someone about possible danger
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide stopped to warn us about loose stones before we began walking down the steep mountain path.
senses.exampleChinese: 下陡峭山路前，向导停下来提醒我们小心松动的石头。

senses.english: person who uses goods or services; individual buyer
senses.exampleEnglish: Each consumer should be able to understand the total price before agreeing to buy a product or service.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位消费者在同意购买商品或服务前，都应能了解总价。

senses.english: helpful act of kindness
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you do me a favor and collect the parcel if it arrives while I am at work?
senses.exampleChinese: 如果包裹在我上班时送到，你能帮我收一下吗？

senses.english: approval of or support for someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Most residents expressed their favor for the plan, provided that the new building would not block the footpath.
senses.exampleChinese: 多数居民表示赞成计划，条件是新建筑不能挡住步道。

senses.english: to prefer one person, thing or course of action over another
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee tends to favor proposals that benefit local families without requiring expensive changes to existing buildings.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会倾向于支持让当地家庭受益、又不需昂贵改造现有建筑的方案。

senses.english: without water; not wet
senses.exampleEnglish: Make sure the paint is completely dry before putting the shelves back, otherwise the surface may be damaged.
senses.exampleChinese: 重新装上架子前，要确保油漆全干，否则表面可能受损。

senses.english: to make something no longer wet or become no longer wet
senses.exampleEnglish: Please dry the equipment carefully before putting it away, since water left inside could damage the smaller parts.
senses.exampleChinese: 收起设备前请仔细擦干，因为内部残水可能损坏小零件。

senses.english: not interesting or enjoyable, often because there are too many facts
senses.exampleEnglish: The topic could seem dry, but the teacher made it interesting by connecting the facts with real situations.
senses.exampleChinese: 话题可能显得枯燥，但老师把事实联系真实情境，让它有趣起来。

senses.english: someone you have a business or personal relationship with
senses.exampleEnglish: She discussed the new contract with her business partner before deciding whether the company could afford the extra staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先与商业伙伴讨论新合同，再决定公司能否承担增加员工的费用。

senses.english: to work with someone or put people together for an activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum will partner with local schools to create activities that connect classroom lessons with the new exhibition.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆将与当地学校合作，设计把课堂与新展览联系起来的活动。

senses.english: organization created for a particular cause or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The institution provides training for adults who want to return to education after several years away from the classroom.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家机构为离开课堂多年后希望重返教育的成年人提供培训。

senses.english: a long-established practice or system important in society
senses.exampleEnglish: The article examines marriage as an institution and explains how family expectations have changed over several generations.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章把婚姻视为社会制度，解释家庭期望如何在几代人中变化。

senses.english: a particular area that is different from the area around it; (v) to see someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: We found a quiet spot beside the river where we could eat lunch without disturbing the people fishing nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在河边找到安静的地方吃午饭，不会打扰附近钓鱼的人。

senses.english: a small round mark or an area that looks different from its surroundings
senses.exampleEnglish: She noticed a dark spot on the tablecloth just before the guests arrived, so she changed it quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 客人到达前她发现桌布上有个黑点，于是赶紧换了。

senses.english: to see or notice something, especially when it is not easy to find
senses.exampleEnglish: We finally spotted the missing sign behind a tree, which explained why so many walkers had taken the wrong path.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们终于在树后发现了丢失的路牌，难怪许多徒步者走错了路。

senses.english: large animal with 4 legs used for riding
senses.exampleEnglish: The horse remained calm while the instructor showed us how to approach it without making sudden movements.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练教我们如何缓缓靠近时，马一直很平静。

senses.english: finally
senses.exampleEnglish: After trying several different methods, we eventually found a solution that worked without requiring any additional equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 尝试几种方法后，我们终于找到了无需额外设备就能奏效的办法。

senses.english: to make hot or hotter
senses.exampleEnglish: Heat the soup gently while stirring, so it becomes warm throughout without sticking to the bottom of the pan.
senses.exampleChinese: 一边搅拌一边轻轻加热汤，让它均匀变热而不粘锅底。

senses.english: warmth or a high temperature, or the energy that produces it
senses.exampleEnglish: The heat made the room uncomfortable, so we moved the meeting to a shaded area outside the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 室内高温让人不舒服，因此我们把会议移到楼外阴凉处。

senses.english: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager
senses.exampleEnglish: The chance to work with real scientists can excite students who have only studied the subject in textbooks.
senses.exampleChinese: 与真正科学家合作的机会，能让只在课本里学过这门课的学生兴奋。

senses.english: person who reads written or printed materials
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer gives the reader enough information to understand the problem without revealing how the story will end.
senses.exampleChinese: 作者给读者足够的信息理解问题，却不透露故事结局。

senses.english: an electronic device used to read books or stored information
senses.exampleEnglish: She takes an electronic reader when travelling because it holds many books without adding much weight to her bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 她旅行时带电子阅读器，因为它能存很多书，又不会明显增加行李重量。

senses.english: being important; having a big effect on
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained the importance of checking sources before students began researching their projects on the internet.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生开始上网研究课题前，老师解释了核查来源的重要性。

senses.english: amount of space between two things
senses.exampleEnglish: We underestimated the distance between the two villages, so the walk took much longer than we had planned.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们低估了两村的距离，所以步行时间远超原计划。

senses.english: to show that you are not closely connected with someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisation tried to distance itself from the comments because they did not reflect the views of its members.
senses.exampleChinese: 该组织试图与这些言论划清界限，因为它们不代表成员的看法。

senses.english: to lead people visiting a new or unknown place
senses.exampleEnglish: A local volunteer will guide us through the old neighbourhood and explain how its buildings have changed over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地志愿者会带我们走过老街区，讲解建筑随时间发生的变化。

senses.english: a person who shows visitors around a place or helps others understand something
senses.exampleEnglish: Our guide knew a quieter path to the lake, so we avoided the crowds near the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导知道一条通向湖边的安静小路，让我们避开主入口附近的人群。

senses.english: a book or set of information explaining a place or how to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide includes clear maps and practical advice for families who want to explore the region without a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 指南包含清晰地图及实用建议，供想不驾车游览该地区的家庭使用。

senses.english: to give or let someone do what they want
senses.exampleEnglish: The council agreed to grant permission for the event, provided that the organisers kept the noise within reasonable limits.
senses.exampleChinese: 市议会同意批准活动，条件是组织者把噪声控制在合理范围内。

senses.english: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The school received a grant to improve the playground, provided that local families helped decide how it would be used.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校获得改善游乐场的补助，条件是让当地家庭参与决定用途。

senses.english: car that transports people for money
senses.exampleEnglish: We booked a taxi for the early flight because no buses would reach the airport before our departure.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为早班飞机预约出租车，因为起飞前没有公交车能到机场。

senses.english: to give food (e.g., to an animal or a baby)
senses.exampleEnglish: Please feed the cat before leaving, and check that there is enough fresh water in the bowl.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前请喂猫，并检查碗里是否有足够的新鲜水。

senses.english: to supply information or material to a machine or process
senses.exampleEnglish: The scanner feeds information into the computer, where the program checks the details against the records already stored.
senses.exampleChinese: 扫描仪把信息输入电脑，程序再与已存记录核对。

senses.english: food given to animals
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer stored the feed in a dry building so it would stay usable throughout the wet winter months.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民把饲料存放在干燥建筑里，保证整个潮湿冬季都能使用。

senses.english: a regularly updated list of online posts, news or other information
senses.exampleEnglish: Her news feed includes local events and science stories, but she checks the sources before sharing anything with friends.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的信息流包含本地活动和科学故事，但分享前会先核查来源。

senses.english: strong feeling of hurt or discomfort
senses.exampleEnglish: The pain in his shoulder gradually eased, allowing him to carry a small bag without feeling uncomfortable.
senses.exampleChinese: 肩膀的疼痛逐渐减轻，他能提小包而不觉得难受了。

senses.english: area that includes certain kinds of job
senses.exampleEnglish: The tourism sector provides many local jobs, although employment tends to fall when the summer season ends.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅游业为当地提供很多岗位，但夏季结束时就业通常减少。

senses.english: something done wrong, calculated wrong.; error
senses.exampleEnglish: She noticed a mistake in the address just before sending the package, which prevented a much longer delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 她寄包裹前发现地址有误，从而避免了更长时间的耽搁。

senses.english: to believe wrongly that one person or thing is another
senses.exampleEnglish: I mistook the side entrance for the main door because the signs were difficult to read in the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 雨中标牌难以辨认，我把侧门误认为正门。

senses.english: to make something sure, certain, or safe
senses.exampleEnglish: Please check the list carefully to ensure that every participant receives the information before the meeting begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 请仔细核对名单，确保每位参与者会前都收到信息。

senses.english: to be happy because you met your expectation
senses.exampleEnglish: The new design should satisfy customers who want a lighter bag without giving up the space they need.
senses.exampleChinese: 新设计应能满足希望包更轻、又不愿减少容量的顾客。

senses.english: to meet a need, rule or condition
senses.exampleEnglish: The design must satisfy the safety requirements before the council can allow the playground to open to local children.
senses.exampleChinese: 设计必须符合安全要求，市议会才能允许游乐场向当地孩子开放。

senses.english: most important one
senses.exampleEnglish: Our chief concern was whether the children would have a safe place to wait until their parents arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们最关心的是孩子们能否在安全的地方等父母来。

senses.english: the person in charge of a group or organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The police chief explained the new arrangements before inviting residents to ask questions about safety in the town centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 警察局长先解释新安排，再请居民询问镇中心的安全问题。

senses.english: almost cold; not warm or hot
senses.exampleEnglish: The air felt cool after sunset, so we put on our jackets before continuing along the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 日落后空气有些凉，我们穿上外套才继续沿河走。

senses.english: calm and able to think clearly in a difficult situation
senses.exampleEnglish: She stayed cool when the equipment failed and quickly found another way to show the audience her work.
senses.exampleChinese: 设备故障时她保持冷静，很快找到了向观众展示作品的其他方法。

senses.english: fashionable, attractive or very good in an informal way
senses.exampleEnglish: The children thought the new bicycle looked cool, but their parents were more interested in its brakes and lights.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们觉得新自行车很酷，但父母更关心刹车和车灯。

senses.english: to become less hot or make something less hot
senses.exampleEnglish: Leave the soup to cool before serving it, especially if the children are too hungry to wait patiently.
senses.exampleChinese: 先让汤放凉再上桌，尤其是孩子们饿得无法耐心等待时。

senses.english: skillful person with special knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: We asked an expert to examine the painting because its age and possible value were difficult to judge.
senses.exampleChinese: 画的年代和可能价值很难判断，因此我们请专家检查。

senses.english: having a high level of skill or knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: With expert help, we repaired the old chair without damaging the wood that had become weaker over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 在专家帮助下，我们修好了旧椅子，没有损伤日渐脆弱的木头。

senses.english: to move your hand or arm to say hello or goodbye
senses.exampleEnglish: She turned to wave at her friends before the train moved slowly away from the crowded platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车缓缓驶离拥挤站台前，她转身向朋友们挥手。

senses.english: a raised moving part of the surface of water
senses.exampleEnglish: The waves became larger as the wind increased, so we stayed on the beach instead of hiring a boat.
senses.exampleChinese: 风力增强时海浪变大，于是我们待在沙滩上，没有租船。

senses.english: a sudden increase in a feeling, activity or number of events
senses.exampleEnglish: A wave of interest followed the announcement, and the library soon had more volunteers than it could train.
senses.exampleChinese: 公告后掀起了兴趣热潮，图书馆很快连培训志愿者都来不及了。

senses.english: a movement of the hand used to greet someone or say goodbye
senses.exampleEnglish: She gave us a final wave from the train window just before it moved away from the platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车驶离站台前，她从车窗向我们最后挥手道别。

senses.english: direction to your right when facing the rising sun; opposite of north
senses.exampleEnglish: The south of the country attracts many visitors, especially when the warmer weather makes its beaches pleasant in spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个国家的南部吸引许多游客，尤其是在春季天气转暖、海滩宜人时。

senses.english: towards or in the direction of the south
senses.exampleEnglish: We drove south for another hour before finding a village with somewhere to eat and a place to stay.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们又往南开了一小时，才找到有地方吃饭住宿的村庄。

senses.english: in, facing or relating to the south
senses.exampleEnglish: The south side of the building receives more sunlight, so the gardener planted the vegetables near that wall.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑南侧阳光更足，园丁便把蔬菜种在那面墙附近。

senses.english: to work hard (often physically) for many hours
senses.exampleEnglish: Workers had to labor for hours in the heat before the damaged road was finally safe to use again.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人们在炎热中辛苦劳作数小时，受损道路才终于恢复安全。

senses.english: work, especially physical work, or the people available to do it
senses.exampleEnglish: The repairs required considerable labor, so volunteers shared the heavier tasks and took regular breaks during the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 维修需要很多体力劳动，所以志愿者分担重活，并定时休息。

senses.english: the process in which a woman gives birth to a baby
senses.exampleEnglish: The hospital offers classes explaining labor so parents know what support is available when the baby is ready to arrive.
senses.exampleChinese: 医院开课讲解分娩，让父母知道临产时有哪些支持。

senses.english: of the top layer; superficial
senses.exampleEnglish: The first inspection found only surface damage, but a specialist still needed to check the machine's internal parts.
senses.exampleChinese: 初次检查仅发现表面损伤，但仍需专家检查机器内部零件。

senses.english: the outside or top layer of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The surface of the table felt rough, so we covered it before laying out the delicate pieces of glass.
senses.exampleChinese: 桌面摸起来粗糙，所以摆放精细玻璃片前我们先铺上了东西。

senses.english: to rise to the top of water or become visible after being hidden
senses.exampleEnglish: New details began to surface after the team compared the old photographs with records kept by local families.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队将旧照片与当地家庭保存的记录对照后，新细节开始显现。

senses.english: place where books and other media are kept
senses.exampleEnglish: The library stays open late during the week so people can borrow books after finishing work or school.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆平日开放到很晚，方便人们下班或放学后借书。

senses.english: extremely good
senses.exampleEnglish: The course received excellent reviews because the instructors explained difficult ideas clearly and gave everyone useful feedback.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程评价极佳，因为教师讲解清楚，并给每人有用的反馈。

senses.english: boundary of a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: We stayed away from the edge of the path because the ground had become slippery after the rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 雨后地面湿滑，所以我们远离小路边缘。

senses.english: a small advantage over someone or something else
senses.exampleEnglish: Her knowledge of the local area gave the team an edge when they had to choose a safer route.
senses.exampleChinese: 需要选择更安全的路线时，她对当地的了解给团队带来了优势。

senses.english: to move slowly and carefully, often by a small amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver edged the car forward until there was enough space for the bus to pass behind him.
senses.exampleChinese: 司机慢慢把车往前挪，直到后方留出足够空间让公交车通过。

senses.english: place where people live for a short time in tents
senses.exampleEnglish: We reached the camp before sunset, leaving enough time to put up our tents and prepare a simple meal.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们日落前到达营地，有足够时间搭帐篷并准备简餐。

senses.english: to stay in a tent for a short time
senses.exampleEnglish: We plan to camp near the lake, provided that the weather remains calm and the site has space.
senses.exampleChinese: 只要天气平静且营地有空位，我们就打算在湖边露营。

senses.english: a group of people with the same opinions on a particular issue
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion divided residents into two camps, although both groups agreed that the park needed better facilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论使居民分成两派，不过双方都同意公园需要更好的设施。

senses.english: group of people listening, watch a play, movie, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker paused to let the audience consider the question before asking for suggestions from people near the front.
senses.exampleChinese: 演讲者停下来让听众思考问题，再请前排观众提出建议。

senses.english: to move something to higher position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please lift the box from both sides, since the bottom is weak and might break if you pull it.
senses.exampleChinese: 请从两边抬箱子，因为底部不牢，拉扯时可能破裂。

senses.english: a machine that carries people between floors of a building, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: The lift was out of order, so staff helped visitors carry their bags up the stairs to reception.
senses.exampleChinese: 电梯坏了，工作人员帮访客提行李上楼到前台。

senses.english: a journey in someone's vehicle, often without payment
senses.exampleEnglish: Our neighbour gave us a lift to the station because the early bus did not run on Sundays.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居顺路送我们去车站，因为星期天没有早班公交。

senses.english: to remove an official restriction or ban
senses.exampleEnglish: The council will lift the restriction once engineers confirm that the bridge can safely carry heavier vehicles again.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师确认桥梁能再次安全承载重车后，市议会会解除限制。

senses.english: to make someone's mood better
senses.exampleEnglish: Seeing the finished garden lifted everyone's spirits after several weeks of hard work in cold and wet weather.
senses.exampleChinese: 在寒冷潮湿的天气中辛苦数周后，看到完工花园让大家精神振奋。

senses.english: usual or standard way in which something is done
senses.exampleEnglish: Follow the same procedure each time you use the equipment, even when you feel confident that everything is working.
senses.exampleChinese: 每次使用设备都要遵循同样程序，即使你确信一切正常。

senses.english: a medical treatment or operation carried out in a planned way
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained the procedure beforehand so the child understood what would happen and could ask any questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士提前解释操作过程，让孩子明白将发生什么，并能提问。

senses.english: a system for sending messages electronically, especially from one computer to another using the internet
senses.exampleEnglish: I sent an e-mail to confirm our booking because the details on the website were not completely clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 我发了封电子邮件确认预订，因为网站上的细节不够清楚。

senses.english: to send a message by electronic mail
senses.exampleEnglish: Please e-mail the final schedule to everyone before Friday so they can arrange transport and confirm their attendance.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在星期五前把最终日程发邮件给大家，方便安排交通并确认出席。

senses.english: concerning, affecting, or involving the entire world
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explores global changes in transport and shows how local choices can affect people in other countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览探讨全球交通变化，并展示地方选择如何影响其他国家的人。

senses.english: to try very hard to do something difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: Many students struggle to speak confidently at first, even when they understand most of what their teacher says.
senses.exampleChinese: 许多学生起初很难自信开口，即使能听懂老师的大部分话。

senses.english: a difficult effort to achieve something or deal with a problem
senses.exampleEnglish: Finding enough time to study was a struggle, but she made progress by practising briefly every morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 很难找到足够学习时间，不过她每天早晨短暂练习，仍取得进步。

senses.english: to show how good a product is, to make people buy
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop plans to advertise its new service online so that more people in nearby villages can discover it.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店计划上网宣传新服务，让附近村庄更多人知道。

senses.english: to choose from a group, something most suitable
senses.exampleEnglish: Please select a time that suits your whole group, since the guide cannot change the booking once it is confirmed.
senses.exampleChinese: 请选择适合全组的时间，因为确认后向导无法更改预订。

senses.english: to be on every side of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Tall trees surround the house, keeping the garden cool even when the afternoon sun becomes quite strong.
senses.exampleChinese: 高树环绕房屋，即使午后阳光很强，花园仍很凉爽。

senses.english: range or space included in something
senses.exampleEnglish: We could not understand the full extent of the problem until we spoke to families living near the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 与河边家庭交谈后，我们才理解问题的全部程度。

senses.english: flowing water that runs from mountains to the sea
senses.exampleEnglish: The river passes through several small towns before reaching the coast, where it becomes much wider and deeper.
senses.exampleChinese: 河流经过几个小镇后到达海岸，那里河道宽得多，也深得多。

senses.english: happening once a year, or every year
senses.exampleEnglish: The annual festival brings visitors to the town, giving local artists a chance to display and sell their work.
senses.exampleChinese: 每年的节庆吸引游客来到镇上，让本地艺术家有机会展示和销售作品。

senses.english: completely or entirely
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not fully understand the instructions until the teacher demonstrated the first stage of the experiment.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到老师演示实验第一步，我们才完全理解说明。

senses.english: (v) to show (n) clear and obvious differences between two or more people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The article will contrast city life with village life, showing the advantages and difficulties that each can offer.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章将对比城市和乡村生活，展示各自的优点与困难。

senses.english: a clear difference between people, things or situations
senses.exampleEnglish: The contrast between the old and new photographs showed how much the village had grown during the last century.
senses.exampleChinese: 新旧照片的对比显示，村庄在过去一个世纪扩大了很多。

senses.english: to move along a surface by turning many times
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched the ball roll down the slope until it stopped against a tree at the bottom.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们看球滚下斜坡，直到它在坡底一棵树旁停住。

senses.english: a small piece of bread made for one person
senses.exampleEnglish: She packed a roll and some fruit for the journey because the café at the station might not be open.
senses.exampleChinese: 她为旅程带了小面包和水果，因为车站咖啡馆可能不开门。

senses.english: material such as paper wound around itself into a cylinder
senses.exampleEnglish: We brought a roll of paper so each group could draw a large map of its proposed garden design.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们带了一卷纸，让每组都能画出大幅花园设计图。

senses.english: one movement of turning over or around
senses.exampleEnglish: The dog gave a playful roll on the grass before returning to the children waiting beside the path.
senses.exampleChinese: 狗在草地上顽皮地打了个滚，然后跑回小路旁等着的孩子身边。

senses.english: to make something into a rounded tube or cylinder
senses.exampleEnglish: Roll the poster carefully before putting it in the tube, so its edges will not bend during the journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 把海报放进筒前小心卷起，以免运输时边角弯折。

senses.english: an official list of people's names
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher checked the roll before the bus left to make sure every child was safely on board.
senses.exampleChinese: 公交出发前老师核对名册，确认每个孩子都安全上车。

senses.english: what is true, as opposed to what is imagined
senses.exampleEnglish: The reality of working abroad was more challenging than she expected, although she soon began to enjoy the experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 在国外工作的现实比她预期更难，不过她很快开始享受这段经历。

senses.english: a picture made with a camera that shows how things look in real life
senses.exampleEnglish: The photograph shows the square before the new station was built, when cars could still park beside the fountain.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片展示了新车站建成前的广场，那时汽车还能停在喷泉旁。

senses.english: to take a picture using a camera
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors may photograph the gardens, but they must ask permission before taking pictures of people working in the private areas.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客可以拍花园，但拍摄私人区域工作的人员前必须征得许可。

senses.english: a person who is skilled and creative in art, such as a painter
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist uses objects that people usually throw away to create pictures of places she remembers from childhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位艺术家用人们常丢弃的物品，创作她记忆中童年地方的图画。

senses.english: to have opposite ideas; to disagree; to not match
senses.exampleEnglish: The two accounts conflict with each other, so we need more evidence before deciding what actually happened.
senses.exampleChinese: 两份叙述相互矛盾，所以需要更多证据才能判断实际发生了什么。

senses.english: a serious disagreement or a situation in which things do not fit together
senses.exampleEnglish: The conflict between the two teams eased after they agreed to share information before making major decisions.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个团队同意在重大决策前共享信息后，冲突缓和了。

senses.english: fighting between groups or countries
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how the conflict affected ordinary families rather than focusing only on the decisions of military leaders.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释冲突如何影响普通家庭，而不仅聚焦军事领导人的决定。

senses.english: complete or full; with no part left out; whole
senses.exampleEnglish: The entire village helped prepare for the festival, from decorating the square to arranging places for visitors to stay.
senses.exampleChinese: 全村人都帮忙筹备节庆，从装饰广场到安排游客住宿。

senses.english: fact that someone or something is in a particular place
senses.exampleEnglish: Her presence at the meeting helped the new staff feel comfortable enough to ask questions they had been avoiding.
senses.exampleChinese: 她出席会议，让新员工放松下来，愿意问出一直回避的问题。

senses.english: a strong and noticeable impression made by someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Her confident presence helped the audience relax, even when a technical problem briefly interrupted the beginning of her presentation.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使技术问题短暂打断开场，她自信的气场仍让听众放松。

senses.english: large group of people together in one place
senses.exampleEnglish: A crowd gathered outside the theatre after the show, hoping to catch a glimpse of the main actor.
senses.exampleChinese: 演出结束后，人群聚在剧院外，希望看一眼主角。

senses.english: to fill a space with many people or move together closely
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors began to crowd around the display, so the guide asked some people to step back and make room.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客开始围挤展品，向导便请部分人后退让出空间。

senses.english: place where two or three sides, lines, or roads meet
senses.exampleEnglish: There is a small café on the corner where we usually meet before walking to the evening class together.
senses.exampleChinese: 拐角处有家小咖啡馆，我们通常在那里会合再一起去上夜课。

senses.english: to trap someone where they cannot easily move away or avoid a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The interview did not try to corner the speaker, but asked clear questions about the decision and its consequences.
senses.exampleChinese: 采访没有试图把发言者逼入困境，而是清楚询问决定及其后果。

collocations.chinese: 用问题把某人逼入困境

senses.english: elements in our air, like oxygen or nitrogen
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained that this gas has no colour, so it cannot be identified simply by looking at it.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师解释说这种气体没有颜色，单凭观察无法辨认。

senses.english: petrol used as fuel for vehicles, especially in American English
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped for gas before leaving the town because the map showed few stations along the mountain road.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开城镇前我们停车加油，因为地图显示山路沿途加油站很少。

senses.english: to change in position or direction
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to shift our attention towards the most urgent tasks before spending time on smaller details.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要先把注意力转向紧急任务，再花时间处理细节。

senses.english: a period during which a person or group is at work
senses.exampleEnglish: Her evening shift starts after the children finish school, so the family has arranged for their grandfather to help.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的晚班在孩子放学后开始，因此家里安排祖父来帮忙。

senses.english: a change in position, direction or way of thinking
senses.exampleEnglish: The report describes a shift towards public transport after the new railway line made commuting faster and more reliable.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告指出，新铁路线让通勤更快更可靠后，人们转向公共交通。

senses.english: material made of string, chain, or wire connected together at certain points
senses.exampleEnglish: The gardener placed a net over the young plants to stop birds from eating the seeds before they grew.
senses.exampleChinese: 园丁给幼苗罩上网，防止种子发芽前被鸟吃掉。

senses.english: remaining after costs, taxes or other amounts have been taken away
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop's net profit increased even though sales stayed similar, because the owner found a cheaper delivery service.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然销量相近，店铺净利润仍增加了，因为店主找到了更便宜的配送服务。

senses.english: groups of things that are similar in some way
senses.exampleEnglish: Each book belongs to a different category, making it easier for visitors to find something that matches their interests.
senses.exampleChinese: 每本书按类别归置，方便游客找到符合兴趣的读物。

senses.english: an employee who does general office work for another person in the office
senses.exampleEnglish: The secretary checked everyone's availability before arranging a meeting that would give the manager enough time to discuss the proposal.
senses.exampleChinese: 秘书先确认大家的空闲时间，再安排会议，让经理有充足时间讨论提议。

senses.english: a senior government official in charge of a particular area
senses.exampleEnglish: The education secretary visited the school to hear how teachers were helping families who had recently moved into the area.
senses.exampleChinese: 教育部长访问学校，了解老师如何帮助新搬来当地的家庭。

senses.english: process of protecting something from attack
senses.exampleEnglish: The castle's walls were built for defense, although today visitors admire them mainly for their size and history.
senses.exampleChinese: 城墙原为防御而建，如今游客主要欣赏其规模与历史。

senses.english: the arguments or people used to show that someone accused of a crime is not guilty
senses.exampleEnglish: The defense asked the court to examine the records again before deciding whether the witness had identified the right person.
senses.exampleChinese: 辩方请法院重新检查记录，再判断证人是否认对了人。

senses.english: the players or methods used to stop an opponent scoring
senses.exampleEnglish: The team's defense improved after the coach showed the players how to communicate when the other side moved forward.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练教球员如何在对方进攻时沟通后，球队防守改善了。

senses.english: using very little time; moving far in little time
senses.exampleEnglish: We made a quick decision because the last train was about to leave and there was no time to discuss alternatives.
senses.exampleChinese: 末班火车即将开走，没时间商量其他方案，我们迅速做了决定。

senses.english: to heat food until it is ready to eat
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to cook together instead of going out, since everyone had brought something from the local market.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家都从当地市场带了食材，因此我们决定一起做饭而不外出吃。

senses.english: a person who prepares food as a job or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The cook explained which ingredients came from the nearby farms before showing visitors how the traditional dish was prepared.
senses.exampleChinese: 厨师先介绍哪些食材来自附近农场，再演示传统菜的做法。

senses.english: to place something over or cover a large area
senses.exampleEnglish: Spread the mixture evenly across the surface so that every part of the cake receives the same thin layer.
senses.exampleChinese: 把混合物均匀铺在表面，让蛋糕每个部分都覆盖同样薄的一层。

senses.english: to reach or affect more people or places
senses.exampleEnglish: News of the new path spread quickly after local families shared photographs of their first walk along the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地家庭分享首次沿河新步道散步的照片后，消息很快传开。

senses.english: the process of reaching more people or covering a larger area
senses.exampleEnglish: The display explains the spread of ideas between countries as people travelled, traded and shared what they had learned.
senses.exampleChinese: 展板说明人们旅行、贸易及分享所学时，思想如何在国家之间传播。

senses.english: a soft food that is put on bread or similar foods
senses.exampleEnglish: The café offered a vegetable spread with fresh bread, which gave visitors a lighter alternative to the usual sandwiches.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆提供蔬菜酱配新鲜面包，给游客比普通三明治更清淡的选择。

senses.english: concerning or involving the center of an atom
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how nuclear energy is produced and encourages visitors to consider both its benefits and its challenges.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆解释核能的产生方式，并鼓励游客考虑其优点与挑战。

senses.english: a device that is used to weigh a person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The scale showed that the package was heavier than expected, so we removed a few items before posting it.
senses.exampleChinese: 秤显示包裹比预期重，我们寄出前取走了几件东西。

senses.english: the size or extent of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not understand the scale of the repairs until the engineer showed us photographs of the damaged roof.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师展示损坏屋顶的照片后，我们才明白维修规模。

senses.english: a set of numbers used to measure, compare or describe something
senses.exampleEnglish: Students rated the difficulty on a scale from one to five before explaining which parts needed clearer instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生先按一到五级评难度，再解释哪些部分需要更清楚的说明。

senses.english: the relationship between a distance or size on a model and the real thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The map's scale helped us estimate the distance, although the steep path would make the walk take longer.
senses.exampleChinese: 地图比例尺帮助估计距离，不过陡路会让徒步耗时更长。

senses.english: one of the small flat plates covering the bodies of fish and some other animals
senses.exampleEnglish: The child examined a fish scale under the magnifying glass and noticed details that were invisible without it.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子用放大镜看鱼鳞，发现了肉眼看不见的细节。

senses.english: to climb a steep or high surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The team trained for several months before attempting to scale the mountain by a route that required technical climbing skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队训练数月，才尝试沿一条需要技术攀岩技巧的路线登山。

senses.english: someone who operates a vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver waited until everyone had fastened their seat belts before carefully pulling away from the busy station.
senses.exampleChinese: 司机等所有人系好安全带，才小心驶离繁忙车站。

senses.english: software that allows a computer to communicate with a device
senses.exampleEnglish: The printer needed a new driver before it would work with the computer that the office had recently bought.
senses.exampleChinese: 办公室新买的电脑要先装新驱动，打印机才能工作。

senses.english: something that causes a change or makes an activity develop
senses.exampleEnglish: The report identifies better transport as a major driver of growth because it allows people to reach more jobs.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告指出交通改善是增长的主要驱动力，因为人们能接触更多工作机会。

senses.english: small round object often used in a game or sport
senses.exampleEnglish: The ball landed behind the fence, so the children asked their neighbour if they could collect it from her garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 球落到围栏后，孩子们便问邻居能否去她花园捡球。

senses.english: a formal social event at which people dance
senses.exampleEnglish: The students organised a ball at the end of the course and invited their teachers to celebrate with them.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程结束时学生组织正式舞会，邀请老师一起庆祝。

senses.english: to produce tears and sounds because of pain
senses.exampleEnglish: The little boy began to cry when he lost sight of his family in the busy market.
senses.exampleChinese: 小男孩在热闹的市场里看不见家人时，开始哭起来。

senses.english: to shout something loudly
senses.exampleEnglish: The child cried for help when he could not find his family, and a nearby shopkeeper quickly came over.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子找不到家人时大声求助，附近店主很快过来了。

senses.english: a loud call or shout expressing a feeling or asking for something
senses.exampleEnglish: We heard a cry from the garden and went outside to find the children pointing at an unusual bird.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们听见花园的叫声，出去看见孩子们指着一只少见的鸟。

senses.english: making someone known to another by name
senses.exampleEnglish: After a brief introduction, the guide asked us to share what we already knew about the history of the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 简短介绍之后，向导请我们分享对这座城镇历史已有的了解。

senses.english: the first part of a book, speech or course that explains what follows
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the introduction first because it explains how the chapters are organised and where to find the practical activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 先读引言，它说明章节安排及实践活动的位置。

senses.english: someone's first experience of a subject or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop provides an introduction to photography for people who want to understand their cameras beyond the automatic settings.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊为想了解相机而不只用自动模式的人提供摄影入门。

senses.english: something that is a necessity
senses.exampleEnglish: A basic requirement of the course is that students attend regularly and complete a short project before the final lesson.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程基本要求是定期出席，并在最后一课前完成一个小项目。

senses.english: direction to your left when facing the rising sun
senses.exampleEnglish: The north of the country receives more rain, which explains why its valleys remain green throughout the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个国家的北部降雨较多，因此那里的山谷整个夏天都保持青绿。

senses.english: towards or in the direction of the north
senses.exampleEnglish: We continued north until the road became too narrow for the bus, then walked the rest of the way.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们继续向北，直到道路窄得公交无法通行，再步行走完剩余路程。

senses.english: in, facing or relating to the north
senses.exampleEnglish: The north wall receives less sunlight, so plants growing beside it need different conditions from those near the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 北墙阳光较少，因此墙边植物所需条件与入口附近不同。

senses.english: to provide evidence to establish the truth of
senses.exampleEnglish: Please confirm your arrival time tomorrow, so we can arrange for someone to meet you at the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 请明天确认抵达时间，方便我们安排人在车站接你。

senses.english: to state that an arrangement is definite
senses.exampleEnglish: Please confirm the booking by Friday so the hotel can keep the rooms available for everyone in our group.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在星期五前确认预订，让旅馆为我们全组保留房间。

senses.english: having higher status or authority than another person
senses.exampleEnglish: A senior member of staff will review the proposal before it is passed to the people responsible for the budget.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案交给预算负责人前，会先由一位资深员工审阅。

senses.english: older than another person
senses.exampleEnglish: He is several years senior to his colleague, although they both joined the organisation during the same training programme.
senses.exampleChinese: 他比同事年长几岁，尽管两人通过同一培训项目加入组织。

senses.english: an older adult, especially in contexts about services or activities
senses.exampleEnglish: The centre offers exercise classes for seniors who want to stay active while meeting other people from the neighbourhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 中心为想保持活跃、也想结识邻居的老年人提供运动课。

senses.english: a student in the final year of high school or university, especially in American English
senses.exampleEnglish: As a senior, she helped younger students choose courses while preparing her own applications for the following year.
senses.exampleChinese: 作为毕业班学生，她一边帮低年级学生选课，一边准备下一年的申请。

senses.english: short for photograph; a picture taken by a camera
senses.exampleEnglish: The photo was taken from the top of the hill, where the whole village could be seen below.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片是在山顶拍的，从那里能俯瞰整个村庄。

senses.english: to say that you will not accept something
senses.exampleEnglish: She did not refuse the offer immediately, but asked for time to consider how it would affect her family.
senses.exampleChinese: 她没有立即拒绝邀请，而是要求时间考虑对家人的影响。

senses.english: waste material that is thrown away
senses.exampleEnglish: The council collects refuse twice a week, but residents must separate recyclable items before leaving the bins outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 市议会每周收垃圾两次，但居民要先分类可回收物，再把桶放外面。

senses.english: to carry things from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The company uses smaller vehicles to transport goods through streets that are too narrow for its larger trucks.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司用小型车辆把货物运过大卡车无法通过的窄街。

senses.english: the system or means used to move people and goods
senses.exampleEnglish: Reliable public transport allows families to reach work and school without needing a separate car for every adult.
senses.exampleChinese: 可靠的公共交通让家庭上班上学不必给每位成年人各配一辆车。

senses.english: to rise or appear out of some background
senses.exampleEnglish: As the fog began to clear, the roofs of several houses started to emerge from the grey background.
senses.exampleChinese: 雾渐渐散开，几栋房子的屋顶开始从灰色背景中显现。

senses.english: picture showing the geography of an area
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked the map before leaving the main road, because the smaller paths were not clearly marked on the ground.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们离开主路前查看了地图，因为地面上的小路标记不清。

senses.english: to make a map of an area or describe how things are arranged
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will map the footpaths before creating a guide that shows which routes are suitable for younger children.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者会先绘制步道地图，再制作指南说明哪些路线适合幼儿。

senses.english: abstract idea of something or how it works
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher used a simple experiment to explain a concept that had seemed confusing when we read about it.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个概念在阅读时显得难懂，老师便用简单实验讲解。

senses.english: area of land that is surrounded by water
senses.exampleEnglish: The island can only be reached by boat, which makes planning around the weather an important part of any visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座岛只能乘船到达，因此每次参观都必须考虑天气安排。

senses.english: to improve society by removing abuse and injustices
senses.exampleEnglish: The new measures aim to reform the system so that people receive support according to their needs rather than their connections.
senses.exampleChinese: 新措施旨在改革制度，让人们按需求而非关系得到支持。

senses.english: a change intended to improve a system or organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The reform aimed to make the service fairer by giving the same support to families with similar needs.
senses.exampleChinese: 改革旨在向需求相似的家庭提供同样支持，让服务更公平。

senses.english: not one or the other; not either; none of two things
senses.exampleEnglish: Neither route is particularly difficult, although the path beside the river offers more shade on a hot afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 两条路线都不算难走，不过河边小路在炎热午后更遮阴。

senses.english: not one or the other of two people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: We visited both hotels, but neither had enough space for the whole group to stay together comfortably.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们看了两家旅馆，但都没有足够空间让全组舒适住在一起。

senses.english: used with nor to connect two negative possibilities
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were neither clear nor complete, so we asked the teacher to show us the process again.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明既不清楚也不完整，所以我们请老师再演示一次。

senses.english: used to show that a negative statement also applies to someone or something else
senses.exampleEnglish: She had not seen the message; neither had I, so both of us arrived at the wrong time.
senses.exampleChinese: 她没看到消息，我也没看到，所以我们两人都在错误时间到了。

senses.english: sport where 2 teams try to kick a ball in a goal; soccer
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched the football match together, even though most of us supported different teams during the rest of the season.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们一起看了这场足球赛，尽管赛季其他时候大多支持不同球队。

senses.english: an American team sport involving carrying or throwing an oval ball to score points
senses.exampleEnglish: He learned the rules of American football after moving abroad, although he had previously preferred sports played without protective equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 出国后他学会了美式橄榄球规则，尽管以前更喜欢无需防护装备的运动。

senses.english: to continue to live despite illness or trouble
senses.exampleEnglish: The young trees managed to survive the dry summer because volunteers brought water to the park every evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 幼树熬过了干旱的夏天，因为志愿者每晚都给公园送水。

senses.english: to remain alive longer than another person
senses.exampleEnglish: She survived her husband by many years and continued living in the village where they had raised their children.
senses.exampleChinese: 丈夫去世多年后她仍在世，继续住在两人养育孩子的村庄。

senses.english: act of flying
senses.exampleEnglish: Our flight arrived early, but we still had to wait for the bus that would take us into the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 飞机提前到达，但我们仍要等进城的公交车。

senses.english: a continuous series of steps between two floors or levels
senses.exampleEnglish: The room was up one flight of stairs, so staff offered to help carry the heavier bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 房间要上一段楼梯，工作人员主动帮忙提重行李。

senses.english: the act of escaping from danger or being pursued
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition describes the family's flight from the flood and how neighbouring villages helped them find somewhere safe.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览描述这家人逃离洪水，以及邻村如何帮他们找到安全住处。

senses.english: side of your body your heart is on
senses.exampleEnglish: The library is on your left after the bridge, opposite the building with the large blue door.
senses.exampleChinese: 过桥后图书馆在你的左边，就在蓝色大门的建筑对面。

senses.english: remaining after other things have been used or removed
senses.exampleEnglish: We had only a little time left before the museum closed, so we chose the rooms that interested us most.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆关门前只剩一点时间，我们选了最感兴趣的展室。

senses.english: on the side opposite the right
senses.exampleEnglish: Please use the left entrance while workers repair the steps in front of the main doors this week.
senses.exampleChinese: 本周工人维修正门台阶，请使用左边入口。

senses.english: towards the left side
senses.exampleEnglish: Turn left after the bridge and follow the narrow path until you reach the entrance beside the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 过桥后左转，沿窄路走到湖边入口。

senses.chinese: 离开；留下（leave的过去式或过去分词）
senses.english: the past tense and past participle of leave
senses.exampleEnglish: She left the documents on the desk before going out, so her colleague could check them during the morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 她出门前把文件留在桌上，让同事上午检查。

senses.english: people or groups favouring greater social equality and political change
senses.exampleEnglish: The article compares views from the left and right before asking readers to consider the evidence for each proposal.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章先比较左右两派观点，再请读者考虑每项提案的证据。

senses.english: to find a way to deal with a problem
senses.exampleEnglish: Working together helped us solve a problem that none of us had been able to manage on our own.
senses.exampleChinese: 合作让我们解决了一个谁单独都解决不了的问题。

senses.english: person who lives, or is near, you
senses.exampleEnglish: Our neighbor offered to look after the plants while we were away, provided we showed her where everything was kept.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居愿意在我们外出时照顾植物，只要我们告诉她用品的位置。

senses.english: images, color, or information behind the main one
senses.exampleEnglish: The mountains in the background made the photograph look dramatic, although the main subject was the small farmhouse.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然照片主体是小农舍，背景中的群山让画面很有气势。

senses.english: someone's family history, education or experience
senses.exampleEnglish: Her background in engineering helped her explain the technical problem without using words that confused the rest of the team.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的工程背景让她能不用让其他队员困惑的术语解释技术问题。

senses.english: activity or sound that is not the main thing receiving attention
senses.exampleEnglish: Soft music played in the background while visitors read the letters displayed around the small exhibition room.
senses.exampleChinese: 访客阅读小展室各处陈列的信件时，背景播放轻柔音乐。

senses.english: way of doing by using special knowledge or skill
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor demonstrated a breathing technique that helped the singers stay relaxed while holding longer notes together.
senses.exampleChinese: 导师演示了一种呼吸技巧，帮助歌手在合唱长音时保持放松。

senses.english: amount of activity over a communication system
senses.exampleEnglish: The website experienced heavy traffic after the announcement, so some users had to wait before the pages would load.
senses.exampleChinese: 公告后网站访问量很大，一些用户需要等待页面加载。

senses.english: vehicles moving on roads in a particular area
senses.exampleEnglish: The traffic became heavier near the station, so we left the bus and walked the last few streets.
senses.exampleChinese: 车站附近车流变多，我们下公交走完最后几条街。

senses.english: addition or change that makes something better
senses.exampleEnglish: We noticed an improvement in her confidence after she started practising with a partner rather than studying entirely alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 她开始和伙伴练习、不再完全独自学习后，我们发现她更有信心了。

senses.english: device used to make things (e.g., a hammer or driver)
senses.exampleEnglish: The carpenter selected a smaller tool because the space around the damaged part was too narrow for his usual equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 木匠选了较小的工具，因为损坏部位周围太窄，常用器具放不下。

senses.english: outcome of an event; result
senses.exampleEnglish: One unexpected consequence of the new bus route was that more visitors began shopping in the smaller villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 新公交路线带来的意外结果是，更多游客开始在小村庄购物。

senses.english: condition or fact that affects a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher considered each student's circumstances before deciding how much additional time they should receive for the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先考虑每位学生的具体情况，再决定项目应给多少额外时间。

senses.english: to breathe in through a cigarette and then blow it out
senses.exampleEnglish: People are asked not to smoke near the entrance, where children often wait for their parents after lessons.
senses.exampleChinese: 请勿在入口附近吸烟，孩子们下课后经常在那里等父母。

senses.english: the mixture of gases and small particles produced by burning something
senses.exampleEnglish: Smoke rose from the chimney as we approached the house, suggesting that someone had already lit the kitchen fire.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们靠近房屋时烟囱冒着烟，看来有人已生起厨房的炉火。

senses.english: feeling or action in response to something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her reaction to the news surprised us, because we had expected her to be disappointed rather than excited.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对消息的反应让我们吃惊，因为我们原以为她会失望而非兴奋。

senses.english: a process in which substances change when they are combined or affected
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher demonstrated a safe reaction that produced bubbles, then asked students to explain which changes they had observed.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师演示了产生气泡的安全反应，再请学生解释观察到的变化。

senses.english: drops of water that fall out of clouds in the sky
senses.exampleEnglish: The rain continued throughout the morning, so we explored the museum instead of walking along the coastal path.
senses.exampleChinese: 整个上午都在下雨，我们便参观博物馆而没有去海岸小路徒步。

senses.english: to have water fall from clouds
senses.exampleEnglish: It began to rain while we were crossing the park, so we waited in the café until it eased.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们穿过公园时开始下雨，于是到咖啡馆等雨变小。

senses.english: working hard doing something; full of activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The café becomes busy after school, when families stop for a drink before continuing their journey home.
senses.exampleChinese: 放学后咖啡馆变得忙碌，家庭们回家途中会在那里停下喝点东西。

senses.english: already being used or not available for someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: The line was busy when I called, so I sent a message asking the office to contact me later.
senses.exampleChinese: 我打电话时占线，所以发消息请办公室稍后联系我。

senses.english: a time or event where teaching and learning occur; class
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson ended with a short discussion in which students explained how they could use the new vocabulary outside class.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程以简短讨论结束，学生解释了如何在课外运用新词汇。

senses.english: something learned from an experience, especially a mistake or difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: The delay taught us a useful lesson about checking the timetable before making arrangements that depend on the last train.
senses.exampleChinese: 延误让我们学到实用教训：安排依赖末班火车的行程前，要先查时刻表。

senses.english: part of the head that thinks and controls your body
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how the brain processes information and why people sometimes remember the same event in different ways.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释大脑如何处理信息，以及为何人们对同一事件会有不同记忆。

senses.english: a large amount of something, often of no particular shape
senses.exampleEnglish: A mass of dark clouds appeared above the hills just as we were preparing to leave the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们正准备离开村庄时，山丘上方出现了一大片乌云。

senses.english: involving or affecting very large numbers of people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: Mass production made the products cheaper, although the company still needed skilled workers to check the quality carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 大批量生产让产品更便宜，但公司仍需熟练工仔细检验质量。

senses.english: causing laughter; amusing
senses.exampleEnglish: The story was funny because the main character kept misunderstanding instructions that seemed perfectly clear to everyone else.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事很有趣，因为主角总误解那些别人看来十分清楚的说明。

senses.english: strange, unusual or difficult to explain
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a funny noise from the machine, so we turned it off and asked someone to check it.
senses.exampleChinese: 机器发出奇怪声音，因此我们关掉它并请人检查。

senses.english: give something of value to or help someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone can contribute ideas during the meeting, even if they have only recently joined the project team.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个人都可以在会上提出想法，即使刚加入项目组也一样。

senses.english: act or result of not achieving your goals
senses.exampleEnglish: The team treated the failure as a chance to learn rather than a reason to abandon the project entirely.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队把失败视为学习机会，而不是彻底放弃项目的理由。

senses.english: a situation in which something stops working properly
senses.exampleEnglish: The power failure interrupted the meeting, so the organiser moved the discussion to a room with larger windows.
senses.exampleChinese: 停电打断会议，组织者便把讨论移到窗户更大的房间。

senses.english: to arrange a time to do something with others
senses.exampleEnglish: We should schedule the meeting for the afternoon, when the colleagues arriving by train will have reached the office.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议应安排在下午，那时乘火车来的同事已经到办公室。

senses.english: a plan showing when activities or events will happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The schedule leaves time for questions after each talk, so visitors do not have to wait until the end.
senses.exampleChinese: 日程在每场讲座后都留了提问时间，访客不用一直等到最后。

senses.english: person who makes a speech before a group
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker invited questions from the audience after explaining how the local community had developed the new garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 演讲者介绍社区如何建成新花园后，邀请听众提问。

senses.english: a device that produces sound from a recording or electronic signal
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker near the back was not working, so several people could not hear the introduction clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 后面的扬声器坏了，所以几个人听不清开场介绍。

senses.english: a person who can speak a particular language
senses.exampleEnglish: The class includes speakers of several languages, which gives everyone useful opportunities to compare different ways of expressing ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 班上有使用多种语言的人，让大家能比较不同的表达方式。

senses.english: lowest part of something; part on which it rests
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were printed at the bottom of the page, where several people had failed to notice them.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明印在页面底部，几个人都没有注意到。

senses.english: the part of the body that you sit on
senses.exampleEnglish: The child landed on his bottom after slipping on the grass, then quickly stood up and continued playing.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子在草地滑倒，一屁股坐下，又很快起身继续玩。

senses.english: in the lowest place or position
senses.exampleEnglish: Please put the heavier boxes on the bottom shelf so the smaller ones are easier to reach above them.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把重箱放底层，让上面的轻箱更容易拿到。

senses.english: to decide to use an idea, plan or method
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee agreed to adopt the proposal after several changes made it easier for smaller organisations to participate.
senses.exampleChinese: 几项修改让小机构更容易参与后，委员会同意采纳提案。

senses.english: to take another person's child into your family and legally become the parent
senses.exampleEnglish: They decided to adopt a child after discussing how they could provide a stable and supportive family home.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们讨论如何提供稳定、支持性的家庭环境后，决定收养一个孩子。

senses.english: to mix several things together to form one thing
senses.exampleEnglish: The course will combine practical activities with discussion, so students can test ideas before explaining what they have learned.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程将结合实践与讨论，让学生先检验想法，再说明所学。

senses.english: very high piece of land, higher than a hill
senses.exampleEnglish: The mountain was partly hidden by clouds when we arrived, but its highest peak became visible later that afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到达时山被云部分遮住，不过下午晚些时候最高峰显现了。

senses.english: to use valuable things ineffectively
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not want to waste the remaining time, so we divided the work and started immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不想浪费剩余时间，于是分工后立即开始。

senses.english: material that is no longer wanted or useful
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop encourages people to repair old furniture so less waste ends up being thrown away each year.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊鼓励修理旧家具，让每年被丢弃的垃圾更少。

senses.english: an unnecessary use of something valuable
senses.exampleEnglish: Repeating the whole task would be a waste of time because most of the earlier work was already correct.
senses.exampleChinese: 重做整个任务会浪费时间，因为前面大部分工作已经正确。

senses.english: to put a thing where it can't be found; go where you won't be found
senses.exampleEnglish: The children tried to hide the gift behind the sofa until their grandmother arrived for her birthday dinner.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们想把礼物藏在沙发后，等祖母来吃生日晚餐。

senses.english: formal relationship between a husband and a wife
senses.exampleEnglish: Their marriage brought together two large families who had lived in neighbouring villages without knowing each other well.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的婚姻连接了两个大家庭，双方虽住在邻村却原本不熟。

senses.english: piece of paper that lets you enter or use something
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep your ticket until the end of the journey, because someone may need to check it before you leave the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 请保留车票直到旅程结束，因为出站前可能还要检票。

senses.english: an official notice saying that someone must pay money for breaking a rule
senses.exampleEnglish: He received a parking ticket because he had not noticed the sign explaining when cars were allowed there.
senses.exampleChinese: 他因没注意停车时间标牌，收到了一张停车罚单。

senses.english: food for eating at a particular time (e.g., dinner)
senses.exampleEnglish: We shared a simple meal after the walk, enjoying the chance to talk about what we had seen.
senses.exampleChinese: 徒步后我们共享简餐，愉快地聊起沿途见闻。

senses.english: someone who works with you; coworker
senses.exampleEnglish: A colleague offered to check my report, pointing out several details that I had missed while working quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位同事主动检查我的报告，指出了我赶工时遗漏的细节。

senses.english: soft container to put things in and carry with you
