senses.exampleEnglish: She packed a small bag for the journey, choosing only things that she could carry comfortably throughout the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 她为旅程装了个小包，只选能整天轻松携带的东西。

senses.english: to put something into a bag
senses.exampleEnglish: Please bag the smaller items separately so they do not get lost among the larger things during the journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把小物品分袋装，免得运输时混在大件里找不到。

senses.english: to say something again
senses.exampleEnglish: Could you repeat the final instruction slowly, so everyone understands what to do before the activity begins?
senses.exampleChinese: 你能慢慢重复最后一条说明，让大家在活动开始前明白怎么做吗？

senses.english: something that happens or is shown again
senses.exampleEnglish: The evening programme was a repeat, but we watched it because we had missed the original broadcast the week before.
senses.exampleChinese: 晚间节目是重播，不过我们上周错过首播，所以还是看了。

senses.english: same in shape, size, or number
senses.exampleEnglish: The pieces should be equal in size, otherwise some will finish cooking before the larger ones are ready.
senses.exampleChinese: 各块大小要相等，否则小块会在大块熟之前就煮好。

senses.english: to be the same in amount or quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The final total should equal the amount shown on the receipt, so please check any difference before paying.
senses.exampleChinese: 最终总额应等于收据金额，所以付款前请核对任何差异。

senses.english: a person or thing of the same ability, status or value
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher treats students as equals in discussion, while still helping those who need more time to explain their ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师在讨论中平等对待学生，也帮助需要更多表达时间的人。

senses.english: act of making your thoughts and feelings known
senses.exampleEnglish: The class encouraged expression through music and movement, allowing students to share feelings they found difficult to describe.
senses.exampleChinese: 课堂鼓励通过音乐和动作表达，让学生分享难以言说的感受。

senses.english: a look on the face that shows a feeling
senses.exampleEnglish: Her expression changed when she realised the letter contained good news rather than another request for more information.
senses.exampleChinese: 意识到信里是好消息而非又一次补充资料要求时，她的表情变了。

senses.english: a word or group of words used to communicate a particular meaning
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained the expression using a short conversation, so we understood when people would naturally say it.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师用简短对话解释这个表达，让我们明白人们会何时自然使用它。

senses.english: a group of numbers and symbols showing a mathematical relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: The students simplified the expression before checking whether their answers were the same as those of their partners.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生先化简表达式，再核对答案是否与同伴相同。

senses.english: with; showing one amount added to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The price includes the main course plus a drink, but you will need to pay separately for dessert.
senses.exampleChinese: 价格包含主菜加一杯饮料，但甜点需要另付费。

senses.english: used informally to add another reason or fact
senses.exampleEnglish: The flat is close to work, plus it has a small garden where the children could play safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 公寓离工作地点近，而且有个让孩子安全玩耍的小花园。

senses.english: an advantage or a good feature
senses.exampleEnglish: The quiet location is a real plus, although we still need to check how often the bus runs.
senses.exampleChinese: 安静的位置确实是优点，不过我们仍要查看公交班次。

senses.english: in a way that is much more than usual or expected
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were extremely helpful because they explained not only what to do but also why each step mattered.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明极其有帮助，因为不仅解释做什么，也说明各步骤的重要性。

senses.english: person who owns or has something
senses.exampleEnglish: The owner showed us around the house and explained which parts had belonged to the original building.
senses.exampleChinese: 房主带我们参观房屋，解释哪些部分属于最初的建筑。

senses.english: an airplane
senses.exampleEnglish: Our plane landed before sunrise, so the city was still dark when we began the journey to our hotel.
senses.exampleChinese: 飞机在日出前降落，因此前往旅馆时城市仍然漆黑。

senses.english: a completely flat surface extending in two dimensions
senses.exampleEnglish: The model shows how the lines meet on the same plane, even though the drawing initially makes them look separate.
senses.exampleChinese: 模型显示这些线如何在同一平面相交，虽然图上起初看着像分开的。

senses.english: radio or television advertisement
senses.exampleEnglish: The commercial showed a family preparing dinner together, although the product itself appeared only briefly at the end.
senses.exampleChinese: 广告展现一家人一起做晚饭，产品本身却只在结尾短暂出现。

senses.english: relating to business, trade or making money
senses.exampleEnglish: The project became a commercial success after customers discovered that the product solved a problem they faced every day.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾客发现产品能解决日常问题后，项目获得商业成功。

senses.english: another way of saying 'woman'
senses.exampleEnglish: The lady sitting beside me explained which stop was closest to the museum and where I could buy a ticket.
senses.exampleChinese: 坐在身旁的女士告诉我哪站离博物馆最近，以及哪里能买票。

senses.english: work required by your job or position
senses.exampleEnglish: It is my duty to check that everyone has left the building before I lock the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 我有责任在锁上大门前确认所有人都已离开。

senses.english: a tax charged on particular goods, especially when they enter a country
senses.exampleEnglish: The traveller checked whether duty would be charged before deciding how many gifts to bring back from the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅客先查看是否要缴税，再决定旅行后带多少礼物回去。

senses.english: being strong
senses.exampleEnglish: The bridge was tested for strength before traffic was allowed to use it again after the repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 修复后重新通车之前，桥梁接受了强度测试。

senses.english: a good quality that makes someone or something effective
senses.exampleEnglish: Her main strength is explaining difficult ideas clearly, which helps the team make decisions without misunderstanding the technical details.
senses.exampleChinese: 她主要长处是把难点解释清楚，让团队不会因误解技术细节而影响决策。

senses.english: how strong a force, signal, feeling or substance is
senses.exampleEnglish: The strength of the signal improved near the window, so we moved the computer before trying the call again.
senses.exampleChinese: 窗边信号更强，所以我们先把电脑移过去，再尝试通话。

senses.english: to join or attach things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The new path will connect the school to the park, giving children a safer route away from the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 新小路将连接学校与公园，让孩子远离公路，走更安全的路线。

senses.english: to form a relationship with someone or understand their feelings
senses.exampleEnglish: The story helps readers connect with the main character because her worries are familiar to many young people.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事帮助读者与主角产生共鸣，因为许多年轻人都熟悉她的烦恼。

senses.english: of a particular society's customs and beliefs
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum organises cultural events that introduce visitors to the music and stories of families living in the region.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆举办文化活动，介绍当地家庭的音乐和故事。

senses.english: to put things into a particular order or position
senses.exampleEnglish: We will arrange the chairs in a circle so everyone can see each other during the discussion.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们会把椅子排成圆圈，让大家讨论时都能看见彼此。

senses.english: to plan and organise something so that it can happen
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to arrange transport before inviting everyone, since some families cannot reach the village without a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 邀请大家之前我们得安排交通，因为部分家庭不开车就到不了村里。

senses.english: often dishonest plan to get or do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The scheme promised easy profits, but several people became suspicious when they were asked to pay large fees in advance.
senses.exampleChinese: 该计划承诺轻松获利，但预先索取大笔费用让几个人起疑。

senses.english: an organised plan providing a service or benefit
senses.exampleEnglish: The council introduced a scheme that helps residents borrow tools instead of buying equipment they may use only once.
senses.exampleChinese: 市议会推出借工具方案，居民不必为可能只用一次的器材花钱购买。

senses.english: amount of money that is paid for something
senses.exampleEnglish: The payment must reach the office before Friday if you want your place on the course to be confirmed.
senses.exampleChinese: 要确认课程名额，付款必须在星期五前到达办公室。

senses.english: in a way that is to be regretted; unluckily
senses.exampleEnglish: Unfortunately, the museum was closed when we arrived, so we explored the nearby gardens instead of waiting outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 遗憾的是，到达时博物馆关门了，因此我们改去附近花园游览。

senses.english: short; using few words
senses.exampleEnglish: Please give a brief explanation of your idea before showing the pictures that illustrate how it would work.
senses.exampleChinese: 展示说明运作方式的图片之前，请先简要解释你的想法。

senses.english: instructions explaining what a person is expected to do
senses.exampleEnglish: The brief asked students to design a garden that would suit both young children and older residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 任务说明要求学生设计同时适合幼儿与老年居民的花园。

senses.english: to give someone the information needed before a task or event
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser will brief the volunteers before visitors arrive so everyone understands where to go and whom to help.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者会在游客到达前向志愿者说明情况，让每人明白去哪里、帮助谁。

senses.english: animal with feathers that uses wings to fly
senses.exampleEnglish: A small bird landed on the fence while we were sitting quietly in the garden after lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 午饭后我们静静坐在花园时，一只小鸟落在围栏上。

senses.english: to show how something works (e.g., product)
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor will demonstrate how to use the equipment before allowing anyone to try the activity without assistance.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练会先演示器材用法，再允许大家独立尝试活动。

senses.english: to show clearly that something is true
senses.exampleEnglish: The results demonstrate that regular short practice can be more useful than repeating everything once at the end.
senses.exampleChinese: 结果证明，短时间规律练习可能比最后一次性重复所有内容更有用。

senses.english: to take part in a public protest about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents gathered to demonstrate against the closure, while representatives asked the council to consider keeping the service open.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民聚集反对关闭服务，代表则请市议会考虑维持开放。

senses.english: helping a cause by giving money, things, services
senses.exampleEnglish: Her contribution to the project was important because she understood the concerns of people living near the proposed site.
senses.exampleChinese: 她了解拟建地点附近居民的顾虑，因此对项目的贡献很重要。

senses.english: to be thankful for; to value or admire
senses.exampleEnglish: We appreciate the time you have spent helping us, especially since you were already busy preparing your own presentation.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们很感激你花时间帮忙，尤其是你本来就在忙着准备自己的报告。

senses.english: to understand how serious or important something is
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not appreciate the difficulty of the task until we tried completing the first stage ourselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到亲自尝试第一阶段，我们才充分理解这项任务的难度。

senses.english: to increase in value over time
senses.exampleEnglish: The article explains why some properties appreciate in value while others remain at much the same price for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章解释为何某些房产会升值，而另一些多年价格不变。

senses.english: one of the main sections of a book
senses.exampleEnglish: The final chapter explains how the characters' choices changed their lives, rather than simply telling us what happened next.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一章说明人物选择如何改变生活，而非仅叙述后来的事。

senses.english: something that you don't want others to know; private
senses.exampleEnglish: They kept the plan secret until all the arrangements were complete, hoping to surprise their parents on the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们在安排妥当前一直保密，希望当天给父母一个惊喜。

senses.english: information that is not meant to be known by others
senses.exampleEnglish: She told me the secret only after I promised not to discuss it with anyone outside the family.
senses.exampleChinese: 我承诺不向家人以外的人提起后，她才告诉我秘密。

senses.english: the best way to achieve something or explain why something succeeds
senses.exampleEnglish: The secret of the café's success is simple food and friendly service rather than expensive furniture or complicated recipes.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆成功的秘诀是简单食物和友善服务，而非昂贵家具或复杂食谱。

senses.english: according to what you heard; from what can be seen
senses.exampleEnglish: Apparently, the earlier train has been cancelled, although we are still waiting for confirmation from the station staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 据说早一班火车取消了，不过我们仍在等车站工作人员确认。

senses.english: written fiction story
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel follows a family through several generations, showing how the same village changes as the years pass.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说讲述一个家族几代人的故事，展现同一村庄随岁月发生的变化。

senses.english: new and different from what is usually known or used
senses.exampleEnglish: The team proposed a novel way to reuse the old building without changing the features that residents valued.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队提出新颖办法，在不改变居民珍视部分的情况下重新利用旧建筑。

senses.english: organization of people or groups who have a similar interest or particular goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The union represents workers from several local factories and meets regularly to discuss their concerns about working conditions.
senses.exampleChinese: 工会代表当地几家工厂的工人，定期讨论他们对工作条件的顾虑。

senses.english: the act or state of joining people, groups or things together
senses.exampleEnglish: The union of the two clubs created enough members to organise activities that neither group could manage alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个俱乐部合并后成员充足，能举办原先任何一方单独都办不了的活动。

senses.english: to destroy with fire
senses.exampleEnglish: The old papers began to burn quickly, so he closed the stove door before any sparks could escape.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧纸很快燃烧起来，他在火星飞出前关上炉门。

senses.english: an injury caused by heat, chemicals or electricity
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse checked the burn before explaining how the patient could protect the area while it recovered.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士检查烧伤后，解释患者在恢复期该如何保护该处。

senses.english: to injure or damage something with heat
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to burn your hand when lifting the lid, because steam can escape from the side.
senses.exampleChinese: 揭盖时小心别烫到手，因为蒸汽可能从旁边冒出。

senses.english: to use fuel or energy in order to produce heat or movement
senses.exampleEnglish: The smaller engine burns less fuel, which makes the vehicle cheaper to use for regular journeys around town.
senses.exampleChinese: 小发动机耗油较少，使车辆日常在城里出行的使用成本更低。

senses.english: general direction of developing, proceeding
senses.exampleEnglish: The report identifies a growing trend towards working from home, although it notes that many jobs still require travel.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告指出居家工作趋势增强，不过也说明许多工作仍需出行。

senses.english: existing or occurring at the beginning
senses.exampleEnglish: Our initial plan was to visit three towns, but we later decided to spend more time exploring just one.
senses.exampleChinese: 最初计划游览三个城镇，但后来决定只深入探索其中一个。

senses.english: the first letter of a person's name
senses.exampleEnglish: Write your initials beside the changes so the organiser knows who checked each part of the final document.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在改动旁写姓名首字母，让组织者知道谁检查了最终文件各部分。

senses.english: to write the first letters of your name as a short signature
senses.exampleEnglish: Please initial each page after reading it, so we have a record that you have checked the whole agreement.
senses.exampleChinese: 阅读后请逐页签姓名首字母，便于记录你已核对整个协议。

senses.english: feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction
senses.exampleEnglish: It was a pleasure to see the children enjoying the garden that volunteers had worked so hard to create.
senses.exampleChinese: 看到孩子们喜欢志愿者辛勤建成的花园，令人愉快。

senses.english: idea about what someone should do
senses.exampleEnglish: His suggestion was to leave earlier, which would give us enough time to stop for breakfast before the meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 他建议早点出发，这样会前有足够时间停下来吃早餐。

senses.english: being important or serious; vital; dangerous
senses.exampleEnglish: Access to clean water is critical for the village, especially during the months when very little rain falls.
senses.exampleChinese: 洁净水源对村庄至关重要，尤其是在少雨的月份。

senses.english: expressing disapproval or pointing out faults
senses.exampleEnglish: The review was critical of the service, but it also suggested practical changes that would make the experience better.
senses.exampleChinese: 评论批评了服务，但也提出了能改善体验的实际改变。

senses.english: using careful judgement rather than accepting ideas without checking them
senses.exampleEnglish: The course develops critical thinking by asking students to compare evidence before deciding which explanation they find convincing.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程让学生比较证据再选择有说服力的解释，培养批判性思维。

senses.english: to bring people/animals together into a group
senses.exampleEnglish: We will gather outside the main entrance before the guide takes us through the parts normally closed to visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们将在主入口外集合，然后由向导带往通常不开放的区域。

senses.english: to understand or believe something from information you have received
senses.exampleEnglish: I gather that the meeting has moved to Friday, but I will check the message before changing my plans.
senses.exampleChinese: 据我了解会议改到周五，但我会先核对消息再改计划。

senses.english: in large part; mainly or chiefly
senses.exampleEnglish: The audience consisted mostly of local families, although a few visitors had travelled from towns further along the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 观众主要是当地家庭，也有少数游客来自更远的沿海城镇。

senses.english: planet we live on
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how the earth has changed over time and explains why some landscapes continue to develop.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览展示地球如何随时间变化，并解释为何一些地貌仍在演变。

senses.english: the material in which plants grow
senses.exampleEnglish: The children covered the seeds with a thin layer of earth before watering them gently for the first time.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们给种子盖上一层薄土，再第一次轻轻浇水。

senses.english: to cause something to open or burst suddenly
senses.exampleEnglish: The children watched the bubbles pop as they rose above the garden and touched the branches of the trees.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们看着泡泡升到花园上方，碰到树枝后破裂。

senses.english: popular music with a strong rhythm and tunes that are easy to remember
senses.exampleEnglish: The concert combined pop with traditional songs, giving younger listeners and their grandparents something familiar to enjoy.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会把流行乐与传统歌曲结合，让年轻听众与祖父母都有熟悉的音乐可听。

senses.english: a short sharp sound like something bursting
senses.exampleEnglish: We heard a pop from the kitchen and discovered that a balloon had touched the sharp corner of a cupboard.
senses.exampleChinese: 厨房传来砰的一声，我们发现气球碰到了橱柜尖角。

senses.english: to go somewhere quickly or for a short time, informally
senses.exampleEnglish: I will pop into the shop before coming home, since we need bread for the children's breakfast tomorrow.
senses.exampleChinese: 回家前我会顺便去趟商店，因为明天孩子早餐需要面包。

senses.english: a sweet fizzy drink, especially in informal American English
senses.exampleEnglish: The picnic offered water and pop, so guests could choose a drink before finding somewhere to sit.
senses.exampleChinese: 野餐提供水和汽水，客人可以先选饮料再找座位。

senses.english: extremely important and necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: It is essential to check the weather before setting off, because conditions in the mountains can change very quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前查看天气至关重要，因为山里天气可能迅速变化。

senses.english: something that is completely necessary, often used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: Pack only the essentials because we will carry our bags for several hours before reaching the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 只带必需品，因为到村庄前我们要背包走几个小时。

senses.english: to wish for, hope, or want something
senses.exampleEnglish: People who desire a quieter life sometimes move to smaller towns, although they may miss the convenience of city services.
senses.exampleChinese: 想要安静生活的人有时搬去小镇，但可能怀念城市服务的便利。

senses.english: a strong wish to have or do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her desire to understand other cultures encouraged her to learn languages and speak to people whenever she travelled.
senses.exampleChinese: 理解其他文化的愿望促使她学语言，并在旅行时与人交流。

senses.english: to try to encourage the popularity and sales of a product
senses.exampleEnglish: The town plans to promote local products through a weekend market where visitors can meet the people who make them.
senses.exampleChinese: 镇上计划通过周末市场推介本地产品，让游客与制作者见面。

senses.english: to move someone to a more senior or important job
senses.exampleEnglish: The company decided to promote her after she successfully led a project that involved several different departments.
senses.exampleChinese: 她成功领导了跨部门项目后，公司决定提拔她。

senses.english: to help something develop or encourage people to support it
senses.exampleEnglish: The activities promote cooperation by giving each child an important role in completing the task with the group.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动给每个孩子分配重要角色，共同完成任务，以促进合作。

senses.english: happening or being in the present time
senses.exampleEnglish: The library is currently being repaired, so readers must collect their books from a temporary room in the town hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆目前在维修，读者须到市政厅临时房间取书。

senses.english: to pay a person to work for you; to give a job to
senses.exampleEnglish: The business hopes to employ more local people once its new workshop is ready to begin producing furniture.
senses.exampleChinese: 新车间准备开始生产家具后，企业希望雇用更多当地人。

senses.english: to use a particular method or skill for a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher employs different methods because the same explanation does not always help every student understand a difficult idea.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师采用不同方法，因为同样解释不一定能让每个学生理解难点。

senses.english: track made with stones/by walking over the ground
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed a narrow path through the woods until the trees opened up and we could see the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿着林间窄路前行，直到树林变疏，看见湖水。

senses.english: a series of actions or choices leading towards a result
senses.exampleEnglish: Her career path changed after she discovered that she enjoyed teaching more than working alone in a laboratory.
senses.exampleChinese: 她发现自己更喜欢教书而非独自在实验室工作后，职业道路改变了。

senses.english: matter people talk or write about
senses.exampleEnglish: The topic attracted so much interest that the teacher agreed to continue discussing it during the following lesson.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个话题引起很大兴趣，老师同意下一节课继续讨论。

senses.english: large area of sand, next to an area of water
senses.exampleEnglish: We reached the beach before it became crowded and found a quiet place close to the water.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在海滩拥挤前抵达，在水边找到一个安静位置。

senses.english: to make someone notice and become interested in
senses.exampleEnglish: The new exhibition is expected to attract visitors who would not normally consider spending an afternoon in the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 新展览有望吸引平时不会考虑花一个下午逛博物馆的人。

senses.english: to draw something closer by a physical force
senses.exampleEnglish: The children tested which objects the magnet could attract before grouping the materials according to their observations.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们先测试磁铁能吸引哪些物体，再按观察给材料分类。

senses.english: to carry out, participate in; be involved in
senses.exampleEnglish: The activities encourage students to engage in discussion rather than simply listening while the teacher explains every answer.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动鼓励学生参与讨论，而不是只听老师解释每个答案。

senses.english: to attract someone's attention and keep them interested
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum uses stories to engage visitors before introducing the more difficult historical information shown in the later rooms.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆先用故事吸引游客，再介绍后面展室较难的历史信息。

senses.english: to arrange for someone to provide a professional service
senses.exampleEnglish: The school will engage a local artist to help children design the pictures for the new reading room.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校会聘请本地艺术家，帮助孩子设计新阅览室的图画。

senses.english: having control or influence over
senses.exampleEnglish: The mayor is a powerful figure in the town, but major decisions still require approval from the council.
senses.exampleChinese: 市长在镇上影响很大，但重大决定仍需议会批准。

senses.english: having great physical strength or the ability to produce a strong effect
senses.exampleEnglish: The powerful engine made the boat move quickly, even when it carried equipment and several passengers across the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使载着器材和几位乘客过湖，强大发动机仍让船行驶很快。

senses.english: plant with a pretty head (e.g., a rose)
senses.exampleEnglish: The flower opened during the night, revealing colours that were much brighter than we expected from its small buds.
senses.exampleChinese: 花朵在夜里绽放，颜色远比小花蕾让我们想象的鲜艳。

senses.english: to produce flowers
senses.exampleEnglish: These plants usually flower in spring, although the exact time depends on how warm the weather has been.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些植物通常春季开花，不过具体时间取决于天气暖和程度。

senses.english: unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: The village faced a serious crisis when the bridge closed, cutting off its usual connection to the nearest town.
senses.exampleChinese: 桥梁关闭、切断通往最近城镇的常规通道时，村庄面临严重危机。

senses.english: to move to a new environment and become accustomed to it
senses.exampleEnglish: The family decided to settle near the coast, where they could find work and remain close to their relatives.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人决定在海边定居，既能找工作，也能靠近亲人。

senses.english: to end a disagreement or reach a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to settle the disagreement before the next meeting so both teams can concentrate on the remaining work.
senses.exampleChinese: 下次会前得解决分歧，让两个团队都能专注剩余工作。

senses.english: to pay money that you owe
senses.exampleEnglish: Please settle the bill before leaving the hotel, including any meals or extra services used during your stay.
senses.exampleChinese: 离店前请结清账单，包括住宿期间的餐食及额外服务。

senses.english: to move downwards and remain in one place
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited for the dust to settle before opening the boxes that had been stored in the old workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们等灰尘落定后，才打开一直存放在旧车间的箱子。

senses.english: small form of transport for traveling on water
senses.exampleEnglish: We rented a small boat to explore the lake, taking care to return before the afternoon wind became stronger.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们租小船游湖，注意在午后风势增强前返回。

senses.english: to provide things useful or needed by others
senses.exampleEnglish: The funds will aid families who need temporary accommodation while repairs are carried out on their damaged homes.
senses.exampleChinese: 这笔资金将援助房屋受损、维修期间需要临时住所的家庭。

senses.english: help given to someone who needs support
senses.exampleEnglish: The village received aid after the flood, allowing families to repair their homes before the colder weather arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 洪水后村庄获得援助，让家庭能在天气转冷前修房。

senses.english: something that makes a task easier to do
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher used pictures as a learning aid when the children found the written explanation difficult to follow.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们难以看懂文字解释时，老师用图片辅助学习。

senses.english: thing you wave in front of your face to stay cool
senses.exampleEnglish: She carried a small paper fan, which helped her stay comfortable while waiting in the warm hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 她带着一把小纸扇，在闷热大厅等候时让自己更舒适。

senses.english: someone who greatly likes a person, team or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: She has been a fan of the band for years, although this was her first chance to hear them live.
senses.exampleChinese: 她喜欢这支乐队多年，但这是第一次有机会听现场。

senses.english: to move air towards someone or something using a flat object
senses.exampleEnglish: She used the programme to fan herself while waiting for the performance to begin in the warm hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在闷热大厅等演出开始时，用节目单给自己扇风。

senses.english: place where food is cooked
senses.exampleEnglish: The kitchen was large enough for everyone to help prepare dinner without getting in each other's way.
senses.exampleChinese: 厨房足够大，大家可以一起准备晚饭而不互相妨碍。

senses.english: two times
senses.exampleEnglish: We checked the address twice before leaving, because several streets in the town had very similar names.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前我们核对了两次地址，因为镇上好几条街名字很相似。

senses.english: newly made or gathered
senses.exampleEnglish: The market opens early so customers can buy fresh vegetables before the afternoon heat makes shopping less comfortable.
senses.exampleChinese: 市场很早开门，让顾客在午后炎热到来前购买新鲜蔬菜。

senses.english: clean and pleasant to breathe
senses.exampleEnglish: We opened the windows to let fresh air into the room before the next group arrived for the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 下一组来参加工作坊前，我们开窗让新鲜空气进入房间。

senses.english: new or different from what existed before
senses.exampleEnglish: The team needs a fresh approach because the old method has not solved the problem despite several careful attempts.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧方法经过几次认真尝试仍未解决问题，团队需要新思路。

senses.english: to cause something to happen later than planned or expected
senses.exampleEnglish: Heavy rain could delay the repairs, especially if workers are unable to reach the parts above the river safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 大雨可能延误维修，尤其是工人无法安全到达河流上方的部位时。

senses.english: a period in which something happens later than expected
senses.exampleEnglish: The delay gave us time to read the guide, although we would have preferred to reach the village before dark.
senses.exampleChinese: 延误让我们有时间读指南，但我们更希望天黑前到村庄。

senses.english: state of being free from harm or danger
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone's safety depends on following the instructions, even when the activity seems familiar and the equipment looks simple.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家的安全取决于遵守说明，即使活动熟悉、器材看起来简单也一样。

senses.english: professional who designs and builds machines, roads, and other complicated structures
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineer explained why the bridge needed repairs before showing the council several possible ways to strengthen it.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师先解释桥梁为何需要维修，再向议会展示几种加固方案。

senses.english: to arrange events carefully so that a particular result happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The group managed to engineer a compromise by finding a solution that protected the interests of both sides.
senses.exampleChinese: 团体找到了兼顾双方利益的办法，成功促成妥协。

senses.english: not loud; making very little sound
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a quiet room at the back of the hotel so the children could sleep without hearing the traffic.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选了旅馆后部安静的房间，让孩子睡觉不受车流声影响。

senses.english: a state with little noise or disturbance
senses.exampleEnglish: We enjoyed the quiet of the early morning before traffic and visitors began to fill the village streets.
senses.exampleChinese: 在车流游客充满村庄街道前，我们享受清晨的宁静。

senses.english: payments to cover potential loss/damage/injury/death
senses.exampleEnglish: Before travelling, check whether your insurance covers the activities you plan to do as well as ordinary medical care.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅行前，检查保险是否既涵盖普通医疗，也涵盖你计划参加的活动。

senses.english: person trained to care for sick or injured people
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained each step before checking the child's temperature, helping him feel less worried about the unfamiliar equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士在给孩子量体温前解释每一步，让他不那么害怕陌生器械。

senses.english: to care for a person or animal that is ill or injured
senses.exampleEnglish: She helped nurse the injured bird until a local wildlife centre could provide the specialist care it needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她帮忙照料受伤鸟，直到野生动物中心能提供专业照护。

senses.english: to separate something into equal pieces
senses.exampleEnglish: We will divide the fruit into equal portions so that every child receives the same amount after the activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们将水果平均分份，让每个孩子在活动后得到一样多。

senses.english: to calculate how many times one number fits into another
senses.exampleEnglish: Divide the total by the number of people to find out how much each person should pay.
senses.exampleChinese: 总额除以人数，就能算出每人该付多少。

senses.english: to make people disagree or form separate groups
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal divided the community because some residents valued more parking while others wanted to protect the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案使社区产生分歧，有人重视增加停车位，有人希望保护花园。

senses.english: a difference or separation between groups
senses.exampleEnglish: The project aims to reduce the digital divide by giving families access to computers and practical training.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目为家庭提供电脑使用机会及实用培训，旨在缩小数字鸿沟。

senses.english: measurement of distance or of time
senses.exampleEnglish: Measure the length of the table before buying the cloth, otherwise you may find that it does not cover both ends.
senses.exampleChinese: 买桌布前先量桌子长度，否则可能盖不住两端。

senses.english: search for information about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The investigation focused on why the system failed rather than trying to blame the person who first noticed the problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查重点是系统为何失效，而非责怪最先发现问题的人。

senses.english: box or container in which items are placed for mailing
senses.exampleEnglish: The package arrived earlier than expected, but we waited until the whole family was home before opening it.
senses.exampleChinese: 包裹比预期早到，但我们等全家到齐才打开。

senses.english: a set of related services or products provided together
senses.exampleEnglish: The holiday package includes transport and accommodation, but families must arrange their own meals during the stay.
senses.exampleChinese: 度假套餐含交通和住宿，但家庭需自行安排餐食。

senses.english: to put something into a container ready for sale or transport
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will package the books carefully so they arrive in good condition after the long journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者会仔细包装书籍，保证长途运输后仍完好。

senses.english: at or to an unknown or unnamed place
senses.exampleEnglish: We need somewhere quiet to discuss the plan, because it is difficult to hear each other in this crowded hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要找个安静地方讨论计划，因为这个大厅太拥挤，听不清彼此。

senses.english: to become bigger or larger in size and amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The library plans to expand its reading area so more people can study there without feeling crowded.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆计划扩大阅读区，让更多人在那里学习而不感到拥挤。

senses.english: to do something bad, usually a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: The programme explores why people commit crimes and how communities can help prevent the same behaviour from happening again.
senses.exampleChinese: 节目探讨人们为何犯罪，以及社区如何帮助防止类似行为重演。

senses.english: to promise to do something or accept an obligation
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot commit to a date until the engineer confirms that the repairs will be finished safely in time.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师确认能及时安全修好前，我们无法承诺日期。

senses.english: to give time, money or effort to a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity will commit more resources to training because volunteers need support as well as enthusiasm for the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 慈善机构会把更多资源投入培训，因为志愿者除了热情也需要支持。

senses.english: easily understood and clear; plain to see
senses.exampleEnglish: It became obvious that we needed more chairs when several guests arrived with friends who had not been expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位客人带来了原本没预计到的朋友，需要更多椅子就很明显了。

senses.english: to push your body into the air with your legs
senses.exampleEnglish: The children watched the dog jump over a low fence before running back to the person holding its ball.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们看着狗跳过矮围栏，再跑回拿着球的人身边。

senses.english: to increase suddenly by a large amount
senses.exampleEnglish: Ticket prices jumped after the new timetable was announced, making it harder for some families to use the service.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表公布后票价猛涨，使部分家庭更难使用服务。

senses.english: an act of pushing yourself off the ground with your legs
senses.exampleEnglish: The child practised a small jump before trying to clear the low bar that the instructor had placed on the grass.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子先练小跳，再尝试越过老师放在草地上的低杆。

senses.english: a sudden large increase
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum saw a jump in visitor numbers after local schools began using its exhibitions for their lessons.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地学校开始用展览上课后，博物馆游客数量猛增。

senses.english: something that is used for fighting
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displays an ancient weapon beside a description explaining how soldiers used it and why its design changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆在古代武器旁附说明，介绍士兵如何使用以及设计为何变化。

senses.english: in a manner that measures or compares something to something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The first part of the walk was relatively easy, although the final climb required more effort than we expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 徒步前半段相对轻松，不过最后的攀爬比预期费力。

senses.english: person who entertains guests
senses.exampleEnglish: Our host welcomed us with tea before showing us the room where we would stay during our visit.
senses.exampleChinese: 主人先用茶欢迎我们，再带我们看此次来访期间的住处。

senses.english: to welcome guests or provide the place and arrangements for an event
senses.exampleEnglish: The school will host the exhibition so families can see the work that students have completed during the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校将主办展览，让家长看到学生一年来完成的作品。

senses.english: to provide the computers and services needed for a website or online activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisation will host the website on its own server so staff can manage the information more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织将用自己的服务器托管网站，方便员工管理信息。

senses.english: an organism on or in which another organism lives
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explains how a host can provide food for another organism, using familiar examples from the school garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程用学校花园里的熟悉例子，解释宿主如何供养其他生物。

senses.english: coldest season of the year
senses.exampleEnglish: The village attracts fewer visitors in winter, when snow sometimes closes the narrow road that leads over the hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 冬季村里游客较少，因为积雪有时会封闭翻越山丘的窄路。

senses.english: area of a country, city, or town
senses.exampleEnglish: The district has changed considerably since a new station made it easier for people to travel to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 新车站让通勤更方便之后，这个区域发生了很大变化。

senses.english: wide; from the shorter two sides to the other
senses.exampleEnglish: A broad path leads from the entrance to the lake, allowing families with pushchairs to walk together comfortably.
senses.exampleChinese: 一条宽阔小路从入口通向湖边，方便推婴儿车的家庭一起舒适散步。

senses.english: including a large range of people, ideas or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The course gives a broad introduction to the subject before students choose which area they want to study in detail.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程先广泛介绍该学科，之后学生选择想深入学习的方向。

senses.english: to feel the need to rest after some effort; (n) a rubber covering around a wheel
senses.exampleEnglish: Long journeys can tire young children, so we planned several stops where everyone could stretch and get some fresh air.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途旅行会让幼儿疲劳，因此我们安排几次停车，让大家活动并透气。

senses.english: a thick rubber covering around the outside of a wheel, the American spelling of tyre
senses.exampleEnglish: The front tire was losing air, so we stopped at a repair shop before continuing along the mountain road.
senses.exampleChinese: 前轮胎漏气，我们先到修理店停下，再继续走山路。

senses.english: time of year when plants start growing after winter
senses.exampleEnglish: In spring, the trees along the river become green again, making the walk especially popular with local families.
senses.exampleChinese: 春天河边树木重新变绿，这段步道格外受当地家庭欢迎。

senses.english: a curved piece of metal that returns to its shape after being pressed or stretched
senses.exampleEnglish: A small spring inside the lock had broken, which explained why the door no longer closed properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 锁里小弹簧断了，难怪门关不严。

senses.english: a place where water flows naturally out of the ground
senses.exampleEnglish: The path follows a stream to the spring where villagers once collected water before pipes reached their homes.
senses.exampleChinese: 小路沿溪通往泉眼，村民在家中通水管前曾在那里取水。

senses.english: to jump or move quickly and suddenly
senses.exampleEnglish: The cat sprang onto the wall when it heard the gate open, then watched us carry the boxes inside.
senses.exampleChinese: 听见门开，猫突然跳上墙，看着我们把箱子搬进去。

senses.english: to appear or develop suddenly
senses.exampleEnglish: New cafés began to spring up near the station after the improved train service brought more visitors to the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 铁路服务改善带来更多游客后，车站附近新咖啡馆迅速涌现。

senses.english: part of a person that is not physical and believed to be the source of human emotions and character
senses.exampleEnglish: Her generous spirit encouraged others to volunteer, even when the work required patience and offered little public recognition.
senses.exampleChinese: 她慷慨的精神鼓励别人做志愿者，即使工作需要耐心、又少有人知晓。

senses.english: a non-physical being believed to exist after death
senses.exampleEnglish: The old story describes a spirit that appears near the bridge whenever travellers lose their way in the fog.
senses.exampleChinese: 古老故事讲述旅人在雾中迷路时，桥边会出现一个幽灵。

senses.english: a strong alcoholic drink, usually used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The menu lists spirits separately from wine and beer so guests can easily find the type of drink they prefer.
senses.exampleChinese: 菜单把烈酒与葡萄酒、啤酒分开列出，方便客人找喜欢的饮品。

senses.english: light meal eaten in the middle of the day
senses.exampleEnglish: We brought lunch with us because there were no cafés along the path once it entered the forest.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们自带午餐，因为小路一进入森林，沿途就没有咖啡馆。

senses.english: to eat the meal in the middle of the day
senses.exampleEnglish: We planned to lunch at the small café before walking to the museum on the other side of town.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们打算先在小咖啡馆吃午饭，再步行去镇另一边的博物馆。

senses.english: real or existing in fact, not imagined; real
senses.exampleEnglish: The actual cost was lower than the estimate, leaving us enough money to repair the smaller room as well.
senses.exampleChinese: 实际费用低于估价，剩余的钱足以顺便修好小房间。

senses.english: large container or hole that is filled with water and used for people to swim in
senses.exampleEnglish: The pool is open to families in the afternoon, although swimming lessons take place there earlier in the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 泳池下午向家庭开放，白天较早时段则用来上游泳课。

senses.english: an amount of money, resources or people available for a shared purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The project draws on a pool of local volunteers who bring different skills and knowledge to the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目依靠一批本地志愿者，他们带来不同技能和知识。

senses.english: to combine money, information or other resources for a common purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The families decided to pool their resources so they could buy equipment that none could afford alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 几家人决定集中资源，购买任何一家都无法独立负担的器材。

senses.english: a game in which a cue is used to hit balls into pockets on a table
senses.exampleEnglish: We played pool in the common room while waiting for the rain to stop before walking back to the hotel.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在公共休息室打台球，等雨停后再步行回旅馆。

senses.english: a small area of liquid lying on a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: A pool of water had formed beneath the window, so we checked whether rain was entering through the damaged frame.
senses.exampleChinese: 窗下积了一摊水，我们便检查雨是否从损坏窗框漏入。

senses.english: military fight between armies
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition describes a battle that changed the region, using maps to explain how the two armies moved.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览通过地图说明双方军队的行动，介绍一场改变该地区的战役。

senses.english: a difficult effort to overcome a problem
senses.exampleEnglish: Finding time to study was a constant battle until she began practising for a few minutes during her lunch break.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到开始利用午休几分钟练习前，挤时间学习一直很艰难。

senses.english: to try very hard to overcome a problem or opponent
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers battled against the rising water to protect the building until help arrived from the nearby town.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者奋力对抗上涨的水位保护建筑，直到邻镇救援到达。

senses.english: way of thinking and behaving that was used for a long time
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival continues a local tradition in which neighbours share food and welcome visitors into their homes.
senses.exampleChinese: 节庆延续了当地传统，邻居们分享食物，并欢迎游客到家中做客。

senses.english: physical money (not credit card or digital)
senses.exampleEnglish: The café only accepts cash, so we stopped at a machine before returning to pay for our lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆只收现金，所以我们先去取款机取钱，再回来付午饭钱。

senses.english: to exchange a cheque or similar document for money
senses.exampleEnglish: She went to the bank to cash the cheque before buying the materials needed for the school project.
senses.exampleChinese: 她去银行兑现支票，再买学校项目所需材料。

senses.english: clearly or undoubtedly not; very little
senses.exampleEnglish: We could hardly hear the guide because the wind was blowing strongly across the open space beside the harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 港口旁开阔处风很大，我们几乎听不见向导讲话。

senses.english: to give a prize for doing something well
senses.exampleEnglish: The judges will award the prize to the team whose design offers the clearest solution to the problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 评委会把奖颁给设计方案最清楚解决问题的团队。

senses.english: a prize or official recognition given for an achievement
senses.exampleEnglish: The group received an award for creating a garden that people of different ages could enjoy together.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个团体因建造适合不同年龄共同使用的花园而获奖。

senses.english: person who teaches others how to do (sport, job)
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach encouraged every player to practise the same basic skills before trying the more complicated parts of the game.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练鼓励每位球员先练好同样的基本技能，再尝试更复杂的比赛技巧。

senses.english: a comfortable bus used for longer journeys or group travel
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach will leave the school at eight, giving the group enough time to reach the museum before it becomes crowded.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅游大巴八点从学校出发，方便全组在博物馆拥挤前抵达。

senses.english: to teach someone skills for a sport, activity or performance
senses.exampleEnglish: She coaches the younger players after work, helping them build confidence as well as improve their practical skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 她下班后训练年幼球员，既提升技能，也建立信心。

senses.english: test performed to assess new ideas or theories
senses.exampleEnglish: The experiment showed that the plants grew differently even though they received the same amount of water each day.
senses.exampleChinese: 实验显示，虽然每天浇同样多的水，植物的生长仍有所不同。

senses.english: to try different things to find out what works or what happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will experiment with different materials before deciding which design is strong enough to hold the weight.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生会先试验不同材料，再判断哪种设计足以承重。

senses.english: careful thought; thinking about something
senses.exampleEnglish: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller house because its location would make our daily journeys much easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 仔细考虑后，我们选择较小的房子，因为它的位置使日常出行方便得多。

senses.english: something important to think about when making a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: Cost is an important consideration, but the group must also think about safety and access for older visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 费用是重要因素，但团队也得考虑安全和年长游客的便利。

senses.english: care for the feelings or needs of others
senses.exampleEnglish: Please show consideration for other guests by keeping the noise low when you return to the hotel late.
senses.exampleChinese: 很晚回旅馆时请降低音量，体谅其他住客。

senses.english: unusual or odd; surprising because unexpected
senses.exampleEnglish: It felt strange to return to the school after so many years and find that very little had changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 多年后重返学校，发现几乎一切未变，感觉有些奇妙。

senses.english: not known or familiar to you
senses.exampleEnglish: Arriving in a strange city can feel difficult at first, especially when the signs are in a language you are learning.
senses.exampleChinese: 初到陌生城市可能很难适应，尤其是标牌用的还是你正在学的语言。

senses.english: a password made of a set of letters or numbers
senses.exampleEnglish: You will need a separate code to open the gate if you arrive after the reception desk has closed.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果在前台关门后到达，你需要另一个密码才能打开大门。

senses.english: instructions written in a language that a computer can understand
senses.exampleEnglish: The students checked the code carefully before running the program, because a small error could change the result.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生运行程序前仔细检查代码，因为小错误也会改变结果。

senses.english: a set of rules describing how people should behave
senses.exampleEnglish: The school introduced a code of conduct that explains how students should treat each other during online discussions.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校推出行为准则，解释学生在网络讨论中应如何相互对待。

senses.english: a system of signs or symbols used to represent information or keep it secret
senses.exampleEnglish: The children created a code for their messages, then challenged another group to discover what the symbols meant.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们为消息编了一套密码，再让另一组猜符号的含义。

senses.english: to write instructions that a computer can use
senses.exampleEnglish: She learned to code by building a small game, asking for help whenever the program behaved differently from her plan.
senses.exampleChinese: 她通过做小游戏学习编程，遇到程序运行与计划不符就求助。

senses.english: may be true or likely, but is uncertain
senses.exampleEnglish: The delay could possibly affect our connection, although the station staff thought there would still be enough time.
senses.exampleChinese: 延误可能影响转车，不过车站工作人员认为时间仍然充足。

senses.chinese: 威胁；构成危险的人或事物
senses.english: someone or something that may cause harm or serious trouble
senses.exampleEnglish: The rising water posed a threat to the village, so volunteers helped families move valuable items upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 上涨的水位威胁村庄，志愿者便帮家家户户把贵重物品搬上楼。

senses.english: a statement that someone will cause harm unless another person does what they want
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager reported the threat instead of replying angrily, so the organisation could deal with the situation properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理没有生气回击，而是报告威胁，让组织能妥善处理。

senses.english: sudden unplanned event causing damage, injury, etc.
senses.exampleEnglish: The accident caused a long delay, but the driver kept passengers informed while they waited for another bus.
senses.exampleChinese: 事故造成长时间延误，但司机在乘客等另一辆车时不断通报情况。

senses.english: very unlikely to happen or exist
senses.exampleEnglish: It was impossible to finish before lunch because we were still waiting for information from the other team.
senses.exampleChinese: 午饭前不可能完成，因为我们仍在等另一个团队的信息。

senses.english: money that is made by or paid to a business
senses.exampleEnglish: The market generates revenue for local businesses while giving visitors a reason to spend more time in the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 市场为本地企业创造收入，也吸引游客在镇上停留更久。

senses.english: to make it possible to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The new bridge will enable children to reach school safely without crossing the busy road near the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 新桥能让孩子们安全上学，不必横穿车站附近的繁忙道路。

senses.english: worried that something bad will happen; scared
senses.exampleEnglish: She was afraid of making mistakes at first, but practising with a supportive partner helped her speak more confidently.
senses.exampleChinese: 她起初害怕犯错，但与支持她的伙伴练习后，说话更自信了。

senses.english: moving around a lot or doing many things
senses.exampleEnglish: My grandparents remain active by walking to the market and helping in the community garden several times a week.
senses.exampleChinese: 祖父母通过步行去市场、每周几次在社区花园帮忙来保持活跃。

senses.english: currently working, operating or having an effect
senses.exampleEnglish: The account must remain active if you want to keep receiving updates about the progress of your application.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果想持续收到申请进展消息，账户必须保持有效。

senses.english: describing a verb form in which the subject performs the action
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to rewrite the sentence in the active voice so its meaning would become clearer.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们把句子改为主动语态，让意思更清楚。

senses.english: to stop or finish; to come to the end of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We will conclude the visit with a short discussion, giving everyone a chance to share what they found most interesting.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们将以简短讨论结束参观，让每人分享最感兴趣的内容。

senses.english: to decide that something is true after considering information
senses.exampleEnglish: The researchers concluded that more testing was needed because the first results did not explain all the differences.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究者认为需要更多测试，因为第一批结果没有解释全部差异。

senses.english: concerning religion or faith
senses.exampleEnglish: The building has religious importance for local families, although visitors are welcome to admire its art and architecture.
senses.exampleChinese: 这座建筑对当地家庭具有宗教意义，也欢迎游客欣赏其艺术和建筑。

senses.english: any growth caused by abnormal cell division
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity supports families affected by cancer and helps them find reliable information about services in their local area.
senses.exampleChinese: 慈善机构支持受癌症影响的家庭，帮助他们找到当地服务的可靠信息。

senses.english: to persuade someone, or make them feel sure
senses.exampleEnglish: She used the results of the trial to convince the team that the new method deserved further testing.
senses.exampleChinese: 她用试验结果说服团队，相信新方法值得进一步测试。

senses.english: to be changeable, both up and down
senses.exampleEnglish: Prices vary throughout the year, so booking the same journey in a different month can make a considerable difference.
senses.exampleChinese: 价格全年波动，因此换个月份预订同样行程，费用可能差很多。

senses.english: of the natural world in which plants and animals live
senses.exampleEnglish: The project examines environmental problems in the region and encourages students to suggest changes that local families could make.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目研究当地环境问题，并鼓励学生提出家庭可采取的改变。

senses.english: the hot shining star the earth moves around
senses.exampleEnglish: The sun appeared between the clouds just as we reached the top, revealing a clear view across the valley.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们刚到山顶，太阳从云间露出，山谷景色清楚地展现在眼前。

senses.english: in good condition physically (or financially); not ill or bad
senses.exampleEnglish: The programme helps families develop healthy habits without suggesting that everyone needs to follow exactly the same routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目帮助家庭养成健康习惯，并不要求每个人采用完全一样的作息。

senses.english: helping to keep someone physically well
senses.exampleEnglish: The course shows families how to prepare healthy meals without needing expensive ingredients or spending hours in the kitchen.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程教家庭无需昂贵食材或久待厨房也能准备健康饭菜。

senses.english: to move something using air
senses.exampleEnglish: A strong wind can blow the door shut, so please keep it open with the heavy block beside the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 大风可能把门吹关，请用入口旁的重块把门撑住。

senses.english: a hard hit from a hand, object or other force
senses.exampleEnglish: The door received a heavy blow from the falling branch, leaving a mark that could still be seen afterwards.
senses.exampleChinese: 落下的树枝重击了门，留下后来仍能看见的痕迹。

senses.english: an unexpected event that causes disappointment or makes a situation worse
senses.exampleEnglish: Losing the venue was a serious blow, but the organisers found another building before the tickets went on sale.
senses.exampleChinese: 失去场地是严重打击，不过组织者在开票前找到了另一栋楼。

senses.english: level of sound produced by an object, such as a radio or television
senses.exampleEnglish: Please turn down the volume while we discuss the instructions, because some people are finding it difficult to hear.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论说明时请调低音量，因为有些人听不清。

senses.english: the amount of something or the space it occupies
senses.exampleEnglish: The volume of information was difficult to manage, so the team sorted it into smaller groups before starting the analysis.
senses.exampleChinese: 信息量难以处理，团队先分成小组再开始分析。

senses.english: one book, especially one in a series of related books
senses.exampleEnglish: The final volume contains maps and photographs that help readers understand the places described in the earlier books.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一卷包含地图和照片，帮助读者了解前几卷描述的地方。

senses.english: particular position or area
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose the location because it was close to public transport and had enough space for families to gather.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选这个地点，因为它靠近公共交通，又有足够空间让家庭聚会。

senses.english: to use resources to build for the future
senses.exampleEnglish: The company plans to invest in better equipment so that staff can complete routine tasks more safely and efficiently.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司计划投资改善设备，让员工更安全高效地完成日常任务。

senses.english: to continue to do something; carry on
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot proceed with the repairs until the engineer confirms that the damaged part is safe to remove.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师确认损坏零件可以安全拆除之前，我们无法继续维修。

senses.english: to clean someone or something with soap and water
senses.exampleEnglish: Please wash the vegetables thoroughly before cutting them, especially if they have come straight from the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 切菜前请彻底洗净，尤其是刚从花园摘来的蔬菜。

senses.english: an act of cleaning yourself or something else with water
senses.exampleEnglish: The bicycle needed a wash after the muddy journey, but we waited until the rain had stopped completely.
senses.exampleChinese: 经过泥泞路段后自行车需要清洗，但我们等雨完全停了再洗。

senses.english: person who acts in the theater, movies, or tv
senses.exampleEnglish: The actor spent several weeks learning about the character's job so his movements would look natural on stage.
senses.exampleChinese: 演员花了几周了解角色的职业，让舞台动作看起来自然。

senses.english: happy that something happened; pleased
senses.exampleEnglish: We were glad to hear that the bridge had reopened, since it would make visiting our relatives much easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 听说桥重新开放，我们很高兴，因为探亲会方便得多。

senses.english: to stick things together using an adhesive strip
senses.exampleEnglish: Please tape the label firmly to the box, otherwise it may fall off before the package reaches its destination.
senses.exampleChinese: 请用胶带把标签牢牢贴在箱子上，否则包裹抵达前标签可能脱落。

senses.english: a narrow strip with a sticky surface used to hold things together
senses.exampleEnglish: We used strong tape to close the box before sending it on the long journey to the school.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用结实胶带封好箱子，再长途寄往学校。

senses.english: a long narrow strip used to record sound or moving pictures
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum played an old tape so visitors could hear how local people spoke before the town changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆播放旧录音带，让游客听到城镇变化前当地人的说话方式。

senses.english: to record sound or pictures, traditionally on magnetic tape
senses.exampleEnglish: They asked permission to tape the interview so the speaker's words could be checked accurately before the article was published.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们先请求允许录下采访，方便文章发表前准确核对发言。

senses.english: taking into consideration the fact that
senses.exampleEnglish: The morning class focuses on speaking, whereas the evening session gives students more time to practise writing and reading.
senses.exampleChinese: 上午课程侧重口语，而晚间课程让学生有更多时间练习写作和阅读。

senses.english: across from or on the side facing something
senses.exampleEnglish: The entrance is on the opposite side of the square, so we need to walk past the fountain first.
senses.exampleChinese: 入口在广场对面，所以我们得先走过喷泉。

senses.english: completely different from another thing in direction, effect or meaning
senses.exampleEnglish: The two reports reached opposite conclusions even though both teams had examined information from the same local survey.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然两队查看同一地方调查资料，两份报告却得出相反结论。

senses.english: on the other side from and facing someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The café is opposite the station, so we can wait there comfortably while watching for the bus to arrive.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆在车站对面，我们可以舒适地等着，同时留意公交到站。

senses.english: in a position on the other side facing something
senses.exampleEnglish: She lives opposite, so she can see whether the lights are on in our kitchen from her window.
senses.exampleChinese: 她住在对面，从窗户就能看见我们厨房是否开灯。

senses.english: someone or something completely different from another
senses.exampleEnglish: The room looked crowded in the photograph, but the opposite was true when we actually visited the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片里房间显得拥挤，但实际参观时情况正相反。

senses.english: hard, solid piece of rock
senses.exampleEnglish: She placed a smooth stone on the papers to stop the wind from blowing them off the outdoor table.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在纸上压了一块光滑石头，防止风把纸吹下室外桌子。

senses.english: a British unit of weight equal to fourteen pounds
senses.exampleEnglish: The article used stone to describe body weight, so I checked the conversion before comparing it with kilograms.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章用英石表示体重，因此我先查换算，再与公斤比较。

senses.english: amount when all is added together; total
senses.exampleEnglish: The sum of these small payments was larger than expected, so we checked each entry before approving the report.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些小额付款加起来比预期多，因此我们批准报告前逐项核查。

senses.english: to add numbers together to find a total
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to sum the payments from each family before deciding how much more money the project requires.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们要先合计各家庭的付款，再判断项目还需多少钱。

senses.english: crime of deliberately killing a person
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel begins with a murder, but the story focuses mainly on how the detective questions the people involved.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说以谋杀案开场，但主要讲侦探如何询问相关人员。

senses.english: to kill a person deliberately and illegally
senses.exampleEnglish: The detective tried to discover who had murdered the character, while the story gradually revealed a different motive for each suspect.
senses.exampleChinese: 侦探试图查出谁谋杀了这个人物，故事则逐渐揭示各嫌疑人的不同动机。

senses.english: electronic screen on which you can see images
senses.exampleEnglish: The monitor displayed a clear image, allowing everyone at the back of the room to follow the demonstration.
senses.exampleChinese: 显示器画面清晰，让房间后面的所有人都能看清演示。

senses.english: to watch or check something over time to see how it changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The team will monitor the water level throughout the week before deciding whether it is safe to reopen the path.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队会整周监测水位，再判断能否安全重开步道。

senses.english: a person given responsibility for checking or helping with a particular activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The class monitor helped collect the forms so the teacher could prepare the materials for the following lesson.
senses.exampleChinese: 班长帮忙收表，让老师能准备下节课的材料。

senses.english: person who is in the military
senses.exampleEnglish: The retired soldier visited the school to talk about teamwork and the importance of helping people in difficult situations.
senses.exampleChinese: 退役士兵到学校讲团队合作，以及帮助困境中人们的重要性。

senses.english: control of money a person/business has access to
senses.exampleEnglish: A strong understanding of finance helped the small organisation plan its work when donations were lower than expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 良好的财务知识帮助这家小机构在捐款低于预期时规划工作。

senses.english: to provide the money needed for an activity or project
senses.exampleEnglish: The council will finance the repairs if the community agrees to help maintain the building after the work is complete.
senses.exampleChinese: 若社区同意维修后协助维护建筑，市议会就提供修理资金。

senses.english: the money available to a person or organisation, often used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The group reviewed its finances before deciding whether it could afford another event during the school holidays.
senses.exampleChinese: 团体先检查财务状况，再决定能否承担假期另办活动的费用。

senses.english: to have a very strong feeling of dislike for
senses.exampleEnglish: I hate wasting food, so I usually plan our meals around what is already in the fridge.
senses.exampleChinese: 我讨厌浪费食物，所以通常按冰箱现有食材安排饭菜。

senses.english: a very strong feeling of dislike
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson asks students to recognise how words can express hate and how respectful disagreement differs from personal attacks.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程让学生辨认言语如何表达憎恨，以及尊重的分歧与人身攻击有何不同。

senses.english: hard-shelled thing from which a young bird is born
senses.exampleEnglish: The bird returned to its nest, where a single egg lay safely among the soft grass and small feathers.
senses.exampleChinese: 鸟回到巢里，一枚蛋安稳地躺在柔草和小羽毛之间。

senses.english: musical entertainment given in public by one or more performers
senses.exampleEnglish: The concert was held in the park, allowing families to enjoy the music while sitting together on the grass.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会在公园举行，家庭们坐在草地上一起欣赏音乐。

senses.english: sudden bad feeling caused by something unexpected
senses.exampleEnglish: It was a shock to discover how much the building had changed since we last visited the town.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现这栋楼自上次来访后改变如此之大，让我们很震惊。

senses.english: a sudden effect of electricity passing through the body
senses.exampleEnglish: The safety lesson explained how damaged wires could cause an electric shock and why repairs require proper equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 安全课解释了损坏电线可能导致电击，以及维修为何需要合适设备。

senses.english: a serious physical condition in which the body cannot circulate enough blood properly
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained that shock is a medical emergency and that the patient needed care from the hospital team.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士解释说休克是急症，患者需要医院团队照护。

senses.english: to make someone feel very surprised or upset
senses.exampleEnglish: The sudden announcement shocked the staff because they had been told that no major changes were expected that month.
senses.exampleChinese: 突如其来的公告让员工震惊，因为之前说当月不会有重大变化。

senses.english: not being worried about something; at ease
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt comfortable asking questions once she realised that several other people were equally unsure about the instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 得知其他几个人也不确定说明的意思后，她放心地开始提问。

senses.english: physically relaxed and free from pain or unpleasant pressure
senses.exampleEnglish: The chair looked attractive, but it was not comfortable enough for someone who needed to sit there all afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 椅子好看，但对需要坐整下午的人而言不够舒适。

senses.english: being the way things occur most of the time
senses.exampleEnglish: The bus arrived at the usual time, but the driver warned us that the journey might take longer than normal.
senses.exampleChinese: 公交车按往常时间到达，但司机提醒我们路程可能比平时久。

senses.english: in a manner that involves focus and care
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the instructions carefully before beginning, because some of the smaller parts must be fitted in a particular order.
senses.exampleChinese: 开始前仔细读说明，因为一些小零件必须按特定顺序安装。

senses.english: to put things in a suitcase to go on a trip
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to pack the equipment carefully so nothing gets damaged while the boxes are being carried upstairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们要小心打包器材，避免箱子搬上楼时损坏物品。

senses.english: a set of things sold, kept or used together
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought a pack of cards so the children would have something to play during the long journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们买了一副牌，让孩子们长途旅行时有东西玩。

senses.english: a bag carried on the back for equipment or travel
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide checked each pack before we left, making sure nobody was carrying more than they could manage.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前向导检查每个背包，确保没人背得超出能力。

senses.english: a group of animals that live or hunt together
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary follows a pack of wolves and explains how the animals cooperate when they travel through their territory.
senses.exampleChinese: 纪录片跟拍狼群，解释它们在领地中行进时如何合作。

senses.english: to fill a place with many people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors packed the hall for the final concert, so the organisers opened another room where people could watch a screen.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一场音乐会观众挤满大厅，组织者另开一间房让人看屏幕。

senses.english: to remember events or details of the past
senses.exampleEnglish: I can recall the conversation clearly because it changed the way I thought about choosing a career.
senses.exampleChinese: 我清楚记得那次谈话，因为它改变了我对择业的看法。

senses.english: to ask for a product to be returned or a person to come back
senses.exampleEnglish: The company decided to recall the product after discovering a fault that might affect how safely it worked.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现可能影响使用安全的故障后，公司决定召回产品。

senses.english: an official request to return a product because something is wrong with it
senses.exampleEnglish: The recall included only one model, so customers were asked to check the number printed underneath their machines.
senses.exampleChinese: 召回仅涉及一款型号，因此请顾客查看机器底部的编号。

senses.english: alcoholic drink made from the juice of grapes
senses.exampleEnglish: The region produces wine from grapes grown on the sunny hillsides that surround its small villages and farms.
senses.exampleChinese: 该地区用周围村庄和农场向阳山坡上种的葡萄酿酒。

senses.english: object that takes pictures digitally, or on film
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept her camera ready because the birds sometimes appeared for only a few seconds before flying away.
senses.exampleChinese: 她一直备好相机，因为鸟有时只出现几秒就飞走。

senses.english: to move through water by moving parts of the body
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose to swim near the shore, where the water was calm and the children could stay close to us.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选择在水面平静的岸边游泳，孩子们也能靠近我们。

senses.english: an occasion of moving through water using the body
senses.exampleEnglish: We went for a swim before breakfast, when the pool was quiet and there was plenty of space.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们早餐前去游泳，当时泳池安静，空间充足。

senses.english: to produce large numbers of products in a factory
senses.exampleEnglish: The factory will manufacture the parts locally, reducing the distance they need to travel before reaching the assembly workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 工厂将在当地制造零件，减少送到装配车间前的运输距离。

senses.english: the process of producing goods in large quantities
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how the manufacture of everyday objects changed as workshops began using machines instead of only hand tools.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览显示车间开始用机器、不再只用手工工具后，日常物品的制造如何改变。

senses.english: place where shows are performed on a stage
senses.exampleEnglish: The theater offers afternoon performances for families who find it difficult to attend shows later in the evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 剧院为不便晚上看演出的家庭提供下午场。

senses.english: the activity or art of writing and performing plays
senses.exampleEnglish: She studied theater before becoming a teacher, which helped her design lively activities that encouraged students to speak confidently.
senses.exampleChinese: 她当老师前学过戏剧，因此能设计活泼活动，鼓励学生自信表达。

senses.english: series of regular and repeated actions
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains the life cycle of a butterfly, showing how each stage prepares it for the next.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览解释蝴蝶的生命周期，展示每个阶段如何为下个阶段作准备。

senses.english: a bicycle, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: The centre has space for every cycle near the entrance, encouraging families to arrive without using their cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 中心入口附近有足够自行车位，鼓励家庭不开车前来。

senses.english: to travel on a bicycle
senses.exampleEnglish: We cycle to the library when the weather is dry because the new path keeps us away from traffic.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气干燥时我们骑车去图书馆，因为新步道让我们远离车流。

senses.english: to pass repeatedly through a series of stages
senses.exampleEnglish: The machine cycles through several stages before stopping, so please do not open the door while it is running.
senses.exampleChinese: 机器会循环经过几个阶段才停止，运行时请勿开门。

senses.english: a brown drink made from roasted beans and boiled water
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped for coffee at a small café where the owner told us about places worth visiting nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在小咖啡馆喝咖啡，店主介绍了附近值得参观的地方。

senses.english: in a complete way; completely; absolutely
senses.exampleEnglish: The village looked totally different after the snow, although we could still recognise the church beside the square.
senses.exampleChinese: 下雪后村子看起来完全不同，但我们仍认得广场旁的教堂。

senses.english: building to display art, science, or history objects
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displays everyday objects from the past, helping visitors imagine how families lived before modern technology became common.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆展示过去的日常物品，帮助游客想象现代技术普及前的家庭生活。

senses.english: one who goes to a place to see it (or someone)
senses.exampleEnglish: Each visitor receives a map showing which rooms are open and where the special exhibition begins on the upper floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位游客都会拿到地图，标明开放房间及楼上特展的起点。

senses.english: state of being free, not being controlled
senses.exampleEnglish: Working from home gave her the freedom to organise her day around both family responsibilities and important meetings.
senses.exampleChinese: 居家工作让她能自由安排一天，兼顾家庭责任和重要会议。

senses.english: act of building something; thing that is built
senses.exampleEnglish: Construction of the new library began in spring, after local families had helped choose the design and suggest useful facilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民参与选择设计并建议实用设施后，新图书馆于春天开工。

senses.english: a way in which words are arranged to form a phrase or sentence
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained the construction by comparing two sentences that used similar words but expressed different ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师比较了两句用词相近、意思却不同的话，以解释这个句式。

senses.english: loved or valued very much
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept the letters from her dear friend in a wooden box, carefully arranged in the order they had arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 她把挚友的信放在木盒里，按收到的顺序仔细排列。

senses.english: costing a lot of money, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: The tickets were rather dear, so we decided to attend only one performance instead of staying for the whole festival.
senses.exampleChinese: 票相当贵，所以我们决定只看一场，而不参加整个节庆。

senses.english: used to express worry, disappointment or surprise
senses.exampleEnglish: Oh dear, I have left the map at home, so we will need to ask someone at the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 哎呀，我把地图忘在家了，我们得问车站的人。

senses.english: a person addressed affectionately
senses.exampleEnglish: My dear, please sit beside the window while I make tea and find the photographs you wanted to see.
senses.exampleChinese: 亲爱的，请坐窗边，我去泡茶并找你想看的照片。

senses.english: something you decide you want to do; goal
senses.exampleEnglish: Our main objective is to make the service easier to use without removing features that experienced users still need.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们的主要目标是让服务更易用，同时保留熟练用户需要的功能。

senses.english: based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions
senses.exampleEnglish: We need an objective assessment of the plan before deciding whether the benefits are worth the expected cost.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定好处是否值得预期费用前，我们需要对计划作客观评估。

senses.english: in addition to what has been said
senses.exampleEnglish: The flat is close to the station; moreover, its windows face the garden rather than the busy main road.
senses.exampleChinese: 公寓靠近车站；此外，窗户面向花园，而非繁忙主路。

senses.english: movement towards a position that is on something
senses.exampleEnglish: The cat jumped onto the low wall, where it could watch the people walking through the square.
senses.exampleChinese: 猫跳上矮墙，在那里看着人们走过广场。

senses.english: of or related to events or people in the past
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide used historical records to explain why the village grew around the bridge rather than beside the old road.
senses.exampleChinese: 向导用历史记录解释，村庄为何围绕桥梁而不是旧公路发展。

senses.english: to be against someone in a contest, game, or fight; to disagree
senses.exampleEnglish: Some residents oppose the development because they believe the new shops would create more traffic on their narrow street.
senses.exampleChinese: 一些居民反对这项开发，因为他们认为新商店会让窄街车流更多。

senses.english: a woody part of a tree that grows out from the trunk or another larger part
senses.exampleEnglish: A low branch stretched across the path, so we had to bend down before continuing through the woods.
senses.exampleChinese: 一根低树枝横在小路上，我们得弯腰才能继续穿过树林。

senses.english: a local office or part of a larger organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The company opened a branch near the station so customers would not need to travel across town for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司在车站附近开设分店，顾客求助时就不必穿过整个城镇。

senses.english: to divide into two or more parts or directions
senses.exampleEnglish: The path branches near the stream, with one route leading to the village and the other climbing towards the woods.
senses.exampleChinese: 小路在溪边分岔，一条通村庄，另一条向树林上坡。
